items.headline: Rethinking read replicas for Lakebase
items.summary: Explains why traditional Postgres read replicas are slow and costly, and how Lakebase takes a different approach.
items.why: Faster, cheaper read scaling could simplify Lakebase Postgres workloads for customers.
items.title: Rethinking read replicas for the lakebase architecture

items.headline: Dashboards send larger emails and keep Excel formatting
items.summary: Subscription emails now allow 24 MB of attachments, up from 9 MB, and Excel downloads from table widgets keep column names and widths.
items.why: Customers can share bigger dashboard reports and get cleaner Excel files without rework.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements

items.headline: Genie Code connects to Power BI and Tableau Cloud
items.summary: Genie Code can now connect to Power BI and Tableau Cloud via MCP connectors, checking imported reports against live sources.
items.why: Improves migration quality when moving Power BI and Tableau reports to Databricks.
items.title: Power BI and Tableau Cloud connectors for BI imports (Public Preview)

items.headline: Genie One desktop app arrives on Windows
items.summary: Genie One now runs as a standalone Windows app, with separate x64 and ARM64 installers and automatic updates.
items.why: Lets Windows and ARM64 users work with Genie One in a dedicated window.
items.title: Genie One desktop app is generally available on Windows

items.headline: Google Gemini 4 Neon on Unity Gateway
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Neon model can now be called through Unity Gateway using the system.ai.gemini-4-neon service name.
items.why: Adds a frontier model option to governed Unity Gateway requests for teams.
items.title: Google Gemini 4 Neon is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Table metrics history system table for storage costs
items.summary: The system.storage.table_metrics_history table is now generally available, tracking daily storage size of managed tables and costs.
items.why: Helps you attribute storage costs and find tables to clean up.
items.title: Table metrics history system table is now generally available

items.headline: Default sign-in idle timeout rises to 24 hours
items.summary: From 15 December 2026, the default idle timeout for Databricks sign-in sessions rises from 6 to 24 hours.
items.why: Longer idle sessions raise exposure on shared devices; custom timeouts still apply.
items.title: Upcoming increase to the default sign-in session idle timeout

items.headline: Sharing catalog metadata across platforms, engines and agents
items.summary: Databricks and partners are advancing catalog labels, an open standard for sharing table and column context across platforms and agents.
items.why: Lets teams share governed table context consistently with tools and agents, improving discovery.
items.title: Sharing catalog metadata across data platforms, engines, and agents

items.headline: Migrate Postgres databases to Lakebase
items.summary: Existing PostgreSQL databases can now be copied into a Lakebase project in one migration, with compatibility assessment first.
items.why: Moves existing Postgres workloads onto Lakebase without manual copying, reducing migration effort.
items.title: Migrate a Postgres database to Lakebase (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Migrate converts T-SQL to Lakeflow pipelines
items.summary: T-SQL scripts from SQL Server and Synapse dedicated pools can now convert into Lakeflow pipelines, generally available.
items.why: Speeds migration of legacy SQL Server and Synapse workloads onto serverless pipelines.
items.title: Genie Migrate conversion to Lakeflow pipelines is generally available

items.headline: Lakewatch adds streaming detection rules
items.summary: Lakewatch rules now evaluate each arriving row and raise a signal on SQL matches, with no warehouse needed.
items.why: Enables low-latency detection of threats such as IOCs without managing compute.
items.title: Lakewatch streaming detection rules (Experimental)

items.headline: OpenSharing SecureConnect directory-based access
items.summary: OpenSharing SecureConnect can now deliver eligible tables and views using serverless compute with directory-based access instead of per-file pre-signed URLs.
items.why: Faster delivery of shared tables to Databricks recipients, with admin preview controls.
items.title: Directory-based access for OpenSharing SecureConnect (Public Preview)

items.headline: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 joins Unity Gateway
items.summary: Google's Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 image model can now be called via Foundation Model APIs on Unity Gateway.
items.why: Gives teams image generation from text and image inputs within Databricks governance.
items.title: Google Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Genie One users can access without workspace assignment
items.summary: Users provisioned via automatic identity management or account-level SCIM can now use Genie One without workspace assignment or entitlement.
items.why: Simplifies Genie One rollout, with Unity Catalog still governing each user's data access.
items.title: Account-only user access to Genie One is generally available

items.headline: Impact analysis in Unity Catalog lineage
items.summary: Unity Catalog lineage now shows downstream assets depending on a table or column, with impact levels and owners.
items.why: Helps teams assess change risk and find owners before altering tables or columns.
items.title: Impact analysis in Unity Catalog lineage (Beta)

items.headline: Artifact Registry stores container images as governed assets
items.summary: Container images can now be stored in Unity Catalog, browsed in Catalog Explorer, and managed via the CLI and API.
items.why: Gives one governed home for container images alongside your data and AI assets.
items.title: Artifact Registry is now generally available

items.headline: Genie Code analysis for alerts
items.summary: Alert owners can enable Genie Code to investigate alerts when they trigger or error.
items.why: Speeds up diagnosing triggered or failed alerts with AI-driven investigation.
items.title: Genie Code analysis for alerts is in Beta

items.headline: ai_mask adds version 2.0 with built-in detection
items.summary: ai_mask version 2.0 in Beta masks sensitive data using a Databricks-built detection model across listed classifiers.
items.why: Lets teams mask sensitive data automatically; opt in via version option, v1.0 stays default.
items.title: ai_mask now supports a version 2.0 signature (Beta)

items.headline: ai_forecast version 2 becomes default for compliance workspaces
items.summary: From January 2027, ai_forecast version 2 is the default for compliance-profile workspaces, adding holidays, covariates and non-negative forecasts.
items.why: Better SQL forecasts for regulated teams; queries without a version still use v1.
items.title: ai_forecast version 2 will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Genie Search indexes SharePoint Online files
items.summary: Genie Search can now index SharePoint Online files for Genie One to search alongside other sources, respecting existing permissions.
items.why: Lets teams find SharePoint documents in one place, with existing access permissions preserved.
items.title: Search SharePoint content with Genie Search (Beta)

items.headline: Published outbound IP addresses for serverless compute
items.summary: Databricks now publishes outbound IP addresses for serverless compute, so firewalls can allow it.
items.why: Lets teams allowlist serverless workloads through firewalls protecting their resources.
items.title: Outbound IP addresses for serverless compute are generally available

items.headline: Terraform support for Lakebase resources
items.summary: Eight Lakebase resources in the Terraform provider are now generally available from version 1.145.0.
items.why: Lets teams manage Lakebase infrastructure as code with production-ready Terraform resources.
items.title: Lakebase Terraform resources are generally available

items.headline: Genie Agents add MCP tool support
items.summary: Genie Agents can now attach external MCP servers registered in Unity Gateway, alongside Databricks connectors, via Agent mode APIs.
items.why: Lets authors give Genie agents access to external tools and data sources.
items.title: MCP tools in Genie Agents are generally available

items.headline: Genie One chat now works across workspaces
items.summary: Account-level Genie One can now chat across workspaces in the same region sharing a Unity Catalog metastore.
items.why: Lets users query and act on assets across linked workspaces, simplifying multi-workspace analytics.
items.title: Cross-workspace chat in account-level Genie One

items.headline: Warehouse-level statement timeouts for SQL warehouses
items.summary: Teams can now set a statement timeout on each SQL warehouse through the API, SDKs, Terraform or bundles.
items.why: Caps runaway queries at warehouse level, helping control compute costs and performance.
items.title: Warehouse-level statement timeouts are now generally available

items.headline: OAuth authentication for webhook notification destinations
items.summary: Webhook notification destinations can now authenticate using OAuth 2.0 client credentials and access tokens from a token endpoint.
items.why: Strengthens security for alerts sent to external systems via webhooks.
items.title: OAuth authentication for webhook notification destinations is generally available

items.headline: Genie ZeroOps autonomously fixes broken data pipelines
items.summary: Genie ZeroOps, an autonomous agent, now in beta, detects, investigates and fixes data pipeline issues.
items.why: Could reduce manual pipeline firefighting, built from 80,000 real customer issues.
items.title: Genie ZeroOps, now in public beta: An autonomous agent that fixes data pipelines, with lessons from 80,000 customer issues

items.headline: Bulk migrate Tableau and Power BI dashboards to AI/BI
items.summary: Genie Code can bulk migrate Tableau and Power BI reports to AI/BI using one /importBI command, followed by review.
items.why: Cuts the effort of moving existing Tableau and Power BI dashboards onto Databricks.
items.title: Bulk migrate your dashboards to AI/BI with Genie Code

items.headline: Genie Migrate for Serverless helps move classic workloads
items.summary: Databricks introduces a tool that assesses classic workloads, translates configurations and applies changes with rollback.
items.why: Speeds up moving classic workloads to serverless safely, with rollback if changes fail.
items.title: Introducing Genie Migrate for Serverless

items.headline: PostgreSQL 19 arrives on Lakebase
items.summary: Lakebase now offers PostgreSQL 19, released the same day as the community version.
items.why: Lets teams use the latest Postgres features on managed Lakebase without waiting.
items.title: PostgreSQL 19 is available on Lakebase

items.headline: CustomerLake Conversions improves advertising performance with first-party data
items.summary: Databricks launches a way to send first-party customer data and ML model outputs to advertising platforms via CAPI.
items.why: Helps brands and agencies improve ROAS and advertising measurement using their own customer data.
items.title: Introducing CustomerLake Conversions: Improve advertising performance with first-party customer context

items.headline: Manage Lakewatch with the Databricks CLI
items.summary: Lakewatch can now be managed from the command line, including datasources, parsers, detection rules and catalog configuration.
items.why: Lets security teams automate Lakewatch setup and detection rules through scripts.
items.title: Manage Lakewatch with the Databricks CLI (Beta)

items.headline: New functions for manipulating VARIANT values
items.summary: Six SQL functions for editing VARIANT data, plus error-tolerant versions, now available in Databricks SQL and Runtime 19.
items.why: Lets teams insert, update and delete semi-structured JSON fields directly in SQL.
items.title: New VARIANT manipulation functions

items.headline: Genie One adds voice input and Android notifications
items.summary: Voice input is now generally available across Genie One web, desktop and mobile; Android push notifications are in preview.
items.why: Lets teams dictate prompts, and get Android alerts for long-running tasks.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Genie Code recreates dashboards from screenshots more faithfully
items.summary: Genie Code now copies a screenshot's visual styling more closely when recreating a dashboard.
items.why: Faster dashboard rebuilds from existing visuals, with fewer manual styling adjustments needed.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements

items.headline: Genie arrives in Microsoft Copilot, Teams and Excel
items.summary: Databricks Genie now works inside Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Chat, Teams and Excel, letting users query data there.
items.why: Lets business users query governed Databricks data from tools they already use.
items.title: What's new for Genie in Microsoft: Copilot Cowork and Chat, Microsoft Teams, and Excel.

items.headline: Genie Code CLI moves to shared budget management
items.summary: The Genie Code CLI is generally available, managed like the workspace version, with one shared budget and free monthly usage.
items.why: Admins control one budget across CLI and workspace; users can use free Genie usage.
items.title: Genie Code CLI is now generally available

items.headline: ai_forecast version 2 with improved accuracy
items.summary: Version 2 of the ai_forecast SQL function uses a new forecasting foundation model, adding holiday support, external covariates and non-negative forecasts.
items.why: Better out-of-the-box forecast accuracy in SQL without building custom models.
items.title: ai_forecast version 2 is now generally available

items.headline: Smart Routing sends coding agent subagents to external models
items.summary: Smart Routing in Unity Gateway can now send coding-agent subagents to external models behind a provider service.
items.why: Lets teams use external models in coding agent workflows, beyond Databricks-hosted models.
items.title: Smart Routing now supports external models for coding agents (Beta)

items.headline: Configurable retention for system tables
items.summary: Account admins can now set system table retention from 30 to 3,650 days; the first 395 days are free.
items.why: Lets you balance audit history against storage costs, since data kept beyond 395 days is charged.
items.title: Configurable retention for system tables is generally available

items.headline: Service policies now protect embedding inputs
items.summary: Service policies can now mask sensitive data in embedding inputs, or deny requests containing it or unsafe content.
items.why: Stops sensitive data and unsafe content reaching embedding models, supporting safer AI data handling.
items.title: Service policies protect embedding inputs (Beta)

items.headline: Service policies evaluate streaming responses incrementally
items.summary: Model output policies now evaluate streaming responses by default, including existing policies; choose full response evaluation to buffer.
items.why: Released text can't be recalled, so buffering may be needed for strict output checks.
items.title: Evaluate streaming responses incrementally with service policies (Beta)

items.headline: OAuth M2M authentication for Salesforce, ServiceNow and Jira connectors
items.summary: OAuth machine-to-machine authentication is now generally available for Salesforce, ServiceNow and Jira connectors in Lakeflow Connect.
items.why: Pipelines can connect without a person signing in, simplifying credential management.
items.title: OAuth M2M authentication for the Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Jira connectors

items.headline: LTAP Direct Writes for synced tables
items.summary: Synced table loads now write straight to Lakebase storage, bypassing compute endpoints, so loads are faster.
items.why: Faster large loads that no longer slow down your application's queries.
items.title: LTAP Direct Writes for synced tables is now generally available

items.headline: Unity Catalog and Google Cloud catalog interoperability
items.summary: Databricks and Google Cloud enable zero-copy data access via catalog federation, plus open business and governance metadata.
items.why: Lets teams query data across clouds without copying it, and share business context.
items.title: Advancing Catalog Interoperability with Unity Catalog and Google Cloud’s Borderless Lakehouse

items.headline: Azure Databricks now available on Azure Government
items.summary: Azure Databricks is now in Beta on Azure Government, with plans toward FedRAMP Class D and IL5 compliance.
items.why: Gives government agencies a Databricks route to AI, with stronger compliance on the way.
items.title: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta

items.headline: LiveRamp RampID arrives in packaged clean rooms
items.summary: Shows how LiveRamp identity resolution runs inside a Databricks packaged clean room, using live OpenSharing access.
items.why: Lets customers match identities across partners with secure, governed results in their lakehouse.
items.title: How packaged clean rooms bring RampID to your lakehouse

items.headline: Unity Gateway Insights shows agent usage and wasted tokens
items.summary: Unity Gateway Insights can now generate reports on how people use agents and where tokens are wasted, built by Genie Code from sampled sessions.
items.why: Shows where agent spend goes, helping cut wasted token costs.
items.title: Analyze agent usage and find wasted tokens with Unity Gateway Insights (Beta)

items.headline: Lakebase streaming sink supports merges and schema evolution
items.summary: Lakebase streaming sink supports Trigger.AvailableNow on serverless, plus merge strategies and additive schema evolution in Runtime 19.
items.why: Lets streaming pipelines write to Lakebase with production-ready merges and schema changes.
items.title: Lakebase streaming sink is generally available

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on Unity Gateway
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models can now be accessed via Foundation Model APIs, supporting text, images, function calling and reasoning.
items.why: Gives teams two new OpenAI models through one governed gateway.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Data Classification skips rescans of recreated tables
items.summary: Data Classification no longer rescans recreated or briefly existing temporary tables, lowering ongoing scan costs automatically.
items.why: Cuts ongoing scan costs for catalogs with frequently recreated tables, with no configuration needed.
items.title: Data Classification no longer rescans recreated tables or scans short-lived temporary tables

items.headline: Tabular foundation models on Databricks AI Runtime
items.summary: Tabular foundation models can predict on new datasets without task-specific training, speeding up ML experiments.
items.why: Faster predictive ML experiments without training a bespoke model for each dataset.
items.title: Tabular foundation models on Databricks AI Runtime

items.headline: Genie Ontology snippets arrive by default in November
items.summary: Genie Ontology snippets will be enabled by default in early November 2026, automatically extracting business context from metric views, dashboards and queries.
items.why: Improves Genie answer accuracy and speed using governed metric views and dashboards.
items.title: Genie Ontology snippets will soon be generally available and enabled by default

items.headline: Share Unity Catalog agent skills through OpenSharing
items.summary: Providers can now add Unity Catalog agent skills to OpenSharing shares and Marketplace listings, with read-only access for Databricks recipients.
items.why: Lets teams distribute reusable AI agent skills securely to partners and customers.
items.title: Share Unity Catalog agent skills with OpenSharing and Databricks Marketplace (Beta)

items.headline: Governed tag propagation now works on classic compute
items.summary: Governed tags on a source now propagate to derived tables and views on classic compute running Runtime 19 or above, as well as serverless.
items.why: Keeps governance tags consistent across derived tables and views on more compute types.
items.title: Governed tag propagation supports classic compute (Beta)

items.headline: Integrated CDC pipeline for PostgreSQL ingestion
items.summary: Databricks can now ingest PostgreSQL change data through a single integrated CDC pipeline, without a separate ingestion gateway.
items.why: Simpler change data capture from PostgreSQL, with fewer components to run.
items.title: PostgreSQL integrated CDC pipeline is now in Beta

items.headline: OpenAI and Databricks: enterprise AI on governed data
items.summary: Databricks and OpenAI show how enterprises use ChatGPT, Codex and GPT models on governed Databricks data.
items.why: Shows how firms combine OpenAI models with governed data for enterprise AI.
items.title: OpenAI and Databricks: Enterprise AI on your governed data

items.headline: Metric view parameters bind values at query time
items.summary: Metric views now support parameters that bind values at query time, letting one definition serve many query variants.
items.why: Cuts duplicate metric definitions; requires Databricks Runtime 18.2 or above.
items.title: Metric view parameters are generally available

items.headline: Value lists for AI/BI dashboard parameters
items.summary: Dashboard parameters can now offer a fixed, ordered list of values for viewers to pick from, including on metric views.
items.why: Gives viewers consistent, controlled choices in dashboard filters, reducing mistyped or invalid values.
items.title: Value lists for AI/BI dashboard parameters are generally available

items.headline: Declarative Automation Bundles support AI Function tasks
items.summary: Declarative Automation Bundles can now define and deploy AI Function tasks, currently in Beta.
items.why: Lets teams version and deploy AI Function tasks alongside their jobs.
items.title: AI Function task support in Declarative Automation Bundles (Beta)

items.headline: Unity Catalog views via Iceberg REST catalog
items.summary: External Iceberg engines can now query Unity Catalog views over Iceberg-compatible tables through the REST catalog.
items.why: Lets non-Databricks engines read governed views without copying data, extending Unity Catalog reach.
items.title: External access to views through the Iceberg REST catalog is in Beta

items.headline: Genie Migrate converts T-SQL to Lakeflow pipelines
items.summary: Genie Migrate can now convert SQL Server and Synapse T-SQL scripts into serverless Lakeflow pipelines, currently in Beta.
items.why: Speeds moving legacy SQL Server and Synapse workloads onto Databricks pipelines.
items.title: Genie Migrate can convert T-SQL to Lakeflow pipelines (Beta)

items.headline: Files API 3.0 adds large file uploads
items.summary: Files API 3.0 for Unity Catalog volumes will soon be generally available, adding multipart uploads for files over 5 GB.
items.why: Enables reliable handling of very large files and safer conditional file changes in volumes.
items.title: Files API 3.0 will soon be generally available

items.headline: Efficient column updates in Delta Lake
items.summary: Delta Lake can add and backfill columns without rewriting unchanged columns, now available in beta for workspace admins to enable.
items.why: Avoids rewriting large Delta tables when adding or backfilling columns.
items.title: Efficient column updates (Beta)

items.headline: Discover page and domains default for compliance workspaces
items.summary: From December 2026, Discover and domains will be on by default for workspaces using the compliance security profile.
items.why: Helps compliance teams find and organise trusted assets by business area.
items.title: The Discover page and domains will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Genie Migrate for moving SQL workloads onto Databricks
items.summary: Genie Migrate converts SQL from seven platforms, including Teradata, Oracle and Snowflake, into ANSI SQL or PySpark on Databricks.
items.why: Cuts manual effort and risk when moving legacy warehouses onto the Lakehouse.
items.title: Migrate Effortlessly to the Databricks Lakehouse with Genie Migrate, now Generally Available

items.headline: Lakehouse//RT scales real-time analytics without rising costs
items.summary: Lakehouse//RT handles growing real-time query volume without matching cost increases, and can replace separate real-time serving stacks.
items.why: Cuts serving costs and removes the need for a separate real-time stack.
items.title: Lakehouse//RT: Scale real-time analytics, not your bill

items.headline: Genie in Slack brings governed AI answers to chat
items.summary: Genie can now answer questions and take actions via MCP connectors directly in Slack, using existing Genie One permissions.
items.why: Lets teams get governed answers where they already work, without new access rules.
items.title: Genie in Slack is now Generally Available: Governed AI cowork, right where work happens

items.headline: Genie ZeroOps monitors pipelines and proposes fixes
items.summary: Genie ZeroOps monitors jobs, pipelines and tables, detects failures, investigates root causes and proposes fixes.
items.why: Automates detecting and fixing data failures, reducing manual troubleshooting for data teams.
items.title: Genie ZeroOps is available in Beta

items.headline: Google Gemini 4 Hydrogen now available on Unity Gateway
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen model can now be accessed through Unity Gateway using Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Adds a new model option for generative AI apps, with customers responsible for compliance terms.
items.title: Google Gemini 4 Hydrogen is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Artifacts and slides in Genie One
items.summary: Genie One can now build slide decks and visual pages from your data, which you can edit, present and share.
items.why: Viewers see stored data snapshots, even without access to the source tables.
items.title: Artifacts and slides in Genie One (Beta)

items.headline: OAuth on-behalf-of for service principals
items.summary: Service principals can now use OAuth on-behalf-of by default, with no OAuth secret needed.
items.why: Removes OAuth secrets for automation, reducing credential management and security risk.
items.title: OAuth on-behalf-of for service principals is generally available

items.headline: Genie One desktop app arrives on macOS
items.summary: The Genie One desktop app is now available on macOS, offering the web experience in its own window with automatic updates and dock badges.
items.why: Lets Genie One users work in a dedicated Mac app; Windows is in Beta.
items.title: Genie One desktop app is generally available on macOS

items.headline: ABAC DENY policies now cover AI securables
items.summary: DENY policies can now apply to model, MCP, agent and skill services, and attach directly to individual objects.
items.why: Lets governance teams block access to AI assets at object level.
items.title: ABAC DENY policies support AI securables and attachment to individual objects (Beta)

items.headline: Flows become securable objects in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Pipeline flows can now be granted individual permissions in Unity Catalog, including read, refresh, write and manage, with a Beta available by request.
items.why: Lets teams control access to individual pipeline flows more precisely.
items.title: Flows are securable objects in Unity Catalog (Beta)

items.headline: Unity Gateway budgets now support daily thresholds
items.summary: Unity Gateway budgets, including Genie, can now set daily per-user thresholds alongside monthly ones, with separate actions.
items.why: Gives finer control over per-user spend on AI usage, resetting daily at 00:00 UTC.
items.title: Budgets now support daily thresholds in addition to monthly thresholds

items.headline: Dashboard enhancements, including pivot table improvements
items.summary: Dashboards gain pivot table sorting and styling, undo for variables, and Genie Code custom calculation referencing.
items.why: Smoother pivot tables and clearer filter behaviour for dashboard authors and viewers.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Lakewatch Overview page redesigned with new navigation
items.summary: The Overview page now opens with a Genie question box, seven-day activity and tabs, and controls moved to the top menu.
items.why: Faster security monitoring view, with environment and warehouse pickers in one menu.
items.title: Redesigned Lakewatch Overview page and navigation

items.headline: Genie One adds scheduled task emails and mobile links
items.summary: Scheduled tasks in Genie One can now email other users in your organisation, and chat and dashboard links open in the mobile app.
items.why: Share scheduled Genie results with colleagues and open chats on mobile.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Genie One brings AI cowork home for everyone
items.summary: Genie One unifies search, directories, artifacts, an autonomous agent and MCP actions across browsers, mobile, Slack and Teams.
items.why: Gives teams one governed AI workspace, reaching people where they already work.
items.title: Genie One: The AI cowork home for everyone

items.headline: Genie Agents now analyse documents, Slack and Jira
items.summary: Genie Agents can now analyse documents in Unity Catalog volumes, act in Slack and Jira via MCP connectors, and be shared with partners.
items.why: Lets teams query documents and take actions in everyday tools, extending agents beyond data.
items.title: From enterprise context to action: Genie Agents now analyze more data sources to transform your work

items.headline: Genie plugins bring business context to ChatGPT and Claude
items.summary: Databricks Genie plugins now share governed Genie Ontology business context with ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot.
items.why: Lets teams use consistent, governed definitions inside the AI assistants they already use.
items.title: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot

items.headline: Databricks invests $3 billion across EMEA
items.summary: Databricks will invest $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East, adding engineers and customer teams to scale AI adoption, including Lakebase and Genie.
items.why: Signals sustained regional investment in AI tooling, support and local expertise for enterprise customers.
items.title: Databricks to Invest ~$3 Billion Across Europe and the Middle East to Accelerate Enterprise AI Adoption

items.headline: Pages for governed business definitions in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Pages, organised by domain on Discover, let curators certify and deprecate business definitions, with a MANAGE PAGES permission controlling publishing.
items.why: Gives consistent business definitions, with permissions and API management for data teams.
items.title: Pages are generally available

items.headline: Standalone pipelines on serverless general compute from notebooks
items.summary: Materialised views and streaming tables can now be created and refreshed from notebooks on serverless general compute, using SQL or Python.
items.why: Simplifies building pipeline tables by keeping work inside familiar notebooks.
items.title: Standalone pipelines on serverless general compute are now generally available

items.headline: Pages to become default for compliant workspaces
items.summary: From December 2026, Pages is on by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile, except those with other compliance standards.
items.why: Governed business definitions reach more regulated workspaces; Genie One cites them.
items.title: Pages will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Custom Python service policies in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Custom service policies can now be written as Python functions in Unity Catalog, for rules SQL cannot express.
items.why: Enables guardrails and regex or package rules that SQL policies cannot handle.
items.title: Write custom service policies in Python (Beta)

items.headline: Genie One desktop app arrives for Windows
items.summary: Genie One's desktop app now runs natively on Windows as well as macOS, so users can chat with data outside a browser.
items.why: Lets business users query data and use agents without opening a browser.
items.title: The Genie One desktop app for Windows is in Beta

items.headline: Use your ChatGPT subscription with Codex via Unity Gateway
items.summary: Users can now bill Codex and ChatGPT desktop requests to their own ChatGPT Go, Plus, Pro or Enterprise subscription, with Unity Gateway governing access.
items.why: Lets teams use existing ChatGPT plans for coding agents while keeping governance in place.
items.title: Bring your own ChatGPT subscription to Codex with Unity Gateway

items.headline: Partial schema inference for Python Lakeflow pipelines
items.summary: Python Lakeflow pipelines will let you declare only some columns' types, constraints or comments, inferring the rest.
items.why: Lets you control key column types without defining full schemas manually.
items.title: Partial schema inference for Python Lakeflow pipelines

items.headline: Unity Gateway adds GitHub Copilot CLI and VS Code
items.summary: Unity Gateway can now configure GitHub Copilot CLI and Copilot in Visual Studio Code, including models, headers and tracing.
items.why: Lets admins set models, headers and tracing for developers' coding agents.
items.title: Connect GitHub Copilot CLI and GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code with Unity Gateway

items.headline: Serverless rate limits for jobs and pipelines
items.summary: Serverless jobs and pipelines can now cap Spark executor autoscaling via an automated compute size setting.
items.why: Gives tighter control over serverless compute costs and scaling behaviour.
items.title: Serverless rate limits are now in Beta

items.headline: Lakewatch folders can now use existing schemas
items.summary: Add folder in Lakewatch can now register an existing schema, without needing CREATE SCHEMA rights, and folders can be deleted from Settings.
items.why: Lets teams reuse existing schemas for Lakewatch without extra catalog privileges.
items.title: Add Lakewatch folders from existing schemas

items.headline: Unity Catalog metric views now available in Power BI
items.summary: Unity Catalog metric views can now be used directly in Power BI, keeping business definitions governed in one place.
items.why: Keeps Power BI reports on the same governed metric definitions.
items.title: Unity Catalog Metric Views, now in Power BI: one unified, governed semantic layer for all your reporting and AI

items.headline: Databricks invests over $500M in Netherlands
items.summary: Databricks will invest over $500m in the Netherlands, doubling its Amsterdam R&D team and advancing Lakebase, Genie and Unity Gateway.
items.why: Signals deeper local support and new Lakebase, Genie and Unity Gateway capabilities for Dutch enterprises.
items.title: Databricks to Invest More Than $500M in the Netherlands to Accelerate Enterprise Data + AI

items.headline: Google Gemini 4 Carbon joins Unity Gateway
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon model can now be accessed through Unity Gateway using Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams a new model through governed, existing Databricks access controls.
items.title: Google Gemini 4 Carbon is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: External access to Unity Catalog Delta tables becomes default
items.summary: From December 10, 2026, external Delta clients get access to managed tables by default in eligible compliance-profile workspaces.
items.why: Lets external engines read and write governed tables; check compliance workspaces before the change.
items.title: External access to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Allow ChatGPT and Claude through context-based ingress policies
items.summary: Context-based ingress policies can now allow traffic from ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms, with IP ranges maintained by Databricks.
items.why: Lets hosted MCP clients such as Genie plugins reach your workspace without manual IP tracking.
items.title: Allow ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms in context-based ingress policies

items.headline: Genie One Chrome extension for new tabs
items.summary: Genie One can now open in every new Chrome tab, for quick questions, searches and dashboards.
items.why: One click access to Genie One from any new browser tab.
items.title: The Genie One Chrome extension is in Beta

items.headline: Custom model serving accepts text and binary protobuf inputs
items.summary: Protobuf requests to custom model serving endpoints can now include text and binary data alongside numeric tensors.
items.why: Lets models accept documents, images and audio alongside numeric data in one request.
items.title: Text and binary inputs for protobuf requests to custom model serving endpoints (Public Preview)

items.headline: Budget alerts can now trigger webhooks
items.summary: Budgets can now trigger webhooks when spend thresholds are reached, routing alerts to incident, ticketing or automation tools.
items.why: Lets cost events flow into existing incident and automation workflows.
items.title: Budget alerts can now trigger webhooks (Beta)

items.headline: Databricks expands European sovereignty capabilities across AWS and Azure
items.summary: Databricks is expanding sovereignty capabilities on AWS and Azure to help meet European data-residency requirements.
items.why: Helps European organisations meet data-residency and sovereignty rules on their preferred cloud.
items.title: Databricks' Commitment to European Sovereignty

items.headline: UCDataset streams Unity Catalog tables to GPU training
items.summary: UCDataset streams Unity Catalog tables straight to every GPU in PyTorch training jobs, without exports or custom loaders.
items.why: Speeds up deep learning training by removing data export and loader engineering.
items.title: Accelerate GPU training on Unity Catalog tables with UCDataset

items.headline: Sendoso gifts in Genie One from buying signals
items.summary: Sales, marketing and customer success teams can approve gifts in Genie One from intent signals via Sendoso's MCP server and track results.
items.why: Lets go-to-market teams act on intent signals and measure pipeline impact.
items.title: Turn buying signals into pipeline with Sendoso gifts in Genie One

items.headline: Genie Ontology gives AI agents a business-aware context map
items.summary: Genie Ontology combines modelled Unity Catalog semantics with learned usage knowledge to map your organisation for agents.
items.why: Gives Genie One, Genie Code and agents consistent business context across your data.
items.title: Genie Ontology is now generally available

items.headline: Databricks Genie app arrives in Microsoft Teams
items.summary: The Genie app in Microsoft Teams is now generally available, letting users ask data questions in chats and channels.
items.why: Lets teams get data answers without leaving Microsoft Teams, reducing context switching.
items.title: Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams is now generally available

items.headline: Genie Search now indexes org knowledge across connected sources
items.summary: Genie Search indexes knowledge from sources like Google Drive, Jira and Confluence, respecting each document's existing permissions.
items.why: Lets teams find documents and people in one place, with access controls intact.
items.title: Genie Search is now generally available

items.headline: AI Functions asynchronous API for batch processing
items.summary: Lets AI Functions run ai_parse_document, ai_extract or ai_classify asynchronously on up to 50,000 JSONL requests.
items.why: Processes large document batches without manual looping, writing results to a Unity Catalog volume.
items.title: AI Functions Asynchronous API (Beta)

items.headline: Lakewatch brings security log monitoring to Databricks
items.summary: Lakewatch ingests security logs into governed tables, runs detection rules, and helps investigate alerts.
items.why: Lets security teams monitor and respond to threats within Databricks.
items.title: Lakewatch is available in Beta

items.headline: Claude Fable 5.2 now available on Unity Gateway
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 model can now be accessed through Unity Gateway using Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams another hosted model option under existing governance and access controls.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.2 is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Cleaned AI answers now available in Lakeflow Designer
items.summary: Lakeflow Designer can now clean supported AI Function outputs for downstream transformations, with answers, errors and raw responses in separate columns.
items.why: Lets teams use AI results reliably in pipeline steps, with errors visible.
items.title: Use cleaned AI answers in Lakeflow Designer (Public Preview)

items.headline: Provision Claude desktop via MDM using Unity Gateway.
items.summary: Admins can deploy Claude desktop machine-wide via MDM with governed models, MCP servers and skills; macOS only.
items.why: Lets IT govern Claude access on managed Mac fleets with approved models and tools.
items.title: Provision Claude desktop with MDM using Unity Gateway

items.headline: Shift dates in Lakeflow Jobs parameters
items.summary: Lakeflow Jobs dynamic values can now shift dates by a duration before formatting them.
items.why: Lets teams pass relative dates, such as yesterday, to tasks without custom code.
items.title: Shift dates in Lakeflow Jobs parameters with date arithmetic (Beta)

items.headline: Consumer access extends to workspace objects in Genie One
items.summary: Consumer users will soon read and write workspace objects they already can access, enabling forecasting, slides and visual data prep.
items.why: Admins should review group grants, since consumer users inherit users group permissions.
items.title: Consumer access to workspace objects is coming soon

items.headline: Unity Catalog volumes can now be recovered
items.summary: You can now restore a Unity Catalog volume dropped within the past seven days, keeping its privileges and tags.
items.why: Recovers accidentally dropped volumes without rebuilding permissions or tags, reducing downtime and manual rework.
items.title: Recover dropped Unity Catalog volumes with UNDROP VOLUME

items.headline: Unity Catalog managed tables move to catalog commits
items.summary: After Runtime 15.4 LTS ends support on 19 August 2027, all Unity Catalog managed tables will upgrade to catalog commits.
items.why: Enables multi-table transactions and consistent governance across external engines.
items.title: All Unity Catalog managed tables will be upgraded to catalog commits

items.headline: Unity Catalog wikis document table meaning and usage
items.summary: Data owners can draft wikis describing tables' meaning, intended use and sources, and teams can comment and suggest edits.
items.why: Shared table documentation gives business context that improves discovery and trust in data.
items.title: Unity Catalog wikis are in Beta

items.headline: Restore deleted Unity Catalog metastores via REST API
items.summary: Account admins can now restore a deleted Unity Catalog metastore by ID, within five days of deletion.
items.why: Recovers accidentally deleted governance metadata quickly, reducing outage risk for data teams.
items.title: Restore a deleted Unity Catalog metastore with the REST API (Public Preview)

items.headline: Account-only users gain Genie One access by default
items.summary: From November 2026, account-only users added via AIM or SCIM can access account-level Genie One by default.
items.why: Shares to all account users now reach these users, so review them before the change.
items.title: Account-only user access to Genie One will soon be generally available and enabled by default

items.headline: AI Search endpoints show error sources, ingestion rate
items.summary: AI Search endpoints now show whether failed queries come from the embedding model or AI Search, plus rows written per second.
items.why: Helps pinpoint the failing component and monitor indexing throughput via the Metrics tab or API.
items.title: AI Search endpoint metrics show error sources and ingestion rate

items.headline: Feature Views for real-time fraud detection
items.summary: Feature Views define fraud features once for point-in-time training and online scoring.
items.why: Reduces data leakage and training-serving skew in fraud models.
items.title: Real-time fraud detection with Feature Views

items.headline: OpenSharing replaces Delta Sharing as open protocol
items.summary: Delta Sharing is renamed OpenSharing, an open protocol now covering tables, agent skills, AI models and unstructured data.
items.why: Lets you share agent skills, AI models and unstructured data across platforms.
items.title: From Delta Sharing to OpenSharing: what changed, what's next

items.headline: Zerobus Ingest and Debezium stream CDC into Unity Catalog
items.summary: Debezium Server streams CDC events directly into Unity Catalog Delta tables through push-based Zerobus Ingest.
items.why: Gives engineers a governed, direct path for CDC data into Unity Catalog.
items.title: Push-based CDC into Unity Catalog with Zerobus Ingest and Debezium

items.headline: Allow Power BI and Tableau through ingress policies
items.summary: Context-based ingress policies can now permit traffic from Power BI, Tableau Cloud, dbt Cloud and Genie in Slack and Teams.
items.why: BI tools connect without manual IP tracking, as Databricks keeps partner details current.
items.title: Allow partner platforms in context-based ingress policies

items.headline: Genie can use Power BI measure definitions
items.summary: Databricks can pull metadata from Power BI semantic models, and Genie can use Power BI measure definitions in answers.
items.why: Gives Genie business definitions already agreed in Power BI, so answers match existing reporting.
items.title: External knowledge sources are in Beta

items.headline: Providers can publish metric views in Marketplace
items.summary: Providers can now publish governed metric views as listings in Databricks Marketplace, shareable only with Databricks recipients.
items.why: Lets teams share consistent business metrics with Databricks customers, reducing definition drift.
items.title: Metric view listings are generally available in Databricks Marketplace

items.headline: Tableau and Sigma added as external knowledge sources
items.summary: Databricks plans to support Tableau and Sigma as external knowledge sources.
items.why: Brings BI tool context into AI answers for teams using Tableau or Sigma.
items.title: More external knowledge sources

items.headline: Apache Spark 4.3 arrives in Databricks Runtime 19
items.summary: Apache Spark 4.3 adds stateful streaming with millisecond latency, history-preserving Auto CDC, and faster development tools.
items.why: Brings low-latency streaming and easier change data capture to Databricks Runtime 19.
items.title: Introducing Apache Spark® 4.3 - Now available in Databricks Runtime 19

items.headline: Genie Code imports metric view relationships to dashboards
items.summary: Genie Code can now import relationships declared on Unity Catalog metric views into dashboards as dashboard relationships.
items.why: Saves rebuilding joins by hand when building dashboards on governed metric views.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie Migrate for Serverless moves classic jobs to serverless
items.summary: An agent builds serverless working copies of classic jobs for review, approval and background migration via the CLI.
items.why: Cuts manual effort moving jobs to serverless compute safely, with human approval before changes.
items.title: Genie Migrate for Serverless (Beta)

items.headline: Smart Routing now routes only subagents
items.summary: Smart Routing now only routes subagents, cutting costs up to 70% in internal tests and p90 latency from 9 to 2 seconds.
items.why: Lower costs and faster agent responses for multi-agent workloads.
items.title: Smart Routing is faster and lower cost, and now routes subagents only (Beta)

items.headline: Calculate across rows in Lakeflow Designer
items.summary: Lakeflow Designer adds a Multi-Row Formula operator for running totals, ranks and moving averages across ordered rows.
items.why: Lets teams build window-style calculations visually, without writing code.
items.title: Calculate across rows in Lakeflow Designer (Public Preview)

items.headline: Claude Code and Codex in SSH tunnel sessions
items.summary: Claude Code and Codex can now run in SSH tunnel sessions, sending model requests through Unity Gateway using SSH credentials.
items.why: Lets developers run coding agents using their existing SSH session credentials.
items.title: Run Claude Code and Codex in the SSH tunnel

items.headline: Genie Agents gain access-aware answers and faster benchmarks
items.summary: Genie Agents now answer from accessible sources only, add custom claim monitoring, and run benchmarks in parallel.
items.why: Users no longer blocked by partial access; faster evaluations and clearer monitoring.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: Genie One gains traces, faster responses and file uploads
items.summary: Genie One adds unified trace table export in Beta, faster responses, larger visualisations and Markdown or text uploads.
items.why: Better observability for Genie One, plus quicker answers and easier file-based questions.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: AI Function tasks for jobs
items.summary: Jobs can now run AI Functions on volume files or table rows without SQL, processing only new or changed inputs.
items.why: Lets teams automate AI document processing in jobs without writing SQL or reprocessing unchanged data.
items.title: AI Function tasks for jobs (Beta)

items.headline: Scope modifiers for personal access tokens and OAuth
items.summary: Scope modifiers narrow API tokens and OAuth grants to specific operations, such as read-only access.
items.why: Limits what leaked or misused tokens can do, reducing security risk.
items.title: Scope modifiers for personal access tokens and OAuth are generally available

items.headline: Create Lakeflow Designer parameters while configuring fields
items.summary: Users can now create a parameter from a supported operator field and use it straight away.
items.why: Speeds up pipeline configuration by letting teams reuse values without leaving the field.
items.title: Create Lakeflow Designer parameters while configuring fields (Public Preview)

items.headline: Moonshot AI Kimi K3.1 Pro now on Unity Gateway
items.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro model is available on Unity Gateway for coding, knowledge work and agentic tool use, with vision and reasoning.
items.why: New model option for coding and agents, pay-per-token in us-east-1 only.
items.title: Moonshot AI Kimi K3.1 Pro is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Publish Unity Gateway skills from GitHub with an Action
items.summary: A GitHub Action now publishes Git-managed skills to Unity Catalog, mapping folders to skills and updating on merges.
items.why: Lets teams version-control skills and ship updates automatically from their repositories.
items.title: Publish Unity Gateway Skills with a GitHub Action in Beta

items.headline: Declare UNIQUE constraints on Databricks tables
items.summary: Databricks lets teams declare multiple nullable or composite uniqueness constraints beyond a single primary key, referenced by foreign keys.
items.why: Clarifies data relationships and helps the query optimiser.
items.title: Declare and optimize with UNIQUE constraints on Databricks

items.headline: Claude Platform adds OpenTelemetry observability in MLflow
items.summary: Claude traces can now be sent natively to Databricks MLflow using OpenTelemetry, for debugging agents and evaluating changes.
items.why: Helps teams spot recurring agent issues and test changes against real cases.
items.title: Claude Platform now supports native OpenTelemetry observability in Databricks MLflow

items.headline: Lakehouse//RT adds fine-grained access control for reads
items.summary: Read queries now work on tables protected by row filters, column masks and ABAC policies in Lakehouse//RT.
items.why: Lets teams query sensitive real-time data while keeping existing row and column protections.
items.title: Lakehouse//RT supports fine-grained access control (Beta)

items.headline: Approve Genie tool actions in Slack and Teams
items.summary: Genie apps for Slack and Microsoft Teams now prompt users to approve or deny external tool actions within the chat.
items.why: Lets teams approve Genie's external tool actions without leaving chat, keeping control in familiar channels.
items.title: Approve Genie tool actions in Slack and Microsoft Teams (Public Preview)

items.headline: Control Lakebase upserts with merge strategies
items.summary: Streaming writes to Lakebase can now set per-column upsert rules: keep first or last value, ignore nulls, or order.
items.why: Gives finer control over how streaming data merges into Lakebase tables.
items.title: Control Lakebase sink upserts with merge strategies

items.headline: Set checkpoints across a Lakeflow Designer file
items.summary: You can now set checkpoint options for every operator in a visual data prep file at once.
items.why: Saves time configuring checkpoints across larger visual data prep pipelines.
items.title: Set checkpoints across a Lakeflow Designer file

items.headline: Edit shared Lakeflow Designer operators using Genie Code
items.summary: Genie Code in Lakeflow Designer can now create shared custom operators or edit them via workspace YAML path.
items.why: Helps teams reuse and maintain shared pipeline logic more easily.
items.title: Edit shared Lakeflow Designer operators with Genie Code

items.headline: Trigger Lakeflow Jobs when upstream jobs finish
items.summary: Lakeflow Jobs can now start when one or more upstream jobs complete, including across workspaces sharing a Unity Catalog metastore.
items.why: Simplifies dependencies between jobs spanning multiple workspaces in one metastore.
items.title: Trigger Lakeflow Jobs when upstream jobs complete (Beta)

items.headline: Lakebase Postgres arrives on Google Cloud
items.summary: Serverless Postgres on Lakebase is now production-ready for Google Cloud customers.
items.why: Lets Google Cloud teams run production Postgres natively within Databricks, serverless.
items.title: Lakebase Postgres is now generally available on Google Cloud

items.headline: ai_decide now answers questions 33% more accurately
items.summary: ai_decide uses a new model that answers questions 33% more accurately, with existing low latency maintained.
items.why: Better AI answers from ai_decide without slower responses for teams.
items.title: ai_decide (Beta) now delivers higher answer accuracy

items.headline: Unity Catalog secrets get higher limits and BROWSE
items.summary: Schemas can hold 1,000 secrets and metastores 10,000, and BROWSE on catalogs now covers secrets' metadata without exposing values.
items.why: Lets teams find secrets without seeing values, and supports larger secret estates.
items.title: Higher limits and BROWSE support for Unity Catalog secrets

items.headline: Managed warehouse for MLflow
items.summary: Lets users view Unity Catalog-stored MLflow traces without choosing a SQL warehouse; admins enable it in Previews.
items.why: Simpler trace viewing with no SQL warehouse setup needed.
items.title: Managed warehouse for MLflow (Beta)

items.headline: Zerobus Ingest now supports default storage tables
items.summary: Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect can now write to tables backed by default storage.
items.why: Offers a streaming ingestion option for Databricks-managed tables.
items.title: Zerobus Ingest into default storage is now generally available

items.headline: AI Functions spend now counts towards Unity Gateway budgets
items.summary: From 1 November 2026, Unity Gateway budgets include spend from task-specific AI Functions across batch and real-time execution.
items.why: Helps control AI Function costs alongside other Unity Gateway spend.
items.title: AI Functions usage is now included in Unity Gateway budgets

items.headline: Databricks and SAP expand end-to-end data and AI capabilities
items.summary: The new SAP Application Data Foundation eases access to SAP data across SAP Business Data Cloud and SAP Databricks.
items.why: Simplifies using SAP business data with Databricks AI, reducing integration effort for enterprise AI.
items.title: Databricks and SAP unleash end-to-end data & AI capabilities to level up enterprise AI transformation

items.headline: Relationships between metric views
items.summary: Unity Catalog metric views can now record how they join, including cardinality and join conditions, for AI and BI tools.
items.why: Helps AI assistants and BI tools pick correct join paths across metric views.
items.title: Relationships between metric views (Beta)

items.headline: Claude Code auto mode supports Anthropic and other models
items.summary: Auto mode reviews tool calls to cut routine permission prompts, now for Anthropic and non-Anthropic models on Databricks.
items.why: Fewer permission interruptions for developers building agents on Databricks-hosted models.
items.title: Claude Code auto mode for Anthropic and non-Anthropic models

items.headline: Authorise headless machines with OAuth device code flow
items.summary: Workspace admins can now let headless machines, such as remote VMs or containers, get OAuth tokens via browser sign-in on another device.
items.why: Lets engineers authenticate CLI and scripts on remote servers without a local browser.
items.title: Authorize headless machines with the OAuth device code flow (Beta)

items.headline: Monitor data freshness in Lakeflow Connect pipelines
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect database pipelines now show data freshness per CDC table, queryable in event logs with alerts.
items.why: Catch stale tables early, with alerts on ingestion lag.
items.title: Monitor data freshness in Lakeflow Connect database connector pipelines (Public Preview)

items.headline: Track Unity Gateway skill usage with audit logs
items.summary: Audit logs and a usage dashboard now show Unity Gateway Skills downloads, loads and user activity.
items.why: Gives admins visibility into who uses AI skills, supporting governance as adoption grows.
items.title: Track Unity Gateway skill usage with audit logs and the usage dashboard

items.headline: Real-time mode arrives for Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Real-time mode for Spark Declarative Pipelines is now generally available, delivering millisecond end-to-end latency for operational streaming workloads.
items.why: Lets operational streaming pipelines meet millisecond latency needs on the same platform.
items.title: Announcing General Availability of Real-Time Mode for Spark Declarative Pipelines on Databricks

items.headline: Smarter cost controls for serverless
items.summary: Databricks adds cost attribution, access controls and smarter spend limits to serverless compute.
items.why: Helps leaders track, control and cap serverless spending across teams.
items.title: Smarter cost controls for serverless

items.headline: Dashboard relationships for multi-fact data models
items.summary: Dashboard relationships let AI/BI dashboards combine multiple fact tables in one data model.
items.why: Supports richer dashboards that draw on several fact tables at once.
items.title: Dashboard relationships are now generally available

items.headline: Anomaly detection for data quality monitoring
items.summary: Schema-level anomaly detection monitors freshness and completeness of every table using historical patterns.
items.why: Catches stale or incomplete tables automatically, with results stored in a system table.
items.title: Data quality monitoring anomaly detection is now generally available

items.headline: Native XML file format support for ingestion and parsing
items.summary: Databricks can now ingest, query and parse XML files in batch and streaming via Auto Loader, read_files, COPY INTO and new SQL functions.
items.why: Simplifies XML data pipelines without custom parsing code or external tools.
items.title: Native XML file format support is now generally available

items.headline: ABAC policies now cover shared views and tables
items.summary: Attribute-based row filters and column masks can now apply to shared views, materialised views and streaming tables via OpenSharing.
items.why: Lets providers enforce fine-grained access controls on data shared with external recipients.
items.title: Apply ABAC policies to shared views, materialized views, and streaming tables

items.headline: Genie MCP connectors enabled by default for compliance workspaces
items.summary: From December 2026, Genie One and Genie Code MCP connectors turn on by default in compliance security profile workspaces.
items.why: Customers in compliance profiles should review connector access before the default changes.
items.title: Databricks-provided MCP connectors in Genie One and Genie Code will soon be enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Genie Agents gain guided setup and faster file retrieval
items.summary: Adds guided agent creation, faster file retrieval in Beta, hides content search details from viewers, and opens volume file links directly in embedded agents.
items.why: Makes agents quicker to build and files faster to surface for users.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Request for access in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Users can request privileges on Unity Catalog objects from anywhere in Databricks and track status in Catalog Explorer.
items.why: Streamlines getting access to governed data and reduces manual permission requests.
items.title: Request for access is now generally available

items.headline: Serverless GPU for clean room notebooks
items.summary: Clean room notebooks can now run on serverless GPU compute for model training and inference over shared data.
items.why: Lets teams train and run models on shared data under existing clean room controls.
items.title: Serverless GPU for clean room notebooks is now generally available

items.headline: Unpaginated Unity Catalog REST API requests will be rejected
items.summary: Unpaginated calls to list operations such as list tables will return HTTP 400 errors, so clients must paginate.
items.why: Jobs may slow or fail unless clients paginate requests and SDKs are upgraded.
items.title: Unpaginated requests to some Unity Catalog REST API operations will soon be rejected

items.headline: Multiple real-time flows and adaptive repartitioning for serverless pipelines
items.summary: Serverless pipelines on the preview channel can now run several real-time flows together, and auto-adjust Kafka and Kinesis source tasks.
items.why: Less manual tuning of partitions and shards for streaming pipelines.
items.title: Multiple real-time flows per serverless pipeline and source stage adaptive repartitioning are in Beta

items.headline: Serverless job logs delivered to Unity Catalog volumes
items.summary: Workspace admins can now deliver serverless job application logs to a Unity Catalog volume for retention and analysis.
items.why: Helps retain and analyse serverless job logs under Unity Catalog governance.
items.title: Serverless log delivery to Unity Catalog volumes (Beta)

items.headline: Genie One workspace instructions now tailored by user group
items.summary: Admins can tailor Genie One chat behaviour by group, using a recommended instruction to load group memberships.
items.why: Lets teams get Genie One answers suited to their group and access level.
items.title: User-aware workspace instructions for Genie One

items.headline: Vital Skills extend Genie Code into healthcare
items.summary: Databricks industry experts have built a Vital Skills library giving Genie Code healthcare and life sciences analytics skills.
items.why: Speeds up analytical and scientific work for healthcare and life sciences teams.
items.title: Vital Skills: Upskilling Genie Code with Healthcare and Life Sciences skills

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra arrives on Unity Gateway
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra model can now be accessed through Foundation Model APIs on Unity Gateway.
items.why: Gives teams access to a new frontier model within governed Databricks workflows.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Default OAuth apps for external AI agents
items.summary: ChatGPT, Codex, Claude and Cursor can connect to Databricks MCP servers without admins creating OAuth apps.
items.why: Lets admins skip OAuth app setup when connecting popular AI agents.
items.title: Default OAuth apps for external AI agents are now generally available

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer adds AI Function and HTML operators
items.summary: Adds ai_decide in AI Function (Beta), an HTML operator, shareable full-screen previews, and tools for organising large flows.
items.why: Makes visual data prep faster to organise, reuse and share with colleagues.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer October release

items.headline: Unity Gateway usage dashboard tracks coding agent spend
items.summary: Unity Gateway Usage Dashboard v1.0 is available, showing coding-agent adoption, harness usage and estimated session spend.
items.why: Helps leaders track AI coding agent costs and attribute spend by tag.
items.title: Unity Gateway Usage Dashboard v1.0

items.headline: Unity Catalog permissions for AI Functions
items.summary: Metastore admins can now use Unity Catalog permissions on the system.ai schema to control which AI Functions users run.
items.why: Lets admins limit which AI Functions teams can run, tightening control over AI use.
items.title: AI Functions Unity Catalog permissions is now generally available

items.headline: Edit files in Unity Catalog volumes in the workspace
items.summary: Users can now edit volume files directly in the workspace file editor, without downloading and re-uploading them.
items.why: Saves time and avoids download-upload cycles when changing files in volumes.
items.title: Editing files in Unity Catalog volumes is now generally available

items.headline: Unify productivity and AI data with Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect brings data from productivity and collaboration tools into Databricks without custom API integrations.
items.why: Makes enterprise knowledge in productivity apps usable for analytics and AI without bespoke integration work.
items.title: Unify your productivity and AI data with Lakeflow Connect

items.headline: AI Search adds streaming, materialised views and Iceberg
items.summary: AI Search now also indexes Streaming Tables, Materialized Views and Iceberg v3+ managed tables, beyond Delta tables.
items.why: Lets live data feed AI retrieval without copying into Delta tables first.
items.title: Building live intelligence: Databricks AI Search supports Streaming Tables, Materialized Views, and Managed tables using Iceberg

items.headline: Lakebase gets snapshot and backup scheduling APIs
items.summary: Lakebase users can now create, list, restore and delete point-in-time snapshots, and set automated backup schedules, via APIs.
items.why: Enables programmatic backup and point-in-time recovery for Lakebase databases, supporting production resilience.
items.title: Lakebase snapshots and backup schedule APIs are generally available

items.headline: Lakeflow Performance Observability for jobs
items.summary: Lakeflow Jobs now show job-level query performance metrics, data volumes and an Optimise button linked to Genie Code.
items.why: Helps data engineers spot and fix slow serverless job queries faster.
items.title: Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability is now generally available

items.headline: Check Unity Gateway budget usage with Spend Status API
items.summary: A new API lets you check spend against Unity Gateway budget limits, for one budget or across many.
items.why: Lets teams monitor usage against budgets programmatically, avoiding overspend surprises.
items.title: Check budget usage with the Spend Status API

items.headline: Account security features available to all accounts at release
items.summary: New account security features reach all accounts at general availability, but admins must still configure them.
items.why: Platform teams can adopt security best practices sooner, with admins keeping full control.
items.title: Account-level security features are now available by default at GA

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds QuickBooks Online connector
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect can now ingest QuickBooks Online accounting data, including invoices, payments and journal entries, incrementally.
items.why: Brings accounting data into Databricks without custom pipelines, with incremental updates.
items.title: QuickBooks connector is available in Beta

items.headline: Lakeflow performance observability on by default for compliance workspaces
items.summary: On or after 25 November 2026, eligible compliance-profile workspaces get job-level query performance metrics by default.
items.why: Gives Jobs users query performance insights and Genie Code optimisation without manual enablement.
items.title: Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Unity Gateway governs Claude and ChatGPT desktop agents
items.summary: Unity Gateway can now configure Claude and ChatGPT desktop work agents with governed models, MCP servers and skills.
items.why: Lets teams use desktop AI agents while keeping models and tools under governance.
items.title: Use Claude desktop and ChatGPT desktop work agents with Unity Gateway

items.headline: DataFrame caching arrives on serverless compute
items.summary: Users can cache DataFrames on serverless compute with df.cache() or df.persist() to reuse results within a session.
items.why: Avoids recomputing expensive results, speeding up repeated work within a session.
items.title: DataFrame caching on serverless compute is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Files API 3.0 adds large uploads for volumes
items.summary: Files API 3.0 adds multipart uploads over 5000 MiB and version-based conditional file operations for Unity Catalog volumes.
items.why: Lets teams move very large files and avoid overwriting changes in volumes.
items.title: Files API 3.0 for Unity Catalog volumes is now in Beta

items.headline: Google Analytics Aggregated connector in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now ingests aggregated Google Analytics 4 reports, with custom reports, incremental loads and service account or OAuth authentication.
items.why: Lets teams bring Google Analytics 4 marketing and engagement data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Google Analytics Aggregated connector is available in Beta

items.headline: Bulk import from Power BI and Tableau
items.summary: Genie Code can now import up to 100 Power BI or Tableau files at once as dashboards and metric views.
items.why: Speeds migration of Power BI and Tableau reports to metric views.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements

items.headline: Serverless job environments configurable from pyproject.toml
items.summary: Serverless notebook and Python script tasks can now set up their environment using a pyproject.toml file.
items.why: Simplifies dependency management for serverless jobs using standard Python project files.
items.title: Serverless job environments from pyproject.toml (Beta)

items.headline: Shared Serverless compute for bundle projects
items.summary: Notebooks and files in the same bundle can now share serverless compute and an environment defined in pyproject.toml.
items.why: Simplifies sharing compute and environment setup across bundle projects.
items.title: Shared Serverless (Beta)

items.headline: Microsoft Entra ID connector for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now ingests Microsoft Entra ID users, groups, roles and sign-in logs.
items.why: Brings identity and access data into Databricks without custom pipelines for security and governance analysis.
items.title: Microsoft Entra ID connector is available in Beta

items.headline: Genie One enhancements adds outlines and skill uploads
items.summary: Genie One adds conversation outline navigation, skill uploads, external dbt query snippets in Genie Ontology, and mobile sign-in email memory.
items.why: Helps teams navigate long Genie chats and capture dbt query activity.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: AI Runtime brings GPU infrastructure into Databricks
items.summary: AI Runtime, offering high-performance GPU infrastructure inside Databricks, is now generally available.
items.why: Lets teams run GPU-intensive AI workloads without leaving their Databricks environment.
items.title: AI Runtime is Generally Available

items.headline: Unity Gateway now screens MCP tool calls for jailbreaks
items.summary: Unity Gateway can now check MCP tool calls and results for jailbreak and prompt injection attempts, on input, output or both.
items.why: Guards AI agents against manipulation when they call external tools.
items.title: Screen MCP tool calls and results for jailbreaks (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Code tasks now run in Lakeflow Jobs
items.summary: Jobs can now run Genie Code prompts autonomously, reading upstream outputs and calling tools, returning a link to the chat.
items.why: Lets agent-style AI work run within production jobs, with traceable results.
items.title: Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs are now generally available

items.headline: Lakeflow pipeline system tables for monitoring
items.summary: The pipelines and pipeline_update_timeline system tables now record pipeline and update activity across your account.
items.why: Gives a reliable, queryable audit trail of pipeline runs for monitoring.
items.title: Lakeflow pipelines system tables are now generally available (GA)

items.headline: Agent memory stores facts, preferences and workflows
items.summary: Databricks adds agent memory that stores key facts, preferences and workflows, improving agent quality while cutting costs and latency.
items.why: Better agent quality with lower costs and faster responses.
items.title: Introducing Agent Memory on Databricks

items.headline: ai_enrich can ground rows with external MCP search
items.summary: ai_enrich can now ground each row using search tools on external MCP servers registered in Unity Gateway, such as You.com or Exa.
items.why: Keeps AI-enriched data anchored to current external sources, not just model knowledge.
items.title: ai_enrich can ground rows with external MCP search providers (Beta)

items.headline: CustomerLake, an agentic customer data platform, reaches early customers
items.summary: Databricks CustomerLake, an agentic CDP, is in Beta, with early customers reporting conversion and cost gains.
items.why: Early results show a 10-point conversion lift and potential 40% CDP cost savings.
items.title: CustomerLake enters Beta: Leading enterprises going live with the Agentic CDP

items.headline: Per-user row filtering with OAuth custom identity claims
items.summary: Custom identity claims can now be added to service principal OAuth tokens to filter rows in dynamic views and ABAC policies.
items.why: Lets one service principal serve many end users, each seeing only their own data.
items.title: Filter data per end user with OAuth custom identity claims

items.headline: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash now available on Unity Gateway
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017) is now available on Unity Gateway, accepting text and image inputs, and via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Adds another model option for multimodal AI apps, accessible through Foundation Model APIs.
items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017) is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Lakebase Insights moves to per-project settings
items.summary: Lakebase Insights now configures per project in Settings, with on-demand runs. Old observability schedules have stopped.
items.why: Old scheduled runs stopped, so each project needs its own schedule.
items.title: Lakebase Insights moves to per-project settings, with on-demand runs (Beta)

items.headline: Databricks SQL 2026.43 adds schema search path control
items.summary: Adds a SET PATH statement and current_path function to set the schemas searched for unqualified names; path persists in views and functions.
items.why: Gives predictable table resolution in queries, views and functions, reducing ambiguous reference errors.
items.title: Databricks SQL version 2026.43 is now available in Preview

items.headline: Asynchronous processing for transformWithState in Python
items.summary: Python row-based transformWithState API now supports asynchronous processing, running state operations and user logic concurrently for higher throughput.
items.why: Boosts throughput for stateful streaming pipelines with only minor code changes.
items.title: Asynchronous processing with transformWithState is now generally available

items.headline: Multi-statement transactions reach Lakehouse warehousing
items.summary: Multi-statement transactions now work on Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg tables, supporting governed, performant warehouse workloads.
items.why: Lets teams run warehouse-grade, multi-table work on the Lakehouse with governance.
items.title: Transactions are Generally Available, advancing warehousing on the Lakehouse

items.headline: File upload arrives in Genie One and Genie Agents
items.summary: Workspace admins no longer need a preview to enable file upload in Genie One and Genie Agents, letting users analyse uploaded files alongside data.
items.why: Lets teams question their own files in plain language alongside governed data.
items.title: File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents is now generally available

items.headline: Delegate Genie budget access to users and groups
items.summary: Genie budgets now support access control lists, letting admins grant Budget Manager or Viewer roles to users, groups or service principals.
items.why: Lets teams manage Genie spending without giving every admin full budget control.
items.title: Delegate access to Genie budgets

items.headline: READ METADATA privilege now supports all compliance standards
items.summary: The READ METADATA privilege now covers all Databricks compliance security profile standards and is on by default for compliant workspaces.
items.why: Keeps metadata access controls aligned with compliance requirements for regulated workloads.
items.title: READ METADATA privilege support for compliance security profile standards

items.headline: Stripe Data Pipeline syncs real-time data to Lakebase
