items.summary: Stripe Data Pipeline now syncs live payment and subscription data into Lakebase Postgres, with no APIs or webhooks needed.
items.why: Lets app teams power logic with live Stripe data without building custom integrations.
items.title: Stripe Data Pipeline now syncs real-time Stripe data to Lakebase Postgres

items.headline: Geospatial queries up to 38x faster on Lakehouse//RT
items.summary: Lakehouse//RT now supports spatial SQL and spatial joins, running up to 38x faster than traditional warehouses.
items.why: Enables low-latency location analytics at scale for real-time workloads.
items.title: Geospatial queries are up to 38X faster with Lakehouse//RT

items.headline: Replicate data in and out of Lakebase
items.summary: Lakebase now supports native Postgres logical replication, streaming changes into and out of the database.
items.why: Eases migrating existing Postgres databases and keeping external systems in sync.
items.title: Replicate data in and out of Lakebase with Postgres logical replication

items.headline: ADBC driver now default for Power BI connections
items.summary: The ADBC driver for the Databricks connector in Power BI is now generally available and is the default for new connections.
items.why: Modern default connection path for Power BI users connecting to Databricks.
items.title: ADBC driver for Power BI is now generally available

items.headline: Genie Migrate converts SQL from other warehouses to Databricks
items.summary: Genie Migrate, formerly the agentic code converter, converts SQL from T-SQL, Snowflake, Oracle and other dialects into Databricks SQL, validating and fixing output.
items.why: Speeds moving legacy SQL estates to Databricks with validated, ready-to-run queries.
items.title: Genie Migrate is generally available for SQL conversion

items.headline: Dashboard updates include Power BI import and Insights
items.summary: Dashboards gain Real-Time warehouse support, AI-generated insights, pivot drill-down and Power BI .tmdl import for metric views, plus fixes.
items.why: Lets teams reuse Power BI models as metric views and drill into pivot tables.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Consumer users can query Unity Gateway without admin approval
items.summary: Consumers with the entitlement can query shared model services and use coding agents without an account admin enabling the preview.
items.why: Model traffic may rise, so admins should set budgets and rate limits.
items.title: Consumer access to query Unity Gateway services is generally available

items.headline: Redesigned MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs
items.summary: The MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs adds search, filters, live following and downloads, replacing deprecated Artifacts log files.
items.why: Easier to search and debug AI Runtime runs; logs kept 60 days.
items.title: Redesigned MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs

items.headline: Integrated CDC pipeline for MySQL ingestion
items.summary: Databricks' integrated CDC pipeline for MySQL is now generally available, combining extraction and loading in one pipeline with no separate gateway.
items.why: Simplifies MySQL change data ingestion by removing the separate gateway component.
items.title: MySQL integrated CDC pipeline is now generally available

items.headline: Lakebase Search adds Chinese, Japanese and Korean full-text search
items.summary: The lakebase_tokenizer 0.2.0 extension now segments Chinese, Japanese and Korean text for keyword and BM25 search.
items.why: Makes search work properly for CJK content without changing existing indexes or configurations.
items.title: Lakebase Search supports Chinese, Japanese, and Korean full-text search

items.headline: Genie Agents gains Flash option and faster models
items.summary: Agent mode adds Flash, a speed-focused option in Beta, and upgraded models with better long-context handling.
items.why: Faster answers for everyday tasks, and better handling of long context.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: Data Classification adds 50 new sensitive data classes
items.summary: Data Classification now detects 50 new sensitive data types and covers 16 more countries and regions.
items.why: Broader sensitive data coverage helps meet regional compliance and protect payment and personal data.
items.title: Data Classification adds 50 new classes and support for 16 more countries and regions

items.headline: Genie One adds collaborative editing and skill sharing
items.summary: Genie One documents can now be co-edited, shared skills can be published via Unity Gateway in Beta, and past investigations are recalled faster.
items.why: Teams can edit documents together and reuse one central library of skills.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Predictive AI Functions bring forecasts and insights to dashboards
items.summary: Predictive AI Functions add forecasting, anomaly detection, top drivers and value prediction to dashboards, Genie and SQL.
items.why: Lets teams get ML predictions from familiar tools without data science skills.
items.title: Unlock powerful insights and forecasts with Predictive AI Functions

items.headline: Document Intelligence for real-time applications and agents
items.summary: Databricks Document Intelligence parses, classifies and extracts information from documents as they arrive, feeding apps and agents immediately.
items.why: Lets agents and apps act on incoming documents immediately, improving decision accuracy.
items.title: Power real-time applications and agents with Document Intelligence

items.headline: Private Network Gateway replaces many private endpoints
items.summary: Private Network Gateway offers one secure connection to an entire network, replacing many separate private endpoints.
items.why: Simplifies secure network access and cuts setup effort compared with managing many private endpoints.
items.title: Introducing Private Network Gateway

items.headline: Admins can set default package repositories for Databricks Apps
items.summary: Workspace admins can set default Python and npm package repositories for Apps, with app-level overrides allowed.
items.why: Standardises dependency sources across apps while letting teams override where needed.
items.title: Workspace-level package repositories for Databricks Apps are generally available

items.headline: Data Classification API and Terraform support
items.summary: The Data Classification API and its Terraform resource are now GA; auto-tagging configuration remains in Public Preview.
items.why: Lets teams manage data classification programmatically and as code, with auto-tagging still in preview.
items.title: Data Classification API is now generally available

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer gains operators, outputs and canvas upgrades
items.summary: Monthly roundup of Lakeflow Designer updates since its June GA, including new operators, more output options and a better canvas.
items.why: Makes building and collaborating on visual data pipelines faster and easier.
items.title: What's New in Lakeflow Designer - October 2026 Roundup

items.headline: External engines query views via Unity REST API
items.summary: External engines can now query Unity Catalog views over Delta Lake tables through the Unity REST API.
items.why: Lets external engines read governed views without duplicating data.
items.title: External access to views through the Unity REST API is generally available

items.headline: Unity Catalog managed Delta tables accept external Spark writes
items.summary: External Apache Spark clients can now create and write to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables, provided catalog commits are enabled.
items.why: Lets teams write to governed tables from any Spark engine, keeping Unity Catalog controls.
items.title: External writes to managed Delta tables are now generally available

items.headline: Clean rooms now offer one-step identity resolution providers
items.summary: Users can create a packaged clean room with an approved identity resolution provider, such as LiveRamp, in one step.
items.why: Speeds up audience matching for marketing collaboration without building custom setup.
items.title: Create clean rooms with identity resolution providers in one step (GA)

items.headline: Shared output in clean rooms
items.summary: Clean room runs can write to a shared output schema that all collaborators can read as each table is created.
items.why: Lets collaborators see results and debugging information before runs finish.
items.title: Shared output in clean rooms is now generally available

items.headline: Databricks AI Runtime SDK replaces serverless_gpu
items.summary: From GPU environment version 6, databricks-sdk-air replaces the deprecated serverless_gpu package, with renamed arguments; version 6 is the last including it.
items.why: Migrate GPU workloads now; old names work until version 7, then support ends.
items.title: Databricks AI Runtime SDK replaces serverless_gpu

items.headline: Gemini 4 Argon now available on Unity Gateway
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Argon model can now be accessed through Unity Gateway using Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Lets teams test and deploy the newest Google model under governed Databricks access.
items.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Resize streaming state partitions without losing checkpoints
items.summary: Lets you change shuffle partition counts for stateful Structured Streaming queries and Lakeflow pipelines without losing checkpoint state.
items.why: Lets teams rescale streaming jobs as data volumes change, keeping progress intact.
items.title: On-demand state repartitioning is now generally available

items.headline: Clean rooms now support JAR workloads
items.summary: Clean rooms can now run compiled Java or Scala code, either as a standalone analysis or as a UDF in notebooks.
items.why: Lets teams run existing Java or Scala logic on shared data without moving it.
items.title: JAR workloads in clean rooms are now generally available

items.headline: Governed tag propagation in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Unity Catalog can now automatically apply governed tags to derived tables and views using lineage.
items.why: Keeps classification and access controls consistent as data moves downstream.
items.title: Governed tag propagation is in Beta

items.headline: Private connectivity from serverless compute to AWS resources
items.summary: Serverless compute can now reach AWS-managed resources such as S3 buckets over private AWS Private Link connectivity.
items.why: Keeps data traffic on the AWS network, away from the public internet.
items.title: Private connectivity from serverless compute to AWS-managed resources is now generally available

items.headline: Feature Views for batch, streaming and request-time data
items.summary: Feature Views are now generally available for batch, streaming and request-time data, with compliance security profile workspaces following in mid-November 2026.
items.why: Gives ML teams production-ready feature serving across batch, streaming and real-time.
items.title: Feature Views are now generally available

items.headline: Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent now legacy
items.summary: Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent are now legacy; new code agents should use the Agent Bricks CLI, and no-code agents Genie Agents.
items.why: Signals migration to Agent Bricks CLI and Genie Agents for new builds.
items.title: Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent are now legacy

items.headline: Context-based ingress policies for inbound private connectivity
items.summary: Admins can now restrict which registered VPC endpoints reach workspaces, combining endpoint, identity and request conditions.
items.why: Tighter control over who reaches your workspaces across private networks.
items.title: Context-based ingress policies for inbound private connectivity are now generally available

items.headline: Unity Gateway Skills API and developer tools
items.summary: The Unity Gateway Skills REST API supports create, read, update, list, delete and finalise across CLI and SDKs.
items.why: Lets developers manage skills programmatically from their preferred Databricks tools.
items.title: Unity Gateway Skills API and developer tools are available in Beta

items.headline: Parameters for Lakeflow pipelines
items.summary: Lakeflow pipeline SQL can now use key-value parameters, so one pipeline can target different catalogs, schemas or tables.
items.why: Reuse one pipeline across environments without editing source code.
items.title: Parameters for Lakeflow pipelines are now generally available

items.headline: Genie One can now run code safely
items.summary: Genie One can now run code in a secure sandbox for analyses beyond SQL, under existing permissions.
items.why: Enables advanced analyses while Unity Catalog governance and access controls still apply.
items.title: Code execution in Genie One (Beta)

items.headline: Unity Gateway adds Amazon Bedrock Mantle support
items.summary: Unity Gateway now routes requests to Amazon Bedrock Mantle models, with Unity Catalog permissions, rate limits, budgets and inference tables.
items.why: Lets teams use Bedrock models under existing governance, budgets and cost controls.
items.title: Unity Gateway supports Amazon Bedrock Mantle

items.headline: Request tags in Unity Gateway service policies
items.summary: Custom Unity Gateway service policies can now check caller-supplied request tags, such as requiring a tag before model or MCP tool calls proceed.
items.why: Lets teams enforce tagging rules on AI model and tool calls.
items.title: Use request tags in Unity Gateway service policies (Beta)

items.headline: OpenJev evaluator for LLM-as-a-judge service policies
items.summary: You can now choose OpenJev, a fast classifier model, as the evaluator for custom LLM-as-a-judge service policies.
items.why: Faster policy checks than chat evaluators, since it classifies without generating output tokens.
items.title: Use OpenJev as the evaluator for LLM-as-a-judge service policies (Beta)

items.headline: Consumer access extends to Lakeflow Designer
items.summary: Consumer access now covers Lakeflow Designer, letting users read and write workspace resources they can already access.
items.why: Lets Genie One and Lakeflow Designer run richer analyses, but access controls stay unchanged.
items.title: Consumer access to workspace resources (Beta)

items.headline: Query Workday HR and finance data in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Workday Data Connect federation lets teams query HR and finance data in place, governed through Unity Catalog.
items.why: Joins Workday HR and finance data with enterprise data without copying it.
items.title: Announcing Workday Data Connect federation in Unity Catalog

items.headline: Lakebase database branching for coding agents
items.summary: Explains how Lakebase database branching gives coding agents isolated databases for parallel development, testing and CI/CD.
items.why: Lets teams test and ship agent-built changes against safe, isolated database copies.
items.title: Lakebase and Agentic SDLC: Branching Databases for Coding Agents

items.headline: Load terabytes into Lakebase Postgres in minutes
items.summary: Offloads heavy bulk loads from Lakebase Postgres primary compute to distributed engines like Spark.
items.why: Faster large data loads without slowing down the transactional database.
items.title: Load terabytes of data in minutes into Lakebase Postgres

items.headline: Build governed enterprise apps with Replit and Lakebase
items.summary: Replit Agent can build governed apps on live Databricks data and deploy them to Databricks Apps with Lakebase.
items.why: Lets teams build and deploy governed apps from one platform, with Lakebase built in.
items.title: How to build governed enterprise apps on Databricks with Replit and Lakebase

items.headline: Genie Agents gain external tool connections and auto search
items.summary: Genie Agents can now search Google Drive and Microsoft 365 via MCP connectors, with automatic volume content search and sync.
items.why: Lets agents draw on external tools and volumes without manual index upkeep.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Discover page and domains for finding assets
items.summary: Discover offers curated browsing across Databricks, and domains group assets by business area.
items.why: Helps users find governed assets fast and organises them by business area.
items.title: The Discover page and domains are now GA

items.headline: Azure DevOps connector for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now ingests Azure DevOps projects, repositories, work items, builds, releases and identity data.
items.why: Simplifies pulling DevOps delivery data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Azure DevOps connector is available in Beta

items.headline: Dashboards gain faceted counters and legend cross-filtering
items.summary: Counters can now show one tile per dimension value, and legend selections trigger cross-filtering across dashboard visuals.
items.why: Lets you compare categories at a glance and filter visuals more intuitively.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Permission-aware Databricks Apps with on-behalf-of-user authorization
items.summary: Apps can now act for the signed-in user, so actions respect that user's permissions, alongside app-owned authorization.
items.why: Lets apps enforce each user's own data permissions, reducing the risk of over-privileged access.
items.title: Now GA: Building permission-aware Databricks Apps with on-behalf-of-user authorization

items.headline: Dataset materialization for AI/BI dashboards
items.summary: Dashboard datasets can be pre-computed and stored on a schedule, so published dashboards load and respond faster.
items.why: Faster dashboards without rerunning expensive queries on every load.
items.title: Dataset materialization for AI/BI dashboards is now in Beta

items.headline: Enforce partner guardrails on Unity Gateway traffic
items.summary: Unity Gateway can now send traffic to a third-party guardrail vendor, blocking calls it denies, without app changes.
items.why: Adds vendor guardrails to AI traffic without changing your applications.
items.title: Enforce partner guardrails with external service policies (Beta)

items.headline: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash adds priority and reserved throughput
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash can now run on priority pay-per-token or reserved provisioned throughput.
items.why: Lets teams choose latency-optimised or dedicated capacity for this model.
items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash supports priority pay-per-token and reserved provisioned throughput

items.headline: Claude Haiku 5.5 added to Unity Gateway
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 model can now be accessed through Foundation Model APIs on Unity Gateway.
items.why: Adds another Claude option for teams already building AI on Databricks.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Fox picks Databricks as strategic data and AI partner
items.summary: Fox Corporation names Databricks its data and AI platform in a multi-year partnership, using Lakebase and Genie for AI agents.
items.why: Shows a major media group standardising on Databricks for sports and streaming AI agents.
items.title: Fox Corporation Selects Databricks as Strategic Partner for Next-Generation Data and AI Platform

items.headline: Meta's ads MCP server arrives in Databricks Marketplace
items.summary: Meta's ads MCP server is available in Databricks Marketplace, linking enterprise data and models to agentic advertising workflows.
items.why: Lets marketers use customer data directly in agent-driven ad campaign workflows.
items.title: Meta’s ads MCP server comes to Databricks: Put your customer intelligence to work in advertising campaigns

items.headline: Genie Code CLI is a terminal coding agent
items.summary: Genie Code CLI is a terminal coding agent that uses local files and the Databricks CLI to build pipelines, models and apps.
items.why: Lets teams build data and AI assets from the terminal under governance.
items.title: Genie Code CLI is in Beta

items.headline: Genie shows visualizations in Microsoft Teams replies
items.summary: Genie chart responses now appear as images in Microsoft Teams replies.
items.why: Lets Teams users see charts from Genie without leaving the conversation.
items.title: Genie visualizations in Microsoft Teams replies (Public Preview)

items.headline: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW keeps grants, comments and tags
items.summary: From 2 December 2026, CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW updates views in place, keeping grants, tags and comments.
items.why: Saves re-granting permissions, but tagged columns must be untagged before dropping.
items.title: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW will soon preserve grants, comments and tags by default

items.headline: NEAREST BY join scales vector search in Runtime
items.summary: Databricks Runtime adds a NEAREST BY SQL join for batch vector search, using Photon kernels and an IVF index on Liquid Clustered tables.
items.why: Lets teams run batch similarity search directly in SQL pipelines.
items.title: NEAREST BY Join: Scaling Vector Search in Databricks Runtime

items.headline: Data portability with REGISTER and UNREGISTER APIs
items.summary: New REGISTER and UNREGISTER APIs transfer a table's catalog management without copying the underlying data.
items.why: Reduces catalog lock-in and lets teams move tables without duplicating data.
items.title: Unlocking Data Portability: Preventing Catalog Lock-in with REGISTER and UNREGISTER APIs

items.headline: Genie Ontology powers Databricks product development
items.summary: Databricks explains how Genie Ontology combines human-curated business semantics with learned knowledge across first- and third-party sources.
items.why: Shows how business semantics and AI knowledge can be combined for understanding data.
items.title: How Genie Ontology powers product development at Databricks

items.headline: Share and govern Genie One skills with Unity Gateway
items.summary: Users can publish Genie One skills to their team, with access controlled by standard Unity Catalog privileges.
items.why: Lets teams reuse governed Genie skills using permissions they already manage.
items.title: Share and govern Genie One skills with Unity Gateway (Beta)

items.headline: Multiple triggers for Lakeflow Jobs
items.summary: Lakeflow Jobs can now use up to five triggers, combining types, repeating types, and pausing each independently.
items.why: Lets teams orchestrate jobs more flexibly, with independent control over each trigger.
items.title: Use multiple triggers for Lakeflow Jobs (Beta)

items.headline: Lakeflow pipelines can run as account groups
items.summary: Pipelines can now run as an account group, not just a user or service principal.
items.why: Lets teams own automated pipelines without tying them to one person's account.
items.title: Run Lakeflow pipelines as a group

items.headline: Agent Bricks docs now focus on code-first agents
items.summary: Agent Bricks documentation now centres on building and running custom agents in code, with new runtime and server pages.
items.why: Clarifies how to build, deploy and query custom agents; legacy options now mapped to replacements.
items.title: Agent Bricks documentation for code-first agent development

items.headline: Custom trace views in MLflow trace explorer
items.summary: Users can describe a trace view in plain language and Genie generates a reusable layout showing key fields, metrics and feedback controls.
items.why: Speeds up review workflows by surfacing the trace details that matter most.
items.title: Custom trace views in the MLflow trace explorer are now generally available

items.headline: Save reusable Databricks query templates in Google Sheets
items.summary: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets can now save imports as templates your team runs in one step, using each user's Unity Catalog permissions.
items.why: Speeds up recurring data pulls into Sheets while respecting each user's governed access.
items.title: Save reusable query templates in Google Sheets

items.headline: ai_parse_document now extracts chart data
items.summary: ai_parse_document now returns richer figure descriptions, including structured JSON of chart series and legend labels.
items.why: Lets teams pull chart values from documents into structured data without manual entry.
items.title: ai_parse_document now extracts chart data

items.headline: Customer-managed keys for query history
items.summary: Customers can now use their own key to decrypt statement text and error messages in the query history system table.
items.why: Gives regulated customers control over encryption of sensitive query history data.
items.title: Customer-managed keys for query history are now generally available

items.headline: Standard ai_extract now faster and more accurate
items.summary: The default ai_extract mode uses a new model checkpoint that runs 2.3x faster with better quality at no extra cost.
items.why: Better extraction results at no extra cost, with faster processing.
items.title: Standard ai_extract now delivers higher-quality extraction

items.headline: JDBC Unity Catalog connections with SSL support
items.summary: JDBC Unity Catalog connections now support SSL certificates on serverless compute, Runtime 19 and SQL warehouses 2025.40 and above.
items.why: Gives teams a supported, encrypted route to external databases via JDBC.
items.title: JDBC Unity Catalog connections are now generally available

items.headline: OpenJev (Qwen3.5 4B) now available on Unity Gateway
items.summary: OpenJev, a 4B Qwen3.5 model, is now a pay-per-token service on Unity Gateway, with yes/no, choice and scoring question answers.
items.why: Gives a small, pay-per-token model for structured yes/no and scoring tasks.
items.title: OpenJev (Qwen3.5 4B) is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Genie One reshapes work for finance teams
items.summary: Databricks outlines Genie One, an AI coworker grounded in business context for finance professionals.
items.why: Shows finance teams how an AI assistant can speed up decisions using business context.
items.title: How Genie One reshapes work for finance teams

items.headline: Lakebase Postgres branch-based restores for near-instant recovery
items.summary: Lakebase Postgres uses branch-based recovery to restore databases in near-instant time, even at 100 TB scale.
items.why: Dramatically reduces downtime when databases need recovering after failures or errors.
items.title: Lakebase Postgres branch-based restores for fast recovery at scale

items.headline: IP functions bring fast network analytics to the Lakehouse
items.summary: New IP address functions let teams run high-performance network analytics directly in the Lakehouse.
items.why: Lets network and security teams analyse IP data without moving it out of Databricks.
items.title: IP Functions are Generally Available, bringing high-performance network analytics to the Lakehouse

items.headline: Cross-engine ABAC access controls for external engines
items.summary: External engines can read Unity Catalog managed tables with ABAC policies, row filters and column masks enforced by serverless compute.
items.why: Lets governed policies follow data into other engines, with serverless compute costs applying.
items.title: Cross-engine attribute-based access controls (ABAC) is now generally available

items.headline: Schedule automatic data refresh in Excel Add-in
items.summary: Users can now schedule automatic refreshes of Databricks data in Excel, choosing an interval or calendar and a SQL warehouse.
items.why: Keeps Excel reports current without manual refreshes, and lets you review recent runs.
items.title: Schedule automatic data refresh in the Databricks Excel Add-in (Public Preview)

items.headline: Numeric window measures now available in metric views
items.summary: Numeric window measures are now generally available in the low-code metric view UI, and dashboards can materialise SQL datasets in beta.
items.why: Makes semantic metrics easier to build in the no-code UI.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Managed GitLab connector arrives in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now ingests GitLab repository, project, group, CI/CD and security data via a managed, incremental connector.
items.why: Brings GitLab engineering and security data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: GitLab connector is available in Beta

items.headline: Genie One adds streaming, chat downloads and sample questions
items.summary: Genie One now streams answers as they generate, lets you download chats, and shows personalised sample questions on the homepage.
items.why: Answers appear sooner, and users get quicker starting points for their questions.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Workspace admins must enable Excel and Google Sheets writeback
items.summary: Excel and Google Sheets writeback now requires a workspace admin to turn on the Allow spreadsheet writeback setting.
items.why: Gives admins control over who can write data back from spreadsheets.
items.title: Control spreadsheet writeback with a workspace admin setting

items.headline: Table update triggers now cover OpenSharing and system tables
items.summary: Jobs table update triggers can now monitor OpenSharing objects and system tables, which is now generally available.
items.why: Lets workflows start automatically when shared or system tables change.
items.title: Table update triggers on OpenSharing objects and system tables are now generally available

items.headline: Query tags for SQL warehouses for cost tracking
items.summary: Custom key-value tags can now be applied to SQL workloads on SQL warehouses and Lakehouse RT compute, appearing in query history.
items.why: Lets teams group, filter and attribute SQL costs more precisely.
items.title: Query tags for SQL warehouses are now generally available

items.headline: Databricks Apps gains horizontal scaling
items.summary: Apps can now run across multiple instances behind one URL, with zero-downtime deployments and best-effort session affinity.
items.why: Higher availability and concurrency for apps without downtime during deployments.
items.title: Horizontal scaling for Databricks Apps is now generally available

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol on Unity Gateway
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol model can now be accessed through Foundation Model APIs on Unity Gateway.
items.why: Lets teams use the new model within governed Databricks workflows, under their own compliance terms.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Genie One memory retains your preferences and conventions
items.summary: Genie One can now keep facts you provide, like preferences and reporting conventions, for use in later chats.
items.why: Users stop repeating context, and memories stay private to each user.
items.title: Genie One memory is now generally available

items.headline: Agent Bricks CLI for building and deploying agents
items.summary: A command-line tool to scaffold, run locally and deploy custom code agents to the Databricks agent runtime.
items.why: Speeds up building agents with memory, tracing and deployment in one command.
items.title: Agent Bricks CLI is in Beta

items.headline: ai_parse_document now detects signatures and predicts layouts better
items.summary: ai_parse_document now detects signature regions and identifies document layouts more accurately.
items.why: Makes document parsing more accurate for signed and structured business documents.
items.title: ai_parse_document quality improvements: signature detection and layout prediction

items.headline: ABAC policies now extend to views
items.summary: Attribute-based access control row filters and column masks now apply to views as well as tables.
items.why: Lets you protect sensitive data exposed through views with existing ABAC policies.
items.title: ABAC on views is in Beta

items.headline: xAI Grok 4.7 added to Unity Gateway
items.summary: xAI Grok 4.7 can now be called through Unity Gateway using pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams access to another frontier model under governed, pay-per-token billing.
items.title: xAI Grok 4.7 is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds Microsoft 365 Unified Audit Logs
items.summary: Databricks Lakeflow Connect now ingests Microsoft 365 unified audit events incrementally, using OAuth machine-to-machine authentication.
items.why: Simplifies security and compliance monitoring of Microsoft 365 activity in Databricks.
items.title: Microsoft 365 Unified Audit Logs connector is available in Beta

items.headline: Lakebase Search adds configurable text tokenizer for keyword search
items.summary: A new lakebase_tokenizer extension lets you control how Lakebase Search splits text into searchable terms, including stopwords, synonyms and stemming.
items.why: Makes keyword search match how your users and data actually read.
items.title: Lakebase Search adds a configurable text tokenizer for keyword search

items.headline: AI Gateway usage tracking adds session and token details
items.summary: The AI Gateway usage system table now records coding-agent session metadata and token cache details.
items.why: Gives finer visibility into AI spend and coding-agent usage for cost control.
items.title: Usage tracking adds session metadata and token details (Public Preview)

items.headline: Genie One MCP server lets any agent query data
items.summary: Genie is now a Databricks-hosted MCP service in Unity Gateway, letting any agent query data under Unity Catalog permissions.
items.why: Old Beta endpoint sunsets 31 October 2026, so workloads must move to the new service.
items.title: The Genie One MCP server is now generally available

items.headline: Genie Code builds document processing pipelines
items.summary: Genie Code can now orchestrate parsing, classification, extraction and validation into end-to-end document pipelines, iterating on extraction quality.
items.why: Turns unstructured documents into validated data without custom pipeline engineering.
items.title: Genie Code can now build intelligent document processing pipelines

items.headline: Tags for dashboards, notebooks, apps and Genie Agents
items.summary: Dashboards, notebooks, Databricks apps and Genie Agents can now carry governed and ungoverned key-value tags.
items.why: Helps organise and find workspace assets, with governed tagging for compliance.
items.title: Tags for dashboards, notebooks, Databricks apps, and Genie Agents are now generally available

items.headline: Share metric views through OpenSharing
items.summary: You can add metric views to a share and query them with MEASURE on serverless compute.
items.why: Lets recipients use governed business metrics directly, without rebuilding definitions in their own tools.
items.title: Sharing metric views with OpenSharing is now generally available

items.headline: New dashboard controls and metric view LOD expressions
items.summary: Adds column pinning, search and natural-language filtering to results tables, include-style LOD expressions for metric views, and per-widget filter exclusion.
items.why: Gives finer metric view calculations and cleaner dashboards, with fewer bugs.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie Agents gain column picker and page citations
items.summary: Genie Agents can now show chosen monitoring columns, and cite specific pages when answering from volume files.
items.why: Easier monitoring and more precise source checks for agent answers on files.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: ai_search can now search Lakebase synced tables
items.summary: ai_search can now retrieve from Lakebase synced tables alongside AI Search indexes, and combine with vector_search sources.
items.why: Brings Lakebase operational data into AI search for agents and retrieval workflows.
items.title: ai_search can search Lakebase synced tables (Beta)

items.headline: Genie service principal usage now billed at standard rates
items.summary: Genie usage by service principals is now billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates, with no free monthly allowance.
items.why: Automated Genie workloads lose the free allowance, so costs may rise and need budgeting.
items.title: Service principal Genie usage is billed at standard pricing

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer September release adds guardrails and joins
items.summary: Adds guardrails, multi-input joins, parameter controls, external database connections and more visual prep options.
items.why: Makes visual data prep faster and more flexible for analytics teams.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer September Release

items.headline: Genie One gains pinned chats and larger uploads
items.summary: Genie One adds chat pinning, 10 MB+ file uploads, automatic tool approval and mobile MCP writes (Beta).
items.why: Less manual approval and easier file sharing for everyday Genie One work.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Databricks acquires Row Zero for Genie spreadsheets
items.summary: Databricks is acquiring Row Zero to bring governed, live spreadsheets natively into Genie.
items.why: Finance and operations teams get governed spreadsheet analysis on the same business context.
items.title: Databricks Acquires Row Zero, Bringing Live, Governed Spreadsheets to Genie

items.headline: Unity Catalog Python UDFs expand to scalar and batch
items.summary: Scalar and batch Python UDFs now run on all supported compute, with named handlers, no five-call limit, and custom dependencies.
items.why: Lets data teams run richer Python logic in governed SQL queries, with fewer limits.
items.title: Scalar and Batch Unity Catalog Python UDFs are now generally available

items.headline: Genie App Builder makes governed apps without code
items.summary: Genie App Builder creates governed data and AI apps from natural-language prompts inside an App Space, scaling to zero when idle.
items.why: Lets teams build governed apps without coding, with idle apps scaling to zero.
items.title: Build governed data and AI apps without code (Beta)

items.headline: Lakebase telemetry now queryable in system tables
items.summary: Lakebase writes Postgres observability telemetry into system.lakebase tables automatically, with 7-day retention, queryable like any Unity Catalog table.
items.why: Lets Postgres teams diagnose performance and schema issues using standard SQL queries.
items.title: Lakebase observability telemetry in system tables (Beta)

items.headline: Time travel queries now enforce ABAC policies
items.summary: Time travel queries on qualifying Unity Catalog managed tables now apply ABAC row filters and column masks, from Runtime 19.
items.why: Keeps row and column restrictions intact when querying historical data.
items.title: Time travel queries now enforce ABAC policies (Beta)

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-6 Luna now available on Unity Gateway
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna model can now be accessed through Foundation Model APIs on a pay-per-token basis.
items.why: Lets teams try a new frontier model on demand, paying per token.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Luna is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Centrally configure coding agents across your organisation
items.summary: Organisations can now set models, MCP servers, skills, a default harness and Smart Routing for coding agents centrally, applied at launch or via MDM.
items.why: Lets admins govern coding agent models, tools and routing across teams.
items.title: Centrally configure coding agents

items.headline: Connect coding agents to Unity Gateway with ug CLI
items.summary: A new command-line tool connects Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents to Unity Gateway, handling authentication, approved MCP servers, skills and spend tracking.
items.why: Lets developers set up governed coding agents in one command, with visible spend.
items.title: Connect coding agents to Unity Gateway with the ug CLI

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-6 Sol added to Unity Gateway
items.summary: Customers can now call OpenAI GPT-6 Sol through Foundation Model APIs on a pay-per-token basis.
items.why: Lets teams test a new frontier model under governed, pay-as-you-go access.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Sol is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Variant shredding enabled by default on new tables
items.summary: From 18 November 2026, new tables with Variant columns get shredding automatically on Runtime 17.3 or above.
items.why: Runtime 15.4 clusters cannot access shredded tables; upgrade to 16.4 beforehand.
items.title: Variant shredding will soon be enabled by default on new Variant tables

items.headline: Lakebase backup schedules now manageable through API
items.summary: Lakebase users can now set and read automated backup schedules and retention periods programmatically via a new API.
items.why: Lets teams automate backup policy changes across environments without manual console work.
items.title: Lakebase backup schedule API (Beta)

items.headline: Claude Opus 5.5 now available on Unity Gateway
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 model can now be accessed via Foundation Model APIs on Unity Gateway.
items.why: Lets teams use a new Anthropic model without building new integrations.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Unity Gateway tracing now covers coding agent activity
items.summary: Unity Gateway unified tracing now captures coding-agent activity, including tools and skills, alongside model requests, via its CLI.
items.why: Gives one view of agent actions and model calls, helping debug and govern coding agents.
items.title: Unified tracing now includes coding agent activity

items.headline: Invite OpenSharing recipients by email
items.summary: Recipients can now receive a secure activation link by email to connect to shared data, replacing sharing identifiers or credential files.
items.why: Simpler onboarding for external partners, without exchanging credential files or identifiers.
items.title: Invite OpenSharing recipients by email (Beta)

items.headline: Back model provider credentials with Unity Catalog secrets
items.summary: Model provider service API keys can now be stored as customer-owned Unity Catalog secrets, read at query time.
items.why: Rotate provider keys centrally in Unity Catalog without changing services.
items.title: Back model provider service credentials with a Unity Catalog secret

items.headline: Databricks Runtime 19 adds new SQL functions
items.summary: Runtime 19 adds truncate and trim_array functions, enables auto-optimised shuffle v2 by default, and changes OAuth claim handling.
items.why: Default shuffle change may affect performance; check the OAuth row filter behaviour.
items.title: Databricks Runtime 19: September 21, 2026

items.headline: Query history system table for account-wide visibility
items.summary: Account-wide records of queries on SQL warehouses and serverless compute, covering status, duration and source.
items.why: Lets teams monitor query performance and usage across the account with a supported table.
items.title: The query history system table is now generally available

items.headline: Unity Gateway supports negotiated provider discounts for spend estimates
items.summary: Admins can now set a price multiplier on model provider services so external model spend estimates reflect negotiated rates.
items.why: Makes external model cost estimates match your negotiated contract prices.
items.title: Configure provider discounts for external model spend

items.headline: Lakebase Search adds vector and keyword search
items.summary: Lakebase Search brings vector and keyword search into Lakebase Postgres databases via two extensions, enabling hybrid search in one database.
items.why: Run semantic and exact-term search in one database without a separate search stack.
items.title: Lakebase Search is generally available

items.headline: Databricks Apps telemetry persisted to Unity Catalog
items.summary: Telemetry for Databricks Apps now captures traces, logs and metrics into Unity Catalog tables via OpenTelemetry.
items.why: Gives visibility into app health and usage, with custom instrumentation via OpenTelemetry SDK.
items.title: Databricks Apps telemetry is now generally available

items.headline: Metastore-level ABAC policies apply across all catalogs
items.summary: Unity Catalog ABAC policies, including row filters, column masks, GRANT and DENY, can now attach at metastore level.
items.why: One policy governs every catalog, including future ones, cutting duplicate policy work.
items.title: Metastore-level ABAC policies are in Beta

items.headline: Convert SQL datasets to local metric views
items.summary: Datasets can now be converted to local metric views from the menu, with Genie Code doing the work, alongside dashboard improvements.
items.why: Turns one-off SQL datasets into reusable metrics that keep dashboard numbers consistent.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Finer level of detail measures in metric views
items.summary: Metric views now support finer level of detail measures, computing aggregates at a finer grain before reaggregating to the query grain.
items.why: Lets semantic models answer detailed questions with consistent totals; requires Databricks Runtime 19 or above.
items.title: Finer level of detail measures in metric views are generally available

items.headline: Base environments now supported on classic compute
items.summary: Base environments can now manage Python dependencies on classic compute, using Databricks-provided or custom workspace environments.
items.why: Lets teams standardise Python dependencies across classic compute clusters.
items.title: Base environments are now supported on classic compute (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Agents adds larger PDFs and source limits
items.summary: Genie Agents now accept 100-page PDFs, summarise six months of activity, use only attached sources, and fix a usage summary bug.
items.why: Bigger uploads and tighter source control make agents easier to trust.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Unity Gateway now supports all compliance security profile standards
items.summary: Unity Gateway supports every compliance standard Databricks offers, and is enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile.
items.why: Regulated customers can apply gateway controls across all required compliance standards without extra configuration.
items.title: Unity Gateway support for compliance security profile standards

items.headline: Genie One skills now support multiple files and folders
items.summary: Genie One skills can now include multiple files and sub-folders, up to three folders deep and 50 items, text only.
items.why: Lets teams package richer context into reusable Genie One skills.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Managed agent memory and sessions for AI agents
items.summary: Databricks adds two managed, Lakebase-backed stores so agents keep long-term memory and conversation history.
items.why: Agents can remember users and conversations across sessions without custom state infrastructure.
items.title: Managed agent memory and sessions are in Beta

items.headline: Unity Gateway API and developer tools now supported
items.summary: The Unity Gateway API for managing model services, provider services and MCP services is now generally available across Terraform, CLI and SDKs.
items.why: Lets teams automate model, provider and MCP service setup through infrastructure-as-code and SDKs.
items.title: Unity Gateway API and developer tools are generally available

items.headline: Unused OAuth client secrets are deleted after 90 days
items.summary: Databricks now automatically deletes service principal OAuth client secrets unused for 90 days, matching access token cleanup.
items.why: Automations relying on deleted secrets will fail until replacements are created.
items.title: Unused OAuth client secrets are automatically deleted after 90 days

items.headline: Account-only users can access Genie One
items.summary: Genie One now lets account users access account-level Genie One without workspace assignment or consumer access.
items.why: Simplifies Genie One rollout, with Unity Catalog still controlling what each user sees.
items.title: Account-only user access to Genie One (Beta)

items.headline: ABAC column masks extend to ARRAY and MAP columns
items.summary: A single VARIANT function can now mask ARRAY and MAP columns, not just STRUCT and other types.
items.why: Simplifies masking of complex columns with one function, requiring Runtime 19 or above.
items.title: VARIANT cast extends to ARRAY and MAP columns in ABAC column masks

items.headline: Databricks to invest over US$350 million in Singapore
items.summary: Databricks commits over US$350 million to Singapore, expanding its workforce past 500 and quadrupling its headquarters.
items.why: Signals sustained local investment in Lakebase, Genie and Unity Gateway for Asia-Pacific customers.
items.title: Databricks to Invest More Than US$350 Million in Singapore as Enterprise AI Adoption Accelerates

items.headline: Databricks Apps deploy automatically on repository changes
items.summary: Apps will redeploy automatically when changes are pushed to a connected GitHub or Azure DevOps repository.
items.why: Keeps deployed apps in sync with source code without manual redeployment.
items.title: Webhook-triggered deployments for Databricks Apps will soon be generally available

items.headline: Data Classification now scans Unity Catalog views
items.summary: Data Classification can now detect sensitive columns in Unity Catalog views as well as tables, using the same engine.
items.why: Sensitive data exposed through views can now be found and classified, not just tables.
items.title: Data Classification now scans Unity Catalog views (Beta)

items.headline: Manage Lakebase snapshots programmatically via API
items.summary: Point-in-time snapshots of Lakebase branches can now be created, listed, retrieved, deleted and restored through an API.
items.why: Lets teams automate backup and restore of Lakebase project branches.
items.title: Lakebase snapshots API (Beta)

items.headline: OpenSharing now shares foreign Delta tables
items.summary: Providers can now share and read Delta-format tables federated from OneLake, Hive metastore or AWS Glue without copying data.
items.why: Avoids copying data, so sharing foreign tables needs less storage and effort.
items.title: Sharing foreign Delta tables with OpenSharing is now generally available

items.headline: Databricks partners with EDB and IMDA on Singapore AI
items.summary: Databricks is partnering with EDB and IMDA to support Singapore's National AI Strategy through workforce training, startup acceleration and enterprise adoption.
items.why: Signals local AI skills and government backing for Databricks customers and partners in Singapore.
items.title: Databricks Partners with EDB and IMDA to Support Singapore’s National AI Strategy

items.headline: Metric views add window measures on numeric index columns
items.summary: Window measures in metric views can now use a consecutive integer column for ordering, supporting fiscal weeks and 4-4-5 periods.
items.why: Enables accurate rolling and offset comparisons for non-calendar reporting periods like fiscal weeks.
items.title: Window measures on a numeric index column in metric views

items.headline: Genie charts now appear in Slack replies
items.summary: Genie responses with charts now show the visualisation as an image in Slack replies; reinstall the Slack app to enable.
items.why: Lets Slack users see charts from Genie answers without leaving the conversation.
items.title: Genie visualizations in Slack replies (Public Preview)

items.headline: JAR tasks on serverless compute for compliance workspaces
items.summary: From early October 2026, JAR tasks will run on serverless compute automatically for workspaces with the compliance security profile.
items.why: Lets Java and Scala teams run Spark jobs without managing clusters.
items.title: JAR tasks on serverless compute will soon be available for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Share foreign schemas and tables with OpenSharing
items.summary: Providers can share tables federated from external sources via Lakehouse Federation, without copying data into Databricks.
items.why: Share external data without copies, though materialised data adds compute and storage costs.
items.title: Sharing foreign schemas and tables with OpenSharing is now generally available

items.headline: Sharing foreign Iceberg tables with OpenSharing
items.summary: Providers can now share Iceberg tables federated via Lakehouse Federation, including with external Iceberg clients.
items.why: Lets partners read shared Iceberg data from external engines without copying it.
items.title: Sharing foreign Iceberg tables with OpenSharing is now generally available

items.headline: Session restore for serverless jobs
items.summary: Serverless job runs can now restore Python variables and Spark sessions into a new interactive notebook.
items.why: Debug failures and explore results without rerunning the entire job.
items.title: Session restore for serverless jobs is in Public Preview

items.headline: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Unity Gateway
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now available on Unity Gateway, accepting text and image inputs, via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Adds a text and image capable model option for AI application builders.
items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Managed tables in Lakeflow pipelines
items.summary: Pipelines can now create managed tables written by one or more append flows, plus checkpoint import for Structured Streaming migration.
items.why: Lets teams move streaming workloads into pipelines without reprocessing source data.
items.title: Managed tables in Lakeflow pipelines (Beta)

items.headline: Genie One and Genie Code get MCP connectors
items.summary: Genie One and Genie Code can now use Databricks-provided MCP connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Microsoft 365, Slack and GitHub.
items.why: Agents can search and act across company tools, governed by Unity Catalog with per-user authentication.
items.title: Databricks-provided MCP connectors for Genie One and Genie Code are generally available

items.headline: Databricks Excel Add-in brings governed data into Excel
items.summary: Excel users can browse Unity Catalog tables, run SQL, build pivot tables with live queries, and write data back.
items.why: Lets analysts work with governed Unity Catalog data in Excel without exporting extracts.
items.title: The Databricks Excel Add-in is now generally available

items.headline: Dashboard enhancements bring metric view reuse and Tableau imports
items.summary: Dashboards now scope filters to related charts, prefer metric views when building, export themes, and generate insights per page.
items.why: Genie Code favours governed metric views, keeping dashboards consistent with the semantic layer.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements

items.headline: Genie Agents raises data source and conversation limits
items.summary: Genie Agents now support 50 tables, views or metric views, up from 30, and 200,000 conversations, up from 10,000.
items.why: Larger limits let teams build bigger agents over more data and history.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: Maintenance windows for continuous Lakeflow pipelines
items.summary: Continuous Lakeflow pipelines can now restrict platform restarts to a chosen weekly one-hour window, set in the UI or API.
items.why: Keeps pipeline restarts out of business-critical hours, reducing disruption to downstream data freshness.
items.title: Maintenance windows for continuous pipelines

items.headline: Genie One gains skills, steering and PowerPoint uploads
items.summary: Genie One now shows Genie Code skills by default, accepts steering during responses, takes PowerPoint uploads, and suggests memories for confirmation.
items.why: Lets teams guide answers mid-response and save only the memories they approve.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Govern AWS Secrets Manager secrets in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Schemas can now link to AWS Secrets Manager, exposing secrets as read-only Unity Catalog objects governed by privileges.
items.why: Manage external secrets with the same privileges as your data assets.
items.title: External secrets in Unity Catalog (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Code adds branching and editing for chats
items.summary: Genie Code chats can now be forked into new threads, asked quick side questions with /btw, and edited to regenerate from an earlier message.
items.why: Lets users explore alternatives and revise prompts without losing their existing chat.
items.title: Genie Code adds conversation controls

items.headline: Configurable retention for system tables
items.summary: Account admins can set account-wide retention of 30 to 3,650 days for supported system tables.
items.why: Lets teams control how long audit and usage history is kept.
items.title: Configurable retention for system tables is in Beta

items.headline: time_bucket SQL function aligns timestamps to fixed-width buckets
items.summary: New time_bucket function returns the start of fixed-width intervals, aligned to a chosen origin.
items.why: Simpler bucketing for odd widths like 15 minutes or 3 months, instead of date_trunc workarounds.
items.title: time_bucket SQL function aligns timestamps to fixed-width time buckets

items.headline: ABAC DENY policies block access-management actions
items.summary: Unity Catalog now lets admins use DENY policies to block the MANAGE ACCESS CONTROL privilege, even for object owners.
items.why: Stops even object owners changing access, and overrides every grant.
items.title: ABAC DENY policies are in Beta

items.headline: See which chunks support each ai_search answer
items.summary: Setting generate_citations in ai_search shows which retrieved chunks support each generated answer.
items.why: Helps verify AI answers against source content, improving trust in search results.
items.title: See which chunks support each ai_search answer (Beta)

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect incremental Salesforce formula field ingestion
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect will soon ingest Salesforce formula fields incrementally by default instead of full snapshots.
items.why: Typically faster and cheaper than full snapshots on every pipeline run.
items.title: Incremental ingestion for Salesforce formula fields in Lakeflow Connect will soon be generally available

items.headline: Lakebase achieves PCI-DSS and HITRUST in all AWS regions
items.summary: Lakebase is now PCI-DSS and HITRUST compliant in all AWS regions, for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
items.why: Regulated customers can now run Lakebase in every AWS region where it's available.
items.title: Lakebase now supports PCI-DSS and HITRUST in all AWS regions

items.headline: Zerobus Ingest now works with default storage
items.summary: Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect can now write into tables backed by default storage, in Public Preview.
items.why: Lets teams stream data straight into managed default-storage tables for simpler ingestion.
items.title: Zerobus Ingest into default storage is now in Public Preview

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra arrives on Unity Gateway
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model can now be used via Unity Gateway, billed pay-per-token through Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives access to a new frontier model for reasoning, coding and long documents.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Share metric views with OpenSharing recipients
items.summary: Metric views can now be shared with Databricks users in other metastores or accounts through OpenSharing.
items.why: Lets partners and other teams reuse governed business metrics without copying data.
items.title: Share metric views with OpenSharing (Beta)

items.headline: Dashboard updates include cross-dataset filtering and Power BI imports
items.summary: Adds cross-dataset filtering (Public Preview), ranked table calculations for Power BI and Tableau imports, and metric view downloads using display names.
items.why: Better BI imports and metric view consistency reduce rebuild work and keep reports aligned.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie Agents adds SQL function descriptions and better models
items.summary: Genie Agents now shows SQL function descriptions when attached as tools, and chat mode uses upgraded language models.
items.why: Clearer tool context and stronger chat answers for Genie users.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: Genie One adds mobile push notifications for scheduled tasks
items.summary: The Genie mobile app can now send iOS push notifications for scheduled tasks, and embedded dashboards hide Ask Genie where unsupported.
items.why: Puts scheduled Genie results in front of teams on iOS without opening the app.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash available on Databricks
items.summary: Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash model can now be used through Model Serving and Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives customers another hosted model option, subject to their own compliance with Google's terms.
items.title: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: AI Search adds struct, map and filter-only queries
items.summary: AI Search can now index and filter struct and map columns, and run filter-only queries without vector or keyword retrieval.
items.why: Lets teams filter AI Search data by structured fields without needing search terms.
items.title: AI Search supports struct and map columns and filter-only queries

items.headline: Shared Serverless compute for Git folders
items.summary: Notebooks and files in a Git folder can now share one serverless compute and a pyproject.toml-managed environment.
items.why: Simpler, consistent environments for teams working in Git folders and bundles.
items.title: Shared Serverless is in Beta

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Unity Gateway and Foundation Model APIs now offer Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 as a Databricks-hosted model.
items.why: Lets customers use Claude Fable 5.1 for AI apps without separate vendor hosting.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Genie One and Genie Agents now use OpenAI models
items.summary: Genie One and Genie Agents can now use OpenAI models served on Databricks, when partner-powered AI features are enabled.
items.why: Gives teams access to OpenAI models within Genie, subject to the partner-powered setting.
items.title: Genie One and Genie Agents can now use models served through OpenAI on Databricks

items.headline: Genie Code can run prompts on a schedule
items.summary: Genie Code can now run a prompt on a recurring schedule, producing a continuable chat with results for unattended background work.
items.why: Automates recurring analysis so teams get results without manual prompting.
items.title: Genie Code scheduled tasks are now generally available

items.headline: Genie One can now search the web
items.summary: Genie One can now search the public web for current information, citing external sources as links.
items.why: Answers questions needing current information, with clickable sources for checking facts.
items.title: Genie One web search is in Beta

items.headline: Automatic change data feed for row-level changes
items.summary: Auto CDF computes row-level changes at query time for batch, streaming and Delta Sharing.
items.why: Simplifies pipelines needing row-level changes, but requires Runtime 19 and row tracking.
items.title: Automatic change data feed is now generally available

items.headline: Zerobus Ingest gains Apache Arrow support
items.summary: Apache Arrow support for Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available, letting users ingest data via Arrow Flight.
items.why: Offers a standard columnar option for streaming data into Databricks.
items.title: Apache Arrow support for Zerobus Ingest is now generally available

items.headline: ABAC GRANT policies extend to models and MCP services
items.summary: Attribute-based GRANT policies now dynamically grant Unity Catalog privileges to models, services and MCP services matching governed tags.
items.why: Grants access by governed tag, replacing per-object permissions for AI assets.
items.title: ABAC GRANT policies are generally available for models and services

items.headline: Pipeline events system table for Lakeflow
items.summary: A new system table records Lakeflow pipeline event logs across all pipelines and workspaces in a region.
items.why: Enables failure alerts and historical pipeline analysis from one queryable table.
items.title: Pipeline events system table is in Beta

items.headline: Restrict service principal OAuth secrets to specific API scopes
items.summary: Service principal OAuth secrets can now be limited to chosen API scopes, such as SQL or jobs, rather than all APIs.
items.why: Limits damage from a leaked secret, since tokens cannot exceed the granted scopes.
items.title: Restrict service principal OAuth secrets to specific API scopes

items.headline: ai_transcribe SQL function turns audio into text
items.summary: ai_transcribe() converts audio files into time-stamped text segments, with speaker labels if enabled, returned as VARIANT.
items.why: Brings audio transcription into SQL pipelines alongside other AI Functions, with no separate tooling.
items.title: ai_transcribe function (Beta)

items.headline: Zhipu AI GLM 5.3 hosted on Model Serving
items.summary: Databricks now hosts Zhipu AI's GLM 5.3 text model in US and Americas regions, with a one-million-token context window.
items.why: Adds a large-context reasoning and agentic model option for Foundation Model API users.
items.title: Zhipu AI GLM 5.3 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Unity Catalog Skills for governing agent skills
items.summary: Agent skills can now be published, governed and shared as Unity Catalog securables, with the same permissions, tags and audit as tables.
items.why: Lets teams control who discovers, uses and updates coding agent skills, using familiar governance.
items.title: Unity Catalog Skills (Beta)

items.headline: Unity Gateway can now cap external model spend
items.summary: Unity Gateway can now track and cap spend on external providers such as Amazon Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry.
items.why: Gives one place to control AI costs across teams and providers.
items.title: Monitor and cap external provider costs

items.headline: AI Functions REST API for document processing
items.summary: Developers can now call ai_parse_document, ai_extract and ai_classify over REST.
items.why: Lets external systems use document parsing and extraction programmatically.
items.title: AI Functions REST API is now generally available

items.headline: Genie Code as a Lakeflow Jobs task
items.summary: Genie Code prompts can now run autonomously as a Lakeflow Jobs task, reading upstream outputs and linking to conversations.
items.why: Lets agents automate multi-step data workflows inside scheduled pipelines.
items.title: Genie Code is now available as a Lakeflow Jobs task (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Agents add APIs and Unity Catalog functions
items.summary: Agent mode APIs for Genie Agents are now generally available, and agents can use scalar and table-valued Unity Catalog functions as tools.
items.why: Lets teams embed Genie agents in apps, scheduled reports and internal tools.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: Genie Code now helps with AI Runtime deep learning
items.summary: Genie Code can now write distributed training code, fix environment issues and debug GPU failures in notebooks connected to AI Runtime.
items.why: Speeds up deep learning development and troubleshooting for teams training models on GPUs.
items.title: Genie Code for AI Runtime (Public Preview)

items.headline: Share foreign Delta tables with OpenSharing
items.summary: OpenSharing can now share Delta tables registered in foreign catalogs such as OneLake, Hive metastore or AWS Glue, read-only.
items.why: Lets providers share tables from OneLake, Hive or Glue with recipients read-only.
items.title: Share foreign Delta tables with OpenSharing (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer adds Unique operator and more
items.summary: The August release adds a Unique operator for removing duplicate rows, COUNT DISTINCT in Aggregate, dynamic column selection, and canvas improvements.
items.why: Makes visual data prep faster and more flexible for engineering teams.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer August Release

items.headline: Dashboard enhancements: hidden pages, path maps and header alignment
items.summary: Authors can hide dashboard pages from publication, add path map visuals and set table header alignment.
items.why: Gives more control over published dashboard layout and presentation.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Query text masked by default in system tables
items.summary: Query text in system tables and APIs now shows as REDACTED by default; only account admins and databricks_pii_access members see it.
items.why: Protects sensitive SQL content; dedicated compute needs Runtime 15.4 LTS or above.
items.title: Query text is now masked by default in system tables and APIs

items.headline: Zhipu AI GLM 5.3 Flash joins Unity Gateway
items.summary: Zhipu AI's GLM 5.3 Flash model can now be accessed through Unity Gateway's governed API.
items.why: Gives governed access for multimodal reasoning, coding and agentic workloads without code changes.
items.title: Zhipu AI GLM 5.3 Flash is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Genie Agents gain chat mode, cancel and visualisation download
items.summary: Genie Agents now accept Chat mode prompts in Genie One, can cancel responses via API, and the visualisation download API is GA.
items.why: Lets teams use agents more flexibly and manage long-running requests programmatically.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: xAI Grok 4.6 added to Unity Gateway
items.summary: xAI's Grok 4.6 model can now be accessed through Unity Gateway's governed API, alongside other models.
items.why: Lets teams use Grok for coding and agents under existing governance and spend controls.
items.title: xAI Grok 4.6 is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Zerobus Ingest now supports streaming tables
items.summary: Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect can now write to streaming tables, working like managed Delta tables with the same limits.
items.why: Lets teams stream data into familiar tables with unchanged limits and quotas.
items.title: Zerobus Ingest into streaming tables is now generally available

items.headline: Plain text and markdown input for ai_prep_search
items.summary: The ai_prep_search function now accepts plain text and markdown strings, not just parsed document output.
items.why: Lets teams prepare existing text for RAG without a document parsing step.
items.title: ai_prep_search supports plain text and markdown input (Beta)

items.headline: Genie One desktop app arrives for macOS
items.summary: Genie One now runs as a native macOS app, letting business users chat with data, threads and Genie Agents outside a browser.
items.why: Gives business users Genie access on desktop without opening a browser tab.
items.title: The Genie One desktop app for macOS is in Beta

items.headline: ai_parse_document improves checkboxes, handwriting and figure text
items.summary: ai_parse_document now extracts checkboxes, strikethrough text, handwriting and figure text more accurately.
items.why: Better document extraction means cleaner data from forms, scans and reports.
items.title: ai_parse_document quality improvements: checkboxes, handwriting, and figure text

items.headline: LTAP Direct Writes speeds up Lakebase synced table loads
items.summary: Synced table initial loads and full refreshes now write directly to storage, bypassing compute endpoints, so large loads finish faster.
items.why: Large synced table loads finish faster without slowing down your live queries.
items.title: LTAP Direct Writes accelerates synced table loads (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Code arrives in the Lakebase project UI
items.summary: Genie Code, the agentic assistant, is now in the Lakebase project sidebar for all projects, scoped to each project.
items.why: Lets teams query, debug and build tables in Lakebase using natural language.
items.title: Genie Code is now available in the Lakebase project UI

items.headline: Private network gateway for serverless compute connectivity
items.summary: A new gateway links serverless compute to VPC, on-premises and internet resources through one managed connection.
items.why: Simplifies private connectivity and egress control for serverless workloads without per-resource setup.
items.title: Private network gateway is in Private Preview

items.headline: Unity Gateway now supports Provisioned Throughput models
items.summary: Provisioned Throughput model traffic now runs through Unity Gateway, with the same access controls, usage tracking, rate limits and guardrails.
items.why: Brings dedicated model capacity under the same governance as other AI traffic.
items.title: Unity Gateway now supports Provisioned Throughput

items.headline: Secrets in Unity Catalog becoming default for compliance workspaces
items.summary: Secrets in Unity Catalog will be on by default for compliance-profile workspaces from late September 2026.
items.why: Lets security teams govern and audit secrets with the same Unity Catalog controls.
items.title: Secrets in Unity Catalog will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE privileges in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Unity Catalog now offers INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE privileges as least-privilege alternatives to MODIFY, requiring Runtime 18.1 or above.
items.why: Lets you grant write access without schema or metadata change rights.
items.title: The INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE privileges are in Beta

items.headline: Context attributes in ABAC column masks and row filters
items.summary: Row filter and column mask policies can now check the calling OAuth application and whether a request runs on behalf of a user.
items.why: Lets agents see restricted data on users' behalf without widening access elsewhere.
items.title: Context attributes in ABAC column mask and row filter policies (Beta)

items.headline: Unified trace table monitors all AI activity
items.summary: Captures every AI Gateway request and response into one Unity Catalog table in OpenTelemetry format.
items.why: One place to monitor, debug, secure and audit AI activity.
items.title: Monitor all AI activity with the unified trace table (Beta)

items.headline: Default Python package repositories for Lakeflow pipelines and compute
items.summary: Workspace admins can now set private or authenticated Python package registries as the default for Lakeflow pipelines and classic compute.
items.why: Lets admins standardise private package sources for pipelines and classic compute workloads.
items.title: Default Python package repositories are GA for Lakeflow pipelines and classic compute

items.headline: Write data back to Databricks from Google Sheets
items.summary: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets can now write sheet data to Unity Catalog tables, creating or overwriting tables.
items.why: Lets analysts push spreadsheet edits straight into governed Unity Catalog tables.
items.title: Write data back to Databricks from Google Sheets

items.headline: Import Power BI and Tableau reports via Genie Code
items.summary: Importing Power BI and Tableau reports and data models with Genie Code is now generally available.
items.why: Brings existing BI reports into Databricks without rebuilding them.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie One gains PDF export and mobile upgrades
items.summary: Genie One adds PDF export, consistent scheduled task outputs, and mobile workspace switching and IP-list sign-in.
items.why: Lets teams export documents and work on mobile more easily.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Role-based access control (RBAC) for sensitive data
items.summary: Users can now assume a role so only that role's permissions apply, not their accumulated access.
items.why: Enforces exclusive access, stopping data mixing across projects, clients and clinical trials.
items.title: Role-based access control (RBAC) is generally available

items.headline: ai_extract precision mode for complex document extraction
items.summary: Precision mode for ai_extract now supports multi-page documents, 50-plus field schemas and complex conditional logic.
items.why: Enables larger, more complex document extraction workloads in production.
items.title: ai_extract precision mode is now generally available

items.headline: Choose effort level in Genie Code
items.summary: Genie Code users can now set effort level, trading response quality against cost; Auto is default.
items.why: Lets teams control AI assistant costs, choosing faster lower-cost model for simpler tasks.
items.title: Choose an effort level in Genie Code

items.headline: Role-based access control (RBAC) becomes default for compliance workspaces
items.summary: From mid-September 2026, RBAC is on by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile, so users must assume roles to access sensitive data.
items.why: Compliance teams should prepare users to assume roles before the change lands.
items.title: Role-based access control (RBAC) will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: User authorization for Databricks Apps in compliance workspaces
items.summary: Automatically enabled in late September 2026 for workspaces using the compliance security profile, letting apps act with users' own permissions.
items.why: Apps will use each user's permissions; review compliance workspaces before late September.
items.title: User authorization for Databricks Apps will soon be available for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Manage Python project environments with %uv commands
items.summary: Serverless notebooks on environment version 5 or above can now create Python projects, add dependencies and sync environments using %uv commands.
items.why: Gives reproducible Python environments for serverless notebook work without leaving notebooks.
items.title: Manage project environments with %uv commands

items.headline: Session restore for serverless jobs
items.summary: Serverless job runs can now restore variables and Spark sessions into a new notebook for debugging, without rerunning.
items.why: Debug failed or cancelled serverless jobs without a full rerun.
items.title: Session restore for serverless jobs is now in Beta
