items.headline: Share managed Iceberg tables with Delta Sharing
items.summary: Providers can share managed Iceberg tables via Databricks-to-Databricks and open sharing, plus external Iceberg clients.
items.why: Lets teams share Iceberg tables across Databricks and external Iceberg clients.
items.title: Sharing managed Iceberg tables is now generally available

items.headline: Lakebase Postgres APIs for programmatic management
items.summary: Lakebase Postgres can now be managed programmatically through the REST API, Databricks CLI and SDKs for Python, Java and Go.
items.why: Lets teams automate Lakebase provisioning, branching and credentials in their own pipelines.
items.title: Lakebase Postgres APIs are now generally available

items.headline: DeepSeek V4 Pro joins Unity Gateway models
items.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) can now be accessed through Unity Gateway's governed API, alongside other models.
items.why: Lets teams use a reasoning model with central permissions, guardrails and spend controls.
items.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Genie Code now supports file uploads
items.summary: Users can upload files to Genie Code to use as context in the current chat.
items.why: Gives Genie Code your own documents as context for more relevant answers.
items.title: Genie Code supports file uploads

items.headline: Share data behind a firewall with SecureConnect
items.summary: OpenSharing SecureConnect is generally available, letting providers share data behind firewalls without allowlisting recipient networks.
items.why: Simplifies secure sharing with firewalled sources, but adds networking charges to watch.
items.title: Share data behind a firewall with SecureConnect is generally available

items.headline: Cross-workspace access controls serverless traffic between workspaces
items.summary: Account admins can set which workspaces reach a workspace (ingress) and where serverless workloads can send traffic (egress).
items.why: Tightens network isolation between workspaces, limiting risky lateral movement by serverless workloads.
items.title: Cross-workspace access for serverless (Beta)

items.headline: Smart Routing cuts AI costs by choosing models
items.summary: Smart Routing automatically picks the right model and agent harness for each task, with every decision auditable.
items.why: Routine work shifts to cheaper models, cutting task costs by over 30% in benchmarks.
items.title: Smart Routing: Cut AI costs by routing each task to the right model

items.headline: Identity attributes for column-masking policies
items.summary: Account users can now carry nine identity provider attributes, such as title and department, for use in ABAC column masking.
items.why: Lets governance teams apply masking rules using HR data synced from identity providers.
items.title: Identity attributes (Beta)

items.headline: Sensitive data detection guardrail blocks or masks data
items.summary: Unity Gateway now detects sensitive data like SSNs and card numbers, then blocks or masks them.
items.why: Stops personal and financial data leaking through AI requests and responses, deterministically and quickly.
items.title: Block or redact sensitive data in requests and responses

items.headline: OpenSharing SecureConnect networking billing expands
items.summary: Databricks plans new networking charges for SecureConnect, some billed to recipients, beyond today's provider-paid data transfer.
items.why: Shared data costs may rise, and recipients may pay for private connectivity.
items.title: Expanded networking billing for OpenSharing SecureConnect

items.headline: Sharing tables backed by default storage
items.summary: Providers can now share default storage tables with any recipient, including classic compute users.
items.why: Simplifies sharing managed tables with open and Databricks recipients, rolling out by default.
items.title: Sharing tables backed by default storage is now generally available

items.headline: Genie Agents adds content search and simpler file analysis
items.summary: Genie Agents can now optionally index attached volumes for content search, analyse files without Unity Gateway, and send prompts with uploads.
items.why: Improves answer accuracy across larger volumes and simplifies file analysis for agent users.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Gemini 3.7 Flash joins Unity Gateway models
items.summary: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash model is now offered through Unity Gateway's governed API, switchable without code changes.
items.why: Gives a fast, cost-efficient model option with governance, guardrails and spend controls built in.
items.title: Google Gemini 3.7 Flash is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Tags page arrives in Governance Hub
items.summary: Governance Hub now has a Tags page showing tag usage, recent assignments and fix recommendations.
items.why: Gives a central view of tag quality and gaps across the account.
items.title: Tags page in Governance Hub (Beta)

items.headline: Genie One adds file uploads and MCP writes
items.summary: Genie One adds image and Word uploads, MCP writes in Beta, PDF attachments for scheduled tasks, and GA workspace instructions.
items.why: Lets teams share more file types, automate MCP actions and receive PDF reports.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Databricks raises $5B and scales Lakebase, Genie
items.summary: Databricks closed $5 billion in strategic funding at a $190 billion valuation, led by Coatue, and passed a $7 billion revenue run-rate.
items.why: Signals strong growth and investor confidence in Databricks' platform roadmap, including Lakebase and Genie.
items.title: Databricks Grows >80% YoY, Surpasses $7B Revenue Run-Rate, Scales Lakebase, Genie, and Unity AI Gateway

items.headline: Define business concepts with Pages
items.summary: Pages lets teams give business terms, acronyms and KPIs one governed definition within Unity Catalog semantics.
items.why: Gives Genie a human-modelled layer, so AI answers use agreed business definitions.
items.title: Define business concepts with Pages (Beta)

items.headline: Custom MLflow trace views built with Genie
items.summary: Describe a layout in plain language and Genie builds a reusable custom trace view in MLflow's trace explorer.
items.why: Helps teams review GenAI traces faster with views tailored to their workflow.
items.title: Custom trace views in the MLflow trace explorer are in Beta

items.headline: Google Search Console connector for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now ingests Google Search Console search data, site metadata and sitemaps, with incremental loading.
items.why: Brings website search performance data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Google Search Console connector is available in Beta

items.headline: ABAC GRANT policies now cover Unity Gateway resources
items.summary: ABAC GRANT policies can now grant access to model, MCP and agent services by tag.
items.why: Lets you grant gateway access by tag rather than resource by resource.
items.title: ABAC GRANT policies now cover Unity Gateway resource types (Beta)

items.headline: Databricks SQL 2026.32 adds upserts and variant validation
items.summary: Adds is_valid_variant for checking VARIANT data, INSERT REPLACE for upsert-style writes, and scalar UDFs as table-function arguments.
items.why: Simplifies upserts and validates semi-structured data before downstream processing.
items.title: Databricks SQL version 2026.32 is now available in Preview

items.headline: REPLACE USING flows now available for streaming tables
items.summary: Standalone streaming tables can now replace all rows matching key columns on each update, ordered by a sequence column.
items.why: Handles partial snapshot sources without CDC feeds or primary keys, and tolerates out-of-order updates.
items.title: REPLACE USING flows for standalone streaming tables (Beta)

items.headline: Read metadata privilege for Unity Catalog
items.summary: Unity Catalog adds a READ METADATA privilege giving read-only visibility into grants, row filters, column masks and ABAC policies.
items.why: Gives auditors and governance teams safe visibility into access controls and security settings.
items.title: READ METADATA privilege is GA

items.headline: DeepSeek V4 Flash now available on Unity Gateway
items.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) is now available through Unity Gateway's governed API, with permissions, guardrails, spend controls and observability.
items.why: Lets teams switch models without code changes, under central governance and cost controls.
items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Alert system tables for auditing and monitoring
items.summary: New system.alert schema records every alert's configuration and each evaluation, for auditing and trend analysis.
items.why: Lets teams audit alert definitions and monitor alert workloads at scale.
items.title: Alert system tables are in Public Preview

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds managed Notion connector
items.summary: The managed Notion connector in Lakeflow Connect now ingests pages, databases, blocks, comments and users.
items.why: Lets teams bring Notion content and user data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Notion connector (Beta)

items.headline: Run continuous Lakeflow pipelines with continuous jobs
items.summary: Continuous jobs can now orchestrate continuous Lakeflow pipelines, with the job setting execution mode and unlocking job-level features.
items.why: Gives continuous pipelines job-level features like serverless performance mode and alerts.
items.title: Orchestrate continuous pipelines with continuous jobs

items.headline: Lakebase now meets PCI-DSS and HITRUST compliance
items.summary: PCI-DSS and HITRUST compliance now applies to Lakebase workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled; on AWS, only us-east-1 is covered.
items.why: Eases compliance approval for regulated workloads, though AWS coverage is limited to one region.
items.title: Lakebase now supports PCI-DSS and HITRUST

items.headline: ai_search SQL function retrieves grounded answers from knowledge sources
items.summary: New SQL function searches AI Search indexes, reranks results and returns a grounded answer by default.
items.why: Enables batch retrieval-augmented generation and enriching data with context at scale.
items.title: ai_search function (Beta)

items.headline: Tag automations assign governed tags automatically in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Tag automations assign or remove governed tags on matching Unity Catalog tables or volumes, using rules you define or describe to Genie.
items.why: Keeps certifications, sensitivity tiers and required tags accurate as data changes without manual upkeep.
items.title: Tag automations (Beta)

items.headline: Change data feed on materialized views
items.summary: Materialized views can now expose a change data feed on Runtime 18 LTS or above, automatically when row tracking is enabled.
items.why: Lets you replicate materialized view changes externally and keep audit history.
items.title: Change data feed on materialized views (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Ontology now enabled by default
items.summary: Genie Ontology, a business-aware context layer, is now on by default, and Genie One adds PDF uploads in Beta.
items.why: Gives Genie business context, improving answers on your organisation's data.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Genie Code can now search the web
items.summary: Genie Code can now search the public web for current information, disabled by default and enabled from the Previews page.
items.why: Answers time-sensitive questions, but admins must switch it on during the beta.
items.title: Genie Code web search is in Beta

items.headline: Moonshot AI Kimi K3 added to Unity Gateway
items.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 model is now accessible through Unity Gateway's governed API, alongside other models.
items.why: Lets teams use Kimi K3 with existing governance, spend controls and no code changes.
items.title: Moonshot AI Kimi K3 is now available on Unity Gateway

items.headline: Databricks MCP connectors now integrated with Unity Gateway
items.summary: Databricks-managed MCP connectors for Genie One and Genie Code have moved under Unity Gateway, gaining centralised governance and access controls.
items.why: Centralised governance for agent tools, but users must reconnect their connectors.
items.title: Databricks-managed MCP connectors are now integrated with Unity Gateway (Beta)

items.headline: Manage Unity Gateway via SDKs, CLI and Terraform
items.summary: Unity Gateway endpoints, model providers and MCP servers can now be managed programmatically with full create, read, update, list and delete support.
items.why: Automates gateway setup and changes, reducing manual UI work and supporting infrastructure-as-code workflows.
items.title: Unity Gateway API: Manage resources with SDKs, the CLI, and Terraform

items.headline: JAR tasks run on serverless compute in Lakeflow Jobs
items.summary: Scala and Java JARs can now run as Lakeflow Job tasks on serverless compute, with no clusters to provision or manage.
items.why: Lets Scala and Java teams drop cluster management for their batch jobs.
items.title: JAR tasks on serverless compute are now generally available

items.headline: Genie Agents gains markdown tables and comments
items.summary: Genie Agents adds markdown tables in Agent mode APIs, comments on Genie One answers, in-iframe CSV downloads, and several fixes.
items.why: Makes agent answers easier to read, review and share across teams.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie One brings natural language queries to Google Sheets
items.summary: Users can query governed Databricks data in natural language and import results into Google Sheets as native rows and columns.
items.why: Lets spreadsheet users get governed answers without SQL or leaving Sheets.
items.title: Genie One is now available in Google Sheets

items.headline: Genie One arrives in Microsoft Excel
items.summary: Users can query governed Databricks data in natural language and import results into Excel as native rows and columns.
items.why: Brings governed data queries into a familiar spreadsheet, without leaving Excel.
items.title: Genie One is now available in Microsoft Excel

items.headline: Replace USING flows for Lakeflow pipelines
items.summary: Lakeflow pipelines now support REPLACE USING flows, which replace matching rows from partial snapshots using key columns and sequence ordering.
items.why: Simplifies ingesting partial snapshots without change data capture feeds or primary keys.
items.title: REPLACE USING flows for pipelines (Beta)

items.headline: Unity Gateway governs enterprise AI across teams
items.summary: Unity Gateway, part of Unity Catalog, is now generally available, letting teams control, route and monitor AI services and MCP servers.
items.why: Gives one place to govern AI access, costs, and lineage across providers.
items.title: Unity Gateway is now generally available

items.headline: Full-page Genie Code gets a command centre view
items.summary: Genie Code's full-page view shows active chats prominently beside notebooks and files, and runs multiple chats in parallel.
items.why: Lets you run several chats in parallel while working in notebooks and files.
items.title: Full page Genie Code is now generally available

items.headline: Delta Sharing now supports Iceberg reads for Delta tables
items.summary: Delta tables shared through Delta Sharing can now be read by Iceberg clients.
items.why: Lets recipients using Iceberg engines query shared data without converting formats.
items.title: Sharing Delta tables with Iceberg reads enabled is now generally available

items.headline: Rich text for AI/BI dashboard widget titles
items.summary: Widget titles and descriptions on AI/BI dashboards now support rich text, including links, tables and markdown.
items.why: Lets teams add clearer context, links and tables directly to dashboard widgets.
items.title: Format AI/BI dashboard widget titles and descriptions with rich text

items.headline: New Google Drive connectors for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect's two Google Drive connectors are now available: managed for fully managed pipelines, standard for custom Spark and SQL pipelines.
items.why: Simplifies pulling Google Drive files into the lakehouse with either managed or custom pipelines.
items.title: Google Drive connectors are now generally available

items.headline: SharePoint connectors in Lakeflow Connect ready for production
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect's two SharePoint connectors are now available: a managed option and a standard Spark and SQL option.
items.why: Gives teams supported, production-ready ingestion from SharePoint into Databricks.
items.title: SharePoint connector (GA)

items.headline: Schema-level HTTP connections arrive in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Teams can now create HTTP connections inside a schema, inheriting its Unity Catalog privileges and auditing.
items.why: Applies the same access controls and audit trails as other data assets.
items.title: Schema-level HTTP connections in Unity Catalog are now generally available

items.headline: NetSuite connector for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: The managed NetSuite connector in Lakeflow Connect is now ready for production use, ingesting ERP and financial data into Databricks.
items.why: Lets finance and ERP data flow into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: NetSuite connector (GA)

items.headline: Delta Sharing supports deletion vectors and column mapping
items.summary: Tables with deletion vectors or column mapping enabled can now be shared through Delta Sharing.
items.why: Customers can share tables that use these common storage features.
items.title: Sharing Delta tables with deletion vectors and column mapping is now generally available

items.headline: Store and govern secrets in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Secrets can now be stored, governed and accessed as securable objects in Unity Catalog.
items.why: Applies the same access controls and auditing as other data assets.
items.title: Secrets in Unity Catalog is GA

items.headline: Serverless compute access control for admins
items.summary: Workspace admins can now govern who runs serverless notebooks, jobs and pipelines using two built-in compute objects.
items.why: Lets admins tighten serverless access while existing workloads keep running unchanged.
items.title: Serverless compute access control is now generally available

items.headline: Excel Add-in gains cascading filters and case-insensitive matching
items.summary: The Excel Add-in now supports cascading filters and case-insensitive string matching, while LIKE, NOT LIKE, IN, NOT IN and ILIKE filters were removed.
items.why: Cascading filters make Excel analysis of Databricks data faster and more precise.
items.title: Filter updates for the Databricks Excel Add-in

items.headline: Cost attribution for materialized views and streaming tables
items.summary: Materialized view and streaming table refreshes now inherit SQL warehouse custom tags, appearing in billing usage for cost attribution.
items.why: Lets teams trace refresh costs back to the SQL warehouse they came from.
items.title: Automatic cost attribution for materialized views and streaming tables in Databricks SQL

items.headline: MANAGE privilege no longer needs usage privileges
items.summary: MANAGE on a catalog or schema no longer needs USE CATALOG or USE SCHEMA on that object, so existing grants may now take effect.
items.why: Previously unused MANAGE grants may now give holders access, so audit them.
items.title: MANAGE no longer requires USE CATALOG or USE SCHEMA on the same object

items.headline: Free Genie One and Genie Agents usage extended
items.summary: Free usage of Genie One and Genie Agents now runs to 31 January 2027, excluding service principals.
items.why: Extends free access for users, so budget for service principal costs.
items.title: Genie One and Genie Agents free usage extended through January 31, 2027

items.headline: Environment variables for serverless jobs
items.summary: Serverless Lakeflow Jobs tasks can now use named job-level environment variables to pass deployment-specific configuration to application code.
items.why: Lets teams change job configuration across environments without editing application code.
items.title: Environment variables for serverless jobs are in Beta

items.headline: Organise your work with spaces in the editor
items.summary: Spaces let you group work by folder or project in the editor, keeping open tabs for quick resumption.
items.why: Helps teams switch between projects quickly without losing their place.
items.title: Organize your work with spaces

items.headline: Refresh materialized views and streaming tables under ABAC policies
items.summary: Pipelines can now refresh materialized views and streaming tables even when the pipeline owner or run-as identity is subject to ABAC policies.
items.why: Governed data stays protected during pipeline refreshes without needing blanket exemptions for owners.
items.title: Refresh materialized views and streaming tables without exempting the pipeline owner from ABAC policies

items.headline: Packaged clean rooms for private, joint data analysis
items.summary: Providers can supply notebooks, JARs and data that consumers run on their own data without seeing code or assets.
items.why: Enables privacy-preserving collaboration on shared insights without exposing either party's data.
items.title: Packaged clean rooms are now generally available

items.headline: Use Unity Gateway with your Claude subscription
items.summary: Claude Code can route through Unity Gateway using existing Claude Pro, Max, Enterprise or Team subscriptions, keeping governance intact.
items.why: Lets teams use existing Claude subscriptions at no extra model cost, with central governance.
items.title: Use Unity Gateway with your own Claude enterprise subscription

items.headline: Dashboard improvements for Power BI imports and metric views
items.summary: Dashboards gain relationships from imported Power BI and Tableau files, low-code measure filters for metric views, Genie Code undo and redo, and more.
items.why: Eases BI migrations and gives metric views more flexible measure filtering.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie Agents lets users share conversations
items.summary: Individual Genie Agent conversations can now be shared, and visualisations download on Private Link in beta.
items.why: Helps teams share Genie insights easily, and restores CSV and Excel uploads from Genie One.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Unity Gateway governs AI models, agents and tools
items.summary: Unity Gateway will govern model services, MCP servers and model providers, with spend budgets, from one control plane.
items.why: Gives one place to control AI spend, access and traffic across teams.
items.title: Upcoming general availability of Unity Gateway

items.headline: Row tracking and Checkpoint V2 reach existing tables
items.summary: Automatic upgrades are gradually enabling row tracking and Checkpoint V2 on existing Unity Catalog managed tables.
items.why: Existing tables get the features gradually, once every client supports them.
items.title: Automatic upgrades begin rolling out row tracking and Checkpoint V2 to existing tables

items.headline: Python UDTFs in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Python user-defined table functions can now be registered in Unity Catalog, governed and callable from SQL on serverless, classic and warehouses.
items.why: Lets teams govern reusable table-returning Python logic across serverless, classic and warehouse compute.
items.title: Python UDTFs in Unity Catalog are now generally available

items.headline: Unit testing for Lakeflow pipelines
items.summary: Python and SQL pipeline transformations can now be unit tested in the Lakeflow Pipelines Editor using mock data.
items.why: Catches pipeline logic errors earlier, before data reaches production tables.
items.title: Unit testing for pipelines (Beta)

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Opus 5 hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Databricks Model Serving now supports Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 as a hosted model, accessible via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams access to a frontier reasoning and vision model without separate vendor setup.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 5 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Lakebase troubleshooting with Genie and Unity Catalog telemetry
items.summary: Lakebase now flags database issues and early warnings in Insights, letting you investigate and fix them conversationally with Genie.
items.why: Spots and helps fix database problems faster, using telemetry stored in Unity Catalog.
items.title: Diagnose and fix Lakebase issues with Genie, using telemetry in Unity Catalog (Beta)

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer summer release adds new operators
items.summary: Lakeflow Designer adds Prepare, Enter Data and Select operators, richer Output and Join options, and metric view sources.
items.why: Simpler no-code pipelines, plus direct use of Unity Catalog metric views as sources.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer Summer Release

items.headline: Metric views gain materialisation for faster queries
items.summary: Materialised views now pre-compute metric view results and rewrite matching queries to run faster; requires Runtime 17.3 or above.
items.why: Speeds up metric view queries on Runtime 17.3 or above, aiding BI dashboards.
items.title: Materialization for metric views is generally available

items.headline: Git CLI commands arrive in Git folders
items.summary: Git folders now give terminal access to standard Git commands, including stash, rebase, submodules and LFS.
items.why: Lets developers use familiar Git workflows directly within Databricks, reducing context switching.
items.title: Git CLI commands in Git folders are now in Public Preview

items.headline: ai_parse_document gets faster, more accurate layout detection
items.summary: ai_parse_document now reduces latency and improves layout and bounding box detection accuracy.
items.why: Faster document parsing with more reliable layout data for extraction pipelines.
items.title: ai_parse_document quality improvements: faster, more accurate layout detection

items.headline: New system table lists all governed tags
items.summary: A new system table lists every governed tag key in your account, including customer-created and system-generated tags.
items.why: Lets you check programmatically which tags are governed, for easier policy management.
items.title: Governed tags system table is in Beta

items.headline: Genie Code can now run scheduled tasks
items.summary: Genie Code can now run a prompt on a recurring schedule, producing a continuable chat with results for unattended background analysis.
items.why: Turns recurring analysis into hands-off background work, with results ready to continue in chat.
items.title: Genie Code scheduled tasks are in Beta

items.headline: Import Power BI and Tableau reports into AI/BI dashboards
items.summary: Power BI and Tableau reports can now be imported as AI/BI dashboards using Genie Code, plus Genie Code dashboard authoring is generally available.
items.why: Moves existing Power BI and Tableau reports onto AI/BI dashboards without rebuilding.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie Agents gain PDF, API and volume file support
items.summary: Genie Agents can analyse files in Unity Catalog volumes, PDF limits rise to 15,000 characters, and agent mode APIs enter Beta.
items.why: Lets teams query documents and images stored in governed volumes alongside data.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: Databricks Runtime 19 adds Apache Spark 4.3
items.summary: Databricks Runtime 19 and its Machine Learning variant are now available, built on Apache Spark 4.3.0.
items.why: Upgrading gives customers the latest Spark version for data engineering and ML workloads.
items.title: Databricks Runtime 19 and Databricks Runtime 19 for Machine Learning are now generally available

items.headline: Databricks and Microsoft expand partnership through the 2030s
items.summary: Databricks and Microsoft extend their strategic partnership into the 2030s, deepening Azure use and native integration including Genie and Microsoft 365.
items.why: Signals deeper Azure and Microsoft 365 integration, relevant to Microsoft-centred enterprise data strategies.
items.title: Databricks and Microsoft Expand Partnership to Help Enterprises Bring Business Context to Enterprise AI

items.headline: Role-based access control (RBAC) for sensitive data
items.summary: Users can assume a role that grants only that role's permissions for a session, enforcing exclusive access to sensitive data.
items.why: Stops users mixing data across projects, clients and trials, by using only assumed-role permissions.
items.title: Role-based access control (RBAC) is in Public Preview

items.headline: Variant and shredding for semi-structured data
items.summary: Variant, a flexible type for semi-structured data, and its shredding optimisation are now generally available.
items.why: Lets you ingest streaming and API data without losing query performance.
items.title: Variant and Variant shredding are now generally available

items.headline: Governance Hub offers account-wide governance monitoring
items.summary: A new account console view showing data health, AI usage, spend and cost drivers, with recommendations.
items.why: Gives leaders one place to track governance, AI spend and data coverage.
items.title: Governance Hub is in Beta

items.headline: Multi-statement transactions for Unity Catalog Delta tables
items.summary: Group SQL statements across Unity Catalog Delta tables into atomic transactions that commit or roll back together.
items.why: Keeps multi-table writes consistent and avoids partial updates.
items.title: Transactions are now generally available

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer supports all compliance security profile standards
items.summary: Lakeflow Designer now supports all compliance security profile standards and is on by default for compliance-enabled workspaces.
items.why: Lets regulated customers use Lakeflow Designer under required compliance standards.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer support for compliance security profile standards

items.headline: Automated setup for S3 external locations
items.summary: Databricks now offers automated setup for S3 external locations, provisioning the IAM role, storage credential and external location, with approval workflows for AWS admins.
items.why: Cuts manual AWS configuration and gives admins built-in approval for access requests.
items.title: Automated setup for S3 external locations

items.headline: Email alerts for expiring service principal tokens
items.summary: Databricks now emails workspace admins when a service principal token will expire within seven days.
items.why: Gives admins early warning to renew tokens before automated jobs fail.
items.title: Email notifications for expiring service principal tokens are now generally available

items.headline: Priority pay-per-token for Foundation Model APIs
items.summary: Priority mode for pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs is generally available for partner models, with open source models in preview.
items.why: Gives latency-sensitive real-time apps more consistent availability under heavy load.
items.title: Priority pay-per-token for Foundation Model APIs

items.headline: SFTP connector arrives in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect's SFTP connector ingests files from SFTP servers incrementally, with Unity Catalog governing connections and credentials.
items.why: Lets teams pull files from SFTP servers into Databricks with built-in governance.
items.title: SFTP connector is now generally available

items.headline: Context-based ingress control for workspaces
items.summary: Workspace endpoints can now be protected with allow and deny rules combining identities, network sources and request types.
items.why: Gives tighter control over who can reach workspaces, reducing exposure to unauthorised access.
items.title: Context-based ingress control for workspaces public access is now generally available

items.headline: Google Gemini 3.6 Flash hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Model Serving now offers Google Gemini 3.6 Flash as a Databricks-hosted model via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives customers another hosted model option without managing infrastructure.
items.title: Google Gemini 3.6 Flash now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite now hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Databricks now hosts Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, accessible through Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Adds another lightweight Google model option for cost-efficient AI apps on Databricks.
items.title: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Per-warehouse statement timeouts for SQL warehouses
items.summary: You can now set a statement timeout on each SQL warehouse, so warehouses can apply different query limits.
items.why: Lets teams set different query time limits per warehouse, protecting shared workloads.
items.title: Warehouse-level statement timeouts (Beta)

items.headline: Mention Genie Code in notebook comments
items.summary: Users can mention Genie Code in notebook comments to get AI help inline in the thread.
items.why: Get AI help from Genie Code without leaving the notebook comment thread.
items.title: Mention Genie Code in notebook comments

items.headline: Databricks plans strategic funding at $188 billion valuation
items.summary: Databricks has signed a term sheet for strategic funding at a $188 billion valuation, led by Coatue.
items.why: Signals strong investor confidence and capital to fund Unity AI Gateway, Genie and Lakebase.
items.title: Databricks is Raising a Strategic Round of Funding at a $188 Billion Valuation

items.headline: Databricks Genie app arrives in Microsoft Teams
items.summary: Users can ask data questions and get Genie answers directly inside Microsoft Teams.
items.why: Lets teams query governed data in Teams without switching tools, speeding decisions.
items.title: Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Govern external model providers through Unity Gateway
items.summary: Unity Gateway now connects and governs external model providers like OpenAI, Anthropic and Bedrock, with access controls, rate limits and usage tracking.
items.why: Lets teams use any model with consistent governance, cost visibility and audit logging.
items.title: Connect and govern any external model provider

items.headline: Agentic code converter for migrating legacy SQL
items.summary: Converts legacy SQL dialects like T-SQL and Snowflake to ANSI SQL, with admins enabling it via the Previews page.
items.why: Speeds up warehouse migrations by automating SQL translation and error fixing.
items.title: Agentic code converter is in Beta

items.headline: MLflow trace storage moves into Unity Catalog
items.summary: Traces can now be stored in Unity Catalog tables in OpenTelemetry format, with unlimited storage and Unity Catalog permissions.
items.why: Gives governed, unlimited trace storage for production AI workloads, queryable with SQL.
items.title: MLflow trace storage in Unity Catalog is now generally available

items.headline: Genie One adds conversation search and memory
items.summary: Genie One can now search past conversations, remember saved preferences in beta, and @mention scheduled tasks.
items.why: Less repetition and personalised answers; saved preferences shape future conversations.
items.title: Genie One enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Scala and Java UDFs now in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Scala and Java user-defined functions can now be registered in Unity Catalog and reused across notebooks, jobs and SQL warehouses.
items.why: Reuse existing JVM logic with Unity Catalog governance and better performance than Python UDFs.
items.title: Scala and Java UDFs in Unity Catalog are now generally available

items.headline: MLflow trace storage moves to Unity Catalog
items.summary: From mid-August 2026, compliance-profile workspaces will store MLflow traces in Unity Catalog tables by default.
items.why: Gives governed, unlimited, SQL-queryable trace storage in OpenTelemetry format.
items.title: MLflow trace storage in Unity Catalog will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Genie Agents gain saving and conversation sharing
items.summary: You can now save Genie One chats as Genie Agents, and share agent conversations in Public Preview.
items.why: Lets teams turn useful chats into reusable agents and collaborate on answers.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Git folders for dashboards with version control
items.summary: Dashboards now support Git folders for version control, plus on-demand schedule runs and several fixes.
items.why: Lets teams version, review and roll back dashboard changes safely.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Lakebase now offers a service level agreement
items.summary: Lakebase now offers uptime commitments for zone-redundant high availability and single-compute endpoints.
items.why: Gives customers contractual uptime guarantees for production-critical Lakebase endpoints.
items.title: Lakebase now provides a service level agreement (SLA)

items.headline: Thinking Machine Labs Inkling model now hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Model Serving now hosts Thinking Machine Labs' Inkling, a 1 million token multimodal model for coding and agents.
items.why: Gives teams another hosted option for coding, reasoning and agentic workloads.
items.title: Thinking Machine Labs Inkling now available as a Databricks-hosted model in Public Preview

items.headline: ai_extract and ai_classify on compliance-profile workspaces
items.summary: The ai_extract and ai_classify SQL functions are now enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile.
items.why: Lets regulated teams use AI extraction and classification without enabling extra features.
items.title: ai_extract and ai_classify are now available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Genie One and Genie Agents free until January 2027
items.summary: Usage of Genie One and Genie Agents is free through 31 January 2027, with budget controls suspended during that period.
items.why: Lets teams trial Genie agents at no cost, but spending limits will not apply meanwhile.
items.title: Genie One and Genie Agents usage is free through January 31, 2027

items.headline: AI Search High QPS lets endpoints scale throughput
items.summary: Standard AI Search endpoints can now set a target QPS for high-throughput, real-time workloads; it is enabled by default.
items.why: Supports search bars, recommendations and entity matching; extra capacity costs apply only when configured.
items.title: AI Search High QPS is now generally available

items.headline: Custom URLs for your Databricks account
items.summary: Customers can now claim a branded custom URL, such as acme.databricks.com, as one entry point for all workspaces.
items.why: Gives users one branded login point across all workspaces.
items.title: Custom URLs for your Databricks account (Public Preview)

items.headline: Allowlist partner platform IPs in context-based ingress control
items.summary: Context-based ingress control can now allowlist IPs used by partner platforms such as Power BI and Tableau Cloud.
items.why: Lets BI tools reach Databricks securely while IP lists update automatically without manual upkeep.
items.title: Allowlist partner platform IPs in context-based ingress control (Beta)

items.headline: Trigger.AvailableNow support for OpenSharing streaming
items.summary: Streaming reads from OpenSharing tables now support Trigger.AvailableNow, processing all current data in batch-like runs before stopping.
items.why: Enables scheduled incremental processing of shared tables; previously one micro-batch per run.
items.title: Trigger.AvailableNow support for OpenSharing streaming (GA)

items.headline: Lakebase achieves SOC 2 Type 2 compliance
items.summary: Lakebase has achieved SOC 2 Type 2 compliance; SOC reports are available via account teams or the Compliance page.
items.why: Eases security reviews for customers running Lakebase in regulated environments.
items.title: Lakebase is now SOC 2 Type 2 compliant

items.headline: Request for Access becomes default for all workspaces
items.summary: Access requests will route to Unity Catalog object owners by email, with destinations configurable in metastore settings; legacy workspace settings will be deprecated.
items.why: Makes sure access requests reach the right data owner without manual chasing.
items.title: Request for Access will soon be enabled by default for all workspaces

items.headline: Databricks MCP services for Slack, GitHub, Google Drive
items.summary: Databricks-provided MCP services for SaaS apps such as Slack and GitHub will soon be generally available, with read and write enabled by default.
items.why: Lets agents act across SaaS tools, with admins able to switch off access.
items.title: Databricks-provided MCP Services will GA soon

items.headline: Secrets in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Secrets can now be stored and governed as Unity Catalog securable objects, using the same privileges and auditing as other data assets.
items.why: Lets teams apply the same access controls and audit trails to credentials.
items.title: Secrets in Unity Catalog (Public Preview)

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna on Databricks
items.summary: Model Serving now hosts three OpenAI GPT-5.6 models, accessible pay-per-token through Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Lets teams use the latest OpenAI models within Databricks, billed per token.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, and GPT-5.6 Luna now available as Databricks-hosted models

items.headline: Import Power BI and Tableau reports as dashboards
items.summary: Power BI and Tableau reports can now be imported as AI/BI dashboards using Genie Code, in Public Preview.
items.why: Helps teams migrate existing Power BI and Tableau reports to Databricks dashboards.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie One gains citations, version history and MCP apps
items.summary: Documents gain citations, version history and soft tabs; GitHub and third-party MCP options arrive in Beta.
items.why: Improves trust in generated documents and extends Genie One to GitHub and third-party agents.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Genie Agents, formerly Genie Spaces, get grouped SQL expressions
items.summary: Genie Spaces is renamed Genie Agents, with SQL expressions now grouped alongside example queries and consistent opening in Genie One.
items.why: Simplifies authoring and keeps definitions in one place for teams.
items.title: Genie Agents enhancements

items.headline: _object_metadata column exposes cloud storage object properties
items.summary: Adds a hidden _object_metadata column exposing MIME type, ETag, tags and custom key-value metadata for cloud storage objects.
items.why: Lets pipelines access file properties and tags directly from Databricks Runtime 18.1.
items.title: Object metadata column is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Zhipu AI GLM 5.2 hosted on Model Serving
items.summary: Model Serving now hosts Zhipu AI's GLM 5.2, a mixture-of-experts model with a 1 million token context window, accessible via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives access to a long-context model for reasoning, coding and agentic tool use.
items.title: Zhipu AI GLM 5.2 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Genie Agents moves to pay-as-you-go pricing
items.summary: From 8 July 2026 Genie Agents bills pay-as-you-go, with 150 free DBUs monthly; billing is paused from 15 July.
items.why: Budgets let admins control Genie spend; usage free until January 2027.
items.title: Genie Agents now uses pay-as-you-go pricing

items.headline: Lakeflow continuous jobs and pipelines configuration changes
items.summary: From August 2026, continuous schedules can be set on the pipeline page and wrap pipelines in continuous jobs; the built-in setting remains.
items.why: Databricks now recommends continuous jobs over the built-in continuous setting for new pipelines.
items.title: Behavior changes for continuous jobs and pipelines

items.headline: Unity Catalog permissions restrict AI Functions access
items.summary: Unity Catalog permissions can now limit which task-specific AI Functions an organisation can use, separately from foundation model access.
items.why: Gives tighter control over which generative AI functions teams can call.
items.title: Restrict access to AI Functions with Unity Catalog permissions (Public Preview)

items.headline: REPLACE WHERE flows refresh only matching rows
items.summary: Pipelines and standalone streaming tables can now replace only rows matching a predicate on each refresh.
items.why: Avoids costly reprocessing of full table history, cutting refresh time and compute spend.
items.title: REPLACE WHERE flows are now generally available

items.headline: Excel file format support now default for all workspaces
items.summary: Workspaces can now ingest, parse and query .xls, .xlsx and .xlsm files directly, with no external libraries or manual conversion.
items.why: Lets teams query Excel spreadsheets without conversion steps or extra tooling.
items.title: Excel file format support is now available by default

items.headline: Managed Iceberg materialised views for external readers
items.summary: You can now create materialised views that external Iceberg readers can query, enabled via your account team.
items.why: Extends Iceberg interoperability, so other engines can read these views.
items.title: Managed Iceberg materialized views are in Public Preview

items.headline: Budgets now cover Unity Gateway and Genie spending
items.summary: Admins can set spending thresholds, plus per-user limits and alerts for Unity Gateway and Genie requests.
items.why: Gives tighter control over AI and Genie costs across teams.
items.title: Budgets are now generally available

items.headline: Private Link for account-level resources
items.summary: Private Link now lets you connect privately to account-level resources, such as the account console, via a VPC interface endpoint.
items.why: Keeps access to the account console off the public internet for tighter network security.
items.title: Private Link for account-level resources (Beta)

items.headline: Okta automatic identity management for users and groups
items.summary: Databricks can now sync users and groups from Okta without SCIM, with Okta as the group membership source of record.
items.why: Simplifies identity administration and removes the need for SCIM provisioning setup.
items.title: Okta support for automatic identity management is now generally available

items.headline: Genie Agent mode for complex, exploratory questions
items.summary: Agent mode in Genie Agents, formerly Genie Spaces, now answers complex questions with multi-step reasoning, citations and visuals.
items.why: Lets teams explore complex data questions with traceable, visual reports.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: Import Power BI and Tableau reports as dashboards
items.summary: Authors can import Power BI and Tableau reports as AI/BI dashboards from the list page, with Genie Code reusing existing metric views.
items.why: Moves BI reports to Databricks while reusing governed Unity Catalog metric views.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds row filtering for ingestion
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect can now ingest only rows matching SQL-style conditions, during initial and incremental loads.
items.why: Cuts ingestion volume and duplication, improving performance for SaaS and query-based connectors.
items.title: Lakeflow Connect row filtering is now generally available

items.headline: Genie One adds ontology snippets and document links
items.summary: Genie One now supports ontology snippets in Public Preview, plus document edit timestamps, document links and a scheduled tasks fix.
items.why: Adds business context to Genie One answers; early access via your account team.
items.title: Genie One enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Dashboard relationships for multi-fact data models
items.summary: Lets AI/BI dashboards combine multiple fact tables into complex data models scoped to each dashboard.
items.why: Allows more complex analysis across several fact tables within a single dashboard.
items.title: Dashboard relationships (Public Preview)

items.headline: Integrated CDC pipeline for MySQL
items.summary: Ingests MySQL change data in a single pipeline, with no separate ingestion gateway required.
items.why: Simpler MySQL ingestion with no gateway to deploy or maintain.
items.title: MySQL integrated CDC pipeline is now in Beta

items.headline: Gemini image models now hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Model Serving now hosts Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and Gemini 3 Pro Image, accessible via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Lets teams generate images with Google models without managing separate vendor integrations.
items.title: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and Gemini 3 Pro Image now available as Databricks-hosted models

items.headline: Lakehouse Real-Time for low-latency SQL queries
items.summary: Lakehouse//RT is a new serverless SQL warehouse type giving sub-second reads on Unity Catalog tables for high concurrency.
items.why: Serves apps and dashboards to thousands of users with sub-second latency.
items.title: Lakehouse Real-Time (Beta)

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 available on Databricks
items.summary: Model Serving now offers Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 as a Databricks-hosted model, accessible via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives access to a near-Opus-level model at Sonnet's cost and speed, for coding and agents.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: MATCH_RECOGNIZE for row pattern recognition in Databricks SQL
items.summary: Databricks SQL and Runtime now support the SQL:2016 MATCH_RECOGNIZE clause for row pattern recognition, enabled via workspace preview settings.
items.why: Lets analysts detect sequences of events in rows using standard SQL.
items.title: MATCH_RECOGNIZE is now in Beta

items.headline: Run job subsets with upstream and downstream tasks
items.summary: Partial job runs can now include upstream, downstream or both dependent tasks using a plus modifier.
items.why: Saves time and avoids missing dependencies when rerunning part of a pipeline.
items.title: Run a subset of job tasks with their dependencies

items.headline: Govern LLMs in Unity Catalog with model services
items.summary: Databricks-hosted LLMs can now be governed as Unity Catalog model services, shared across workspaces.
items.why: Define LLM endpoints once and share them, avoiding duplicated endpoints per workspace.
items.title: Govern LLMs in Unity Catalog with model services (Beta)

items.headline: Parquet v2 for Delta Lake tables
items.summary: Parquet v2 is now generally available for Delta Lake tables on Runtime 18.1 and above, improving query speed and reducing table size.
items.why: Faster queries and smaller tables with a simple table property change.
items.title: Parquet v2 for Delta Lake tables is generally available

items.headline: SQL alert task in Lakeflow Jobs
items.summary: Lakeflow Jobs can now evaluate a Databricks SQL alert as a task, with its result available for downstream branching.
items.why: Lets workflows branch on alert results, automating responses to data quality or threshold breaches.
items.title: SQL alert task in Lakeflow Jobs is now generally available

items.headline: Databricks SQL 2026.20 adds IP functions and QUALIFY
items.summary: Adds IP address functions, NEAREST BY joins, QUALIFY clause and fixes to metric view window measures.
items.why: Simpler SQL for window filters and IP addresses; metric view results now more accurate.
items.title: Databricks SQL version 2026.20 is now available in Preview

items.headline: Metric views gain query-time parameters
items.summary: Metric views can now take parameters that bind values at query time, so one definition serves many query variants.
items.why: Replaces separate metric views per variant, cutting duplication and maintenance for semantic layer users.
items.title: Metric view parameters are now in Public Preview

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds Microsoft Dynamics 365 connector
items.summary: Databricks Lakeflow Connect's managed Dynamics 365 connector now lets you ingest CRM and ERP data via Azure Synapse Link.
items.why: Removes custom pipeline work for Dynamics CRM and ERP data in Databricks.
items.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 connector (GA)

items.headline: Classic workspaces will need customer-managed VPCs
items.summary: Databricks plans to stop creating classic workspaces with a Databricks-managed VPC; new ones will need a customer-managed VPC.
items.why: Teams creating new classic workspaces should plan networking now; serverless avoids VPC setup.
items.title: Customer-managed VPC will soon be required for classic workspaces

items.headline: ai_parse_document now extracts checkboxes, forms and tables better
items.summary: ai_parse_document extracts checkboxes, forms and complex tables more accurately than before.
items.why: Cleaner extraction from forms and tables means less manual cleanup for document workflows.
items.title: ai_parse_document quality improvements: checkboxes, forms, and complex tables

items.headline: Genie Code adds skills for authoring Genie Agents
items.summary: Genie Code now includes dedicated skills for creating, maintaining and debugging Genie Agents, formerly called Genie Spaces.
items.why: Makes it easier to build and troubleshoot Genie Agents without manual setup.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: Dashboard enhancements: dynamic annotations and new themes
items.summary: AI/BI dashboards gain data-driven annotation lines, six preset themes, and several bug fixes.
items.why: Lets authors add live thresholds and ready-made styling without custom work.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie One gains chat sharing and external app connections
items.summary: Genie One chats can be shared read-only, Gmail and Microsoft 365 apps can connect in Beta, and scheduled tasks are now daily at most.
items.why: Easier insight sharing and email connections, but scheduling now limited to daily.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Databricks connector for Power Platform
items.summary: The Databricks connector for Microsoft Power Platform is now generally available for customers.
items.why: Lets teams connect Databricks data to Power Platform apps and workflows without custom integration.
items.title: Databricks connector for Power Platform is generally available

items.headline: Managed agent memory for AI agents
items.summary: Databricks now offers managed long-term memory for AI agents, stored in Unity Catalog memory stores and governed as securables.
items.why: Lets agents remember across conversations, with governance and isolation handled by Databricks.
items.title: Managed agent memory is in Beta

items.headline: Block specific internet destinations in network policies
items.summary: Serverless workloads can now be blocked from specific internet destinations via the network policies REST API, enforced regardless of access mode.
items.why: Gives tighter control over where serverless workloads can send data, regardless of policy mode.
items.title: Block specific internet destinations in network policies (Public Preview)

items.headline: Materialized views gain data quality expectations
items.summary: Materialized views in Databricks SQL can now enforce data quality expectations, warning, dropping or failing violating records.
items.why: Catches bad records early in materialized views, before they reach downstream reports.
items.title: Standalone pipeline materialized views support expectations

items.headline: Discover page for finding governed data
items.summary: Discover is a curated browsing page that helps users find Unity Catalog data assets, dashboards and Genie Agents by business area.
items.why: Lets people find trusted data without knowing catalog hierarchies, organised by business domain.
items.title: The Discover page is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Enable access requests across your Unity Catalog metastore
items.summary: Metastore admins can now enable access requests centrally, with a default destination inherited by all objects.
items.why: Lets users request access even without a configured destination, reducing governance friction.
items.title: Enable access requests across your Unity Catalog metastore (Public Preview)

items.headline: Dashboard, metric view and Power BI enhancements
items.summary: Dashboards gain table header styling, metric view parameters and wildcards, plus Power BI and Tableau import improvements in Beta.
items.why: Metric view parameters and wildcards simplify semantic layers; Power BI migration gets easier.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements

items.headline: Lakebase adds support for Postgres 18
items.summary: Lakebase now supports Postgres 18, though Postgres 17 stays the default for new projects.
items.why: Lets new projects use the latest Postgres version; existing defaults are unchanged.
items.title: Lakebase now supports Postgres 18

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds Salesforce Marketing Cloud connector
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now offers a Beta connector to ingest Marketing Cloud campaigns, journeys, email engagement and data extensions.
items.why: Lets marketing teams bring campaign and engagement data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud managed ingestion connector (Beta)

items.headline: Incremental ingestion for Workday Reports in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect's Workday Reports connector can now ingest only changed rows using a cursor column.
items.why: Faster pipeline runs and lower costs from ingesting only changed rows.
items.title: Incremental ingestion for Workday Reports (Beta)

items.headline: Genie One users can schedule tasks without SQL entitlement
items.summary: Consumer entitlement users can now create scheduled tasks in Genie One without the SQL entitlement.
items.why: Lets more users automate recurring Genie One questions without extra SQL access.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Lakehouse Federation syncs comments to foreign tables
items.summary: Lakehouse Federation can now sync table and column comments from external sources to foreign tables.
items.why: Keeps external table documentation visible in Catalog Explorer and DESCRIBE output, without manual copying.
items.title: Comments on foreign tables (Beta)

items.headline: Omnigent wraps coding agents in one platform
items.summary: Omnigent wraps coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex in a shared platform with web UI, sessions, and policies.
items.why: Lets teams switch coding agent runtimes without rewriting tools, policies, or prompts.
items.title: Omnigent coding agent meta-harness is now in Beta

items.headline: Share Genie Agents externally using OpenSharing
items.summary: Providers can now share a Genie Agent outside their organisation via OpenSharing, creating a point-in-time snapshot recipients can mount.
items.why: Enables external collaboration with agents, using snapshots rather than live access.
items.title: Share Genie Agents externally using OpenSharing (Beta)

items.headline: Genie One: agentic coworker for every team
items.summary: Databricks launches Genie One, an agentic coworker helping business teams automate and orchestrate work using live business data.
items.why: Lets marketing, finance and sales teams automate work grounded in their own data.
items.title: Databricks Launches Genie One: All-New Agentic Coworker for Every Team

items.headline: LTAP unifies transactional and analytical data in the lake
items.summary: Databricks introduces an architecture combining OLAP and OLTP on one lake data copy, removing ETL and replicas.
items.why: Removes ETL and replica pipelines, simplifying operational and analytical workloads on one dataset.
items.title: Databricks Launches LTAP: The First Lake Transactional/Analytical Processing Architecture

items.headline: Lakehouse//RT brings real-time analytics to the lakehouse
items.summary: Databricks launches Lakehouse//RT, a real-time engine powered by Reyden offering millisecond query latency on governed Delta and Iceberg tables.
items.why: Serves fast queries to many users and agents on existing governed tables.
items.title: Databricks Launches Lakehouse//RT to Bring Real-Time Analytics Directly to the Lakehouse

items.headline: Databricks to acquire Panther, expanding its security lakehouse
items.summary: Databricks has agreed to acquire Panther, an AI SOC platform, to strengthen its security lakehouse and replace legacy SIEMs.
items.why: Adds agentic threat detection and investigation to the lakehouse, aimed at replacing legacy SIEM tools.
items.title: Databricks Agrees to Acquire Panther, Further Establishing the Security Lakehouse Category

items.headline: Databricks launches CustomerLake, an agentic customer data platform
items.summary: Databricks launches CustomerLake, a native agentic CDP unifying customer data, AI agents, identity resolution, audience building and activation.
items.why: Brings agentic marketing and personalised customer experiences into the lakehouse.
items.title: Databricks Enters the Marketing Industry with CustomerLake: Agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP)

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer for no-code data transformation
items.summary: Visual, no-code canvas for preparing and transforming data, with workflows backed by production code governed by Unity Catalog.
items.why: Lets analysts build governed transformation pipelines without writing code.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer is now generally available

items.headline: Install third-party apps from Databricks Marketplace
items.summary: Customers can now discover, install and run third-party data and AI apps within their own Unity Catalog-governed workspace.
items.why: Lets teams add partner apps while Unity Catalog governance and access approvals still apply.
items.title: Install third-party apps from Databricks Marketplace

items.headline: Lakebase Search adds vector and keyword search
items.summary: Lakebase Search adds vector, keyword and hybrid search to Postgres through two extensions, in a single database.
items.why: Run semantic and exact-term search in one database without a separate search stack.
items.title: Lakebase Search adds vector, keyword, and hybrid search to Postgres (Beta)

items.headline: Genie connects to Microsoft Copilot Cowork
items.summary: Users can now ask Genie natural-language questions about Databricks data inside Microsoft Copilot Cowork, via the Genie managed MCP server.
items.why: Lets teams query Databricks data without leaving Microsoft Copilot.
items.title: Connect Genie to Microsoft Copilot Cowork (Beta)

items.headline: Faster reads for workspace files
items.summary: Workspace files now prefetch directory metadata and contents, speeding up file-heavy tasks on serverless and Runtime 18 classic compute.
items.why: Python imports, Git operations and file searches run noticeably faster for teams.
items.title: Improved workspace files read performance

items.headline: Use OAuth to connect Databricks in Power Platform
items.summary: Databricks connections in Microsoft Power Platform can now authenticate with OAuth, as an alternative to personal access tokens.
items.why: Offers an alternative to personal access tokens for Power Platform users.
items.title: Use OAuth to authenticate Databricks connections in Power Platform

items.headline: AUTO CDC flows for streaming tables in Databricks SQL
items.summary: Streaming tables in Databricks SQL can now process CDC records automatically, handling out-of-order records as SCD type 1 or 2.
items.why: Replaces complex MERGE INTO logic for slowly changing dimensions with a built-in clause.
items.title: AUTO CDC flows for streaming tables in Databricks SQL are generally available

items.headline: Genie mobile app for iOS and Android
items.summary: Genie One is now accessible on iOS and Android, letting users ask data questions and view dashboards.
items.why: Lets leaders query data and check dashboards on the go.
items.title: Genie mobile app (Public Preview)

items.headline: ai_query: query any AI model from SQL
items.summary: The ai_query function is now generally available, letting users query any supported AI model directly from SQL or Python.
items.why: Lets teams add AI model calls to existing SQL and Python pipelines.
items.title: ai_query is now generally available

items.headline: OIDC now supported for sharing to Iceberg clients
items.summary: Iceberg REST clients such as Snowflake and OSS Spark can now read OpenSharing shares secured with OIDC federation.
items.why: Lets teams use identity federation with Iceberg clients for secure sharing access.
items.title: OIDC is now supported for sharing to Iceberg clients

items.headline: Use Universal Commits for Marketplace partner products
items.summary: Customers can now spend up to 10% of their Universal Commits on eligible third-party partner products in Databricks Marketplace.
items.why: Lets customers draw down existing commitments on partner software, stretching committed spend further.
items.title: Use Universal Commits to purchase Marketplace partner products

items.headline: Share data behind a firewall with SecureConnect
items.summary: Providers can share cloud storage data behind firewalls or private endpoints without allowlisting each recipient's network.
items.why: Avoids maintaining network allowlists for every recipient when sharing sensitive data.
items.title: Share data behind a firewall with SecureConnect (Public Preview)

items.headline: Configure recovery period for dropped Unity Catalog tables
items.summary: Dropped Unity Catalog managed tables can now have a recovery period set from 0 hours to 30 days at catalog or schema level.
items.why: Guards against accidental drops of critical data, or cuts storage costs for churning tables.
items.title: Configure the recovery period for dropped managed tables (Public Preview)

items.headline: Databricks Runtime 19 with Apache Spark 4.3
items.summary: Databricks Runtime 19 and its Machine Learning variant are now available for testing, built on Apache Spark 4.3.0.
items.why: Lets teams trial Spark 4.3 ahead of general release.
items.title: Databricks Runtime 19 and Databricks Runtime 19 for Machine Learning are in Beta

items.headline: Managed disaster recovery for secondary-region failover
items.summary: Managed DR replicates Unity Catalog metadata, managed tables and workspace assets to a secondary region, with a failover-stable URL.
items.why: Gives business continuity across regions; access is gated, so contact your account team.
items.title: Managed disaster recovery is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Mission Critical add-on adds managed disaster recovery
items.summary: Mission Critical add-on bundles managed disaster recovery with Enhanced Security and Compliance for one compute rate, enabled per workspace.
items.why: Adds managed disaster recovery and compliance controls; access is gated.
items.title: Mission Critical add-on is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Auto time-to-live for automatic row deletion
items.summary: Auto-TTL now automatically deletes rows from Unity Catalog managed Delta, Iceberg and streaming tables based on a date or timestamp column.
items.why: Replaces custom deletion jobs for retention policies on governed tables.
items.title: Auto time-to-live for automatic row deletion is generally available

items.headline: Email alerts for expiring service principal tokens
items.summary: Workspace admins now automatically receive email alerts when service principal tokens are within seven days of expiry.
items.why: Avoids unexpected outages from silently expiring automation credentials.
items.title: Email notifications for expiring service principal tokens (Beta)

items.headline: Convert partitioned tables to liquid clustering
items.summary: Existing partitioned Delta tables can now be converted to liquid clustering with minimal downtime, for external and managed tables.
items.why: Lets teams adopt liquid clustering on existing tables with minimal reader and writer downtime.
items.title: Converting a partitioned table to liquid clustering is generally available

items.headline: AI Runtime CLI for submitting GPU training jobs
items.summary: Users can submit and manage distributed training jobs on serverless GPU compute from their local machine.
items.why: Lets teams run GPU training from a terminal, without opening notebooks.
items.title: AI Runtime CLI (Beta)

items.headline: Faster inference tables for custom model serving
items.summary: Inference tables now ingest through endpoint telemetry, delivering payloads to Unity Catalog within seconds, with configurable sampling.
items.why: Near real-time logging of model requests and responses, with existing tables unaffected.
items.title: Faster inference tables for custom model serving endpoints

items.headline: Structured data extraction with ai_extract
items.summary: ai_extract now extracts structured data from text and documents using a schema you define, with citations and confidence scores.
items.why: Lets teams turn documents into validated, structured data without custom pipelines.
items.title: ai_extract is now generally available

items.headline: Genie Agent enhancements include metric view export
items.summary: Genie Agents can now save visuals to dashboards, reuse earlier visualisations, export as metric views, and deploy via bundles.
items.why: Lets teams refine metric views with Genie Code and deploy agents as code.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: ai_classify function for classifying text by custom labels
items.summary: The ai_classify function now classifies text into custom labels, with label descriptions, global instructions and multi-label support.
items.why: Lets teams sort text with their own labels, plus a no-code builder.
items.title: ai_classify is now generally available

items.headline: ABAC GRANT policies now cover models
items.summary: GRANT policies dynamically grant EXECUTE on models matching governed tags, at catalog or schema level, covering MLflow and foundation models.
items.why: Scales model access control by tags instead of per-object grants.
items.title: ABAC GRANT policies for models (Beta)

items.headline: Dashboard enhancements including Gantt charts and metric views
items.summary: Dashboards gain Gantt charts, Vega-Lite custom visualisations, table cross-filtering, and metric view low-code editor join syntax.
items.why: Adds metric view join syntax and richer charts for BI and semantic layer work.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie One gains Teams and Slack access and customisation
items.summary: Genie One can now run in Teams and Slack, with account-wide branding, email-based scheduled tasks and an MCP server fix.
items.why: Lets teams use Genie One where they already work, and tailor its look.
items.title: Genie One enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Supervisor Agent adds Unity Catalog volumes as tools
items.summary: Supervisor Agent can now use Unity Catalog volumes as tools for subagents.
items.why: Lets multi-agent systems access governed data files directly within Unity Catalog.
items.title: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent now supports Unity Catalog volumes as subagent tools

items.headline: Telemetry for custom model serving endpoints
items.summary: Custom model serving endpoints can now persist OpenTelemetry logs, traces and metrics to Unity Catalog tables.
items.why: Lets teams monitor model behaviour and performance using governed, queryable data.
items.title: Endpoint telemetry for custom model serving endpoints is generally available

items.headline: Genie Code adds OpenAI-served models
items.summary: Genie Code can now use OpenAI-served models alongside Azure OpenAI and Anthropic models, when partner-powered AI features are enabled.
items.why: Gives more model choice for AI features in Genie Code.
items.title: Genie Code now uses models served through OpenAI on Databricks

items.headline: OpenSharing, an open standard for sharing data and AI
items.summary: Databricks unveils OpenSharing, a Linux Foundation-hosted open protocol for sharing data, AI models and agent skills.
items.why: Vendor-neutral standard for securely sharing data, models and unstructured assets across platforms.
items.title: Databricks Announces OpenSharing, a New Open Standard for Sharing of Data and AI Assets Across Platforms and Organizations

items.headline: Databricks Genie app now in Microsoft Teams
items.summary: Users can ask Genie data questions directly in Microsoft Teams, via direct messages or @mentions in channels and group chats.
items.why: Lets teams get data answers without leaving Microsoft Teams, where they already work.
items.title: Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams (Beta)

items.headline: Databricks Runtime 18 released with new features
items.summary: Runtime 18 is now generally available, adding IP address SQL functions, on-demand state repartitioning and pipeline query ID control.
items.why: Brings new SQL functions and streaming controls; check lifecycle and compatibility before upgrading.
items.title: Databricks Runtime 18: June 10, 2026

items.headline: Schedule deferred policy enforcement for all-purpose compute
items.summary: Admins can now delay compute policy enforcement until all-purpose compute next restarts or terminates, and cancel schedules.
items.why: Avoids interrupting running workloads when bringing non-compliant compute into line.
items.title: Schedule deferred policy enforcement for all-purpose compute

items.headline: Lakehouse Replay tests workloads against upcoming runtimes
items.summary: Automatically replays sampled read-only serverless workloads against upcoming Databricks Runtime releases to catch regressions early.
items.why: Catches runtime regressions before production with no setup and no replay compute charges.
items.title: Lakehouse Replay (Beta)

items.headline: Genie app for Slack answers data questions
items.summary: Users can ask Genie data questions directly in Slack via direct messages or mentions, with channel owners pinning specific Genie Agents.
items.why: Lets teams get governed data answers without leaving Slack.
items.title: Databricks Genie app for Slack (Public Preview)

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Fable 5 hosted on Model Serving
items.summary: Databricks Model Serving now hosts Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, built for long-running autonomous knowledge work and coding, via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams a frontier model for autonomous, long-running coding and knowledge tasks without new infrastructure.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Fable 5 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Identity federation now on by default for new workspaces
items.summary: Identity federation is switched on by default for new workspaces, including those without a Unity Catalog metastore; existing workspaces are unaffected.
items.why: Gives new workspaces centralised identity management from day one, with no existing setup changing.
items.title: Identity federation enabled by default for all new workspaces

items.headline: Automatic identity management now supports Okta
items.summary: Automatic identity management now syncs users and groups from Okta without SCIM provisioning setup.
items.why: Removes manual SCIM setup and keeps Okta group memberships authoritative in Databricks.
items.title: Automatic identity management for Okta (Public Preview)

items.headline: Update_flow API for Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Spark Declarative Pipelines now supports update flows that write only changed rows to sinks, handling stateful aggregations without watermarks.
items.why: Simpler stateful aggregations in pipelines, without managing watermarks.
items.title: The update_flow API for Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow is generally available

items.headline: Choose entitlements when adding principals to workspaces
items.summary: New principals no longer inherit users-group entitlements; admins must grant them explicitly, enforced 14 September 2026.
items.why: Automation targeting system groups will fail; update Terraform and SCIM workflows.
items.title: Upcoming behavior change: Choose entitlements when adding principals to workspaces

items.headline: Unity Catalog external lineage covers assets outside Databricks
items.summary: Lets you register external sources and Power BI or Tableau dashboards in one lineage graph, and Lakeflow Connect records source lineage automatically.
items.why: Gives one end-to-end view of data flow, including BI dashboards outside Databricks.
items.title: External lineage is now generally available

items.headline: Inbound Private Link for performance-intensive services
items.summary: Inbound Private Link now supports performance-intensive services such as Lakebase Autoscaling and Zerobus Ingest.
items.why: Lets customers keep private network access to Lakebase and Zerobus traffic.
items.title: Inbound Private Link for performance-intensive services is now generally available

items.headline: AI Search adds column-level text filters, sorting and aggregations
items.summary: AI Search queries can now target selected text columns, sort by indexed columns, and return aggregate counts.
items.why: Lets teams refine search results and see aggregate counts directly.
items.title: AI Search supports selected text columns, sorting, and aggregations (Beta)

items.headline: ai_parse_document gains faster table and long-content parsing
items.summary: ai_parse_document now parses tables faster and handles long, repetitive content more reliably.
items.why: Faster, more reliable document extraction for pipelines that process tables.
items.title: ai_parse_document quality improvements: table efficiency and extraction reliability

items.headline: External access to pipeline streaming tables and materialized views
items.summary: External Delta and Iceberg clients can now read pipeline-managed streaming tables and materialized views through Unity Catalog, without copying data.
items.why: Lets other engines query pipeline outputs directly, avoiding duplicate copies and sync effort.
items.title: External data access for pipeline streaming tables and materialized views (Public Preview)

items.headline: Foundation model Unity Catalog permissions
