items.summary: Account admins can now use Unity Catalog permissions on system.ai to control access to Databricks-hosted foundation models.
items.why: Lets organisations govern which hosted models teams can use, across all inference workloads.
items.title: Foundation model Unity Catalog permissions is generally available

items.headline: Managed SharePoint connector adds structured file ingestion
items.summary: The managed SharePoint connector in Lakeflow Connect now ingests structured files such as CSV, JSON, Excel and Parquet, plus file metadata.
items.why: Lets teams load SharePoint spreadsheets and data files into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Managed SharePoint connector adds structured file ingestion and file metadata support (Beta)

items.headline: UNIQUE constraints for Unity Catalog Delta tables
items.summary: Databricks SQL supports informational UNIQUE constraints on Unity Catalog Delta tables, usable by foreign keys and query optimisation.
items.why: Enables join elimination and simpler queries on Photon compute; helps document data model.
items.title: UNIQUE constraint support is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Genie moves to pay-as-you-go, with budget controls
items.summary: From 8 July 2026, Genie moves to pay-as-you-go billing, with 150 free DBUs monthly per user; admins can now set budgets.
items.why: Admins can cap Genie spend per user before the July pricing change.
items.title: Set budgets for Genie usage

items.headline: Write data from Excel back to Databricks
items.summary: The Databricks Excel Add-in can now write Excel data to Unity Catalog tables, creating new tables or overwriting existing ones.
items.why: Lets analysts update governed Unity Catalog tables directly from Excel, without leaving the spreadsheet.
items.title: Write data from Microsoft Excel back to Databricks

items.headline: Genie One gains customisation, skills and ontology
items.summary: Admins can now brand Genie One per workspace, while users get personal skills and automatic business ontology mapping.
items.why: Tailors Genie One for teams and automates repeatable tasks, improving answer accuracy.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Genie Agent can now be embedded as an iframe
items.summary: Embedding a Genie Agent as an iframe is now generally available, alongside Beta prompt monitoring and delete-conversation permissions for managers.
items.why: Makes conversational analytics available inside customer-facing external applications.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: Genie Code adds auto-approve for tool actions
items.summary: Genie Code can now auto-approve tool actions like running code, with an AI classifier blocking risky ones.
items.why: Speeds up work, but keep it off for production data or shared resources.
items.title: Genie Code now supports auto-approve for tool actions

items.headline: Faster workspace file writes on classic compute
items.summary: Workspace file operations on classic compute now flush asynchronously by default on Runtime 17.1 and above, reducing latency.
items.why: Speeds up workloads writing many files, such as Git operations.
items.title: Improved workspace file write performance on classic compute

items.headline: AI/BI dashboards gain bookmarks, variables and theme controls
items.summary: Dashboards add shared filter bookmarks, dashboard variables, pivot column expand and collapse, richer theme and widget styling, and custom table headers.
items.why: Lets authors tailor dashboards and gives viewers quicker, more consistent filtering.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements

items.headline: Full page Genie Code gets its own command centre
items.summary: Genie Code now has a full-page workspace for running parallel threads, with notebooks and files as tabs.
items.why: Lets teams run several AI threads at once and personalise with skills and MCP servers.
items.title: Full page Genie Code (Beta)

items.headline: Table update triggers extend to Delta Sharing
items.summary: Lakeflow Jobs table update triggers can now monitor Delta Sharing shared tables, views and system tables, Databricks-to-Databricks only.
items.why: Lets jobs run automatically when shared or operational data changes.
items.title: Table update triggers on Delta Sharing and system tables (Beta)

items.headline: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent adds built-in web search
items.summary: Supervisor Agent can now search the public web, returning synthesised answers with source citations.
items.why: Lets teams answer questions needing current information, with citations, without leaving Agent Bricks.
items.title: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent now supports web search as a built-in tool

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds managed RabbitMQ connector
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect's managed RabbitMQ connector streams messages from classic queues into Unity Catalog streaming tables.
items.why: Lets teams bring RabbitMQ queue data into Unity Catalog without custom pipelines.
items.title: Managed RabbitMQ connector (Beta)

items.headline: Vector Search is now AI Search with full text
items.summary: Vector Search is renamed AI Search, and full text search indexes no longer need vectors or embeddings.
items.why: Enables keyword search without building embeddings, simplifying retrieval for AI applications.
items.title: Vector Search is now AI Search

items.headline: Query-based connectors for Lakeflow Connect ingest without CDC
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect's query-based connectors ingest from databases by querying directly using a cursor column.
items.why: Simpler database ingestion across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL without CDC setup.
items.title: Query-based connectors for Lakeflow Connect are now generally available

items.headline: Databricks Apps gains horizontal scaling across instances
items.summary: Apps can now run across multiple instances behind one URL, with session affinity, zero-downtime deployments and optional clean base images.
items.why: Higher availability and zero-downtime releases for customer-facing apps.
items.title: Databricks Apps horizontal scaling (Beta)

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer adds AI descriptions and richer outputs
items.summary: Operators now show AI-generated descriptions, Combine accepts any number of inputs, and previews render plots and images.
items.why: Smoother pipeline building with fewer manual steps and clearer previews for data engineers.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer updates for May 29, 2026

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8 hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Databricks Model Serving now hosts Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8, accessible via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Brings a frontier reasoning and vision model into Databricks workflows.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Unity Catalog attribute-based access controls reach external engines
items.summary: External engines can read Unity Catalog managed Delta and Iceberg tables with ABAC, row filters and column masks enforced server-side.
items.why: Keeps one set of governance rules consistent across engines reading the same tables.
items.title: Cross-engine attribute-based access controls (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Code for dashboards and new metric view expressions
items.summary: Genie Code for dashboard authoring is now available, metric views add median and percentile expressions, and tables gain banded rows and default sorting.
items.why: Speeds dashboard building and adds richer metrics for the semantic layer.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie One adds managed MCP server for agents
items.summary: Genie One now provides a managed MCP server, letting any agent ask natural-language questions of Unity Catalog data and get grounded answers.
items.why: Lets external agents query governed Unity Catalog data through one standard interface.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Genie Agent now cites definitions in its thinking traces
items.summary: Agent mode thinking traces now show the definitions applied when answering questions, such as how best selling is defined.
items.why: Shows how answers are calculated, making agent results easier to check and trust.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Refresh policies and EXPLAIN for materialized views
items.summary: Refresh policies and EXPLAIN CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW are now generally available for materialized views.
items.why: Lets teams control refresh cost and check incrementalisation before creating views.
items.title: Refresh policies and EXPLAIN CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW for materialized views are now generally available

items.headline: Real-time mode for Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Spark Declarative Pipelines gains real-time mode with latency as low as five milliseconds, plus the update_flow API.
items.why: Enables operational streaming use cases like fraud detection and personalisation.
items.title: Real-time mode in Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow, and the update_flow API are now available (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds Google Drive ingestion
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect can now ingest files from Google Drive, including unstructured and structured formats, in Beta.
items.why: Lets teams bring Drive files into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Google Drive managed ingestion connector (Beta)

items.headline: Automatic identity management with Microsoft Entra ID
items.summary: Databricks can now sync users, service principals and groups from Microsoft Entra ID without SCIM provisioning, keeping group memberships in sync.
items.why: Removes SCIM provisioning overhead and keeps Entra groups and memberships in sync automatically.
items.title: Automatic identity management with Microsoft Entra ID is now GA

items.headline: SHOW CREATE TABLE now works on metric views
items.summary: Databricks SQL 2026.15 lets SHOW CREATE TABLE return the definition of metric views, including the three-part catalog name.
items.why: Makes it easier to recreate metric views in the correct catalog location.
items.title: Databricks SQL version 2026.15 is now available in Preview

items.headline: Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines gain parameters
items.summary: Pipelines can now define key-value parameters at pipeline level and reference them in SQL code.
items.why: Lets engineers reuse and change pipeline settings without editing SQL code.
items.title: Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow parameters are now in Beta

items.headline: Genie Code agent mode defaults on in compliance workspaces
items.summary: Agent mode is now enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile and HIPAA, PCI-DSS or FedRAMP Moderate controls.
items.why: Regulated teams get multi-step automation from one prompt without manual enablement.
items.title: Genie Code Agent mode is now available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled

items.headline: Account access denylist for automatic identity management
items.summary: Account admins can now block users, groups or service principals from accessing the Databricks account on AWS and GCP.
items.why: Strengthens control over who can access accounts; denying a group also blocks its members.
items.title: Account access denylist for automatic identity management (Public Preview)

items.headline: Managed and foreign Apache Iceberg tables in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Managed Iceberg tables, foreign Iceberg tables and Iceberg v3 features are now generally available in Unity Catalog.
items.why: Lets teams run Iceberg alongside Delta with production-ready support across engines.
items.title: Unity Catalog managed Apache Iceberg tables, foreign Apache Iceberg tables, and Apache Iceberg v3 features are generally available

items.headline: Import Tableau and Power BI workbooks into dashboards
items.summary: Genie Code can turn a Tableau or Power BI file into an AI/BI dashboard replicating its visualisations.
items.why: Migrates existing Tableau and Power BI visuals without rebuilding dashboards by hand.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie Agent gains Fields and agent-mode benchmarks
items.summary: Genie Agents now use Fields instead of Dimensions, benchmarks support agent mode, and minor fixes ship.
items.why: Benchmarks can now evaluate multi-step agent reasoning, and metric views use Fields.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Databricks CLI now stores login tokens securely
items.summary: The Databricks CLI is generally available, and user login tokens are now stored in OS-native secure storage.
items.why: Gives developers a stable CLI and stronger protection for stored authentication tokens.
items.title: Databricks CLI is now GA

items.headline: Instance events and instance pools system tables
items.summary: New system tables track classic compute instance state changes and full instance pool configuration history across your account.
items.why: Gives admins audit-ready visibility into compute lifecycle and pool settings across accounts.
items.title: Instance events and instance pools system tables are now available (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakebase disables Postgres password login for new projects
items.summary: New Lakebase projects now disable native Postgres password authentication by default; existing projects are unaffected.
items.why: Tighter security for new projects; static passwords must be enabled deliberately.
items.title: Postgres password authentication is now disabled by default for new Lakebase projects

items.headline: Serve custom and fine-tuned LLMs with Custom Model Serving
items.summary: Custom Model Serving now runs custom and fine-tuned LLMs on a vLLM engine, including multimodal models.
items.why: Lets teams serve models Foundation Model APIs cannot, such as multimodal and PEFT models.
items.title: Serve custom LLMs with Custom Model Serving (Beta)

items.headline: Vector Search storage-optimised endpoints for larger vector sets
items.summary: Storage-optimised endpoints hold over a billion vectors at dimension 768 and index 10-20x faster than standard endpoints.
items.why: Supports much larger vector collections with pricing suited to scale.
items.title: Vector Search storage-optimized endpoints are GA

items.headline: Configure Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on for Power BI
items.summary: Power BI users can now sign in to Databricks through Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on, configured via an account-level federation policy.
items.why: Lets Power BI users reuse Entra ID logins, simplifying access and identity management.
items.title: Configure Microsoft Entra ID SSO for Power BI (Public Preview)

items.headline: Metric views now define LOD expressions using window functions
items.summary: Level of detail expressions are now defined in a dimension's expr field using SQL window functions, not pre-computed in the source query.
items.why: Simplifies building level of detail calculations in semantic layer metrics.
items.title: Fixed LOD expression syntax update for metric views

items.headline: Lakebase supports larger compute sizes up to 64 CU
items.summary: Lakebase compute sizes rise from 32 CU to 64 CU (128 GB RAM), with dynamic scaling for larger workloads.
items.why: Larger workloads can now run on Lakebase with dynamic scaling.
items.title: Lakebase now supports compute sizes up to 64 CU (128 GB)

items.headline: Sign in as a service principal using OAuth U2M
items.summary: Users can now get tokens as a service principal's identity via OAuth U2M, not their own account.
items.why: Lets automation run under a service identity, improving security and auditability.
items.title: Authenticate as a service principal using OAuth U2M (Beta)

items.headline: Databricks Add-in for Excel supports all compliance standards
items.summary: The Excel add-in now supports every compliance security profile standard Databricks offers.
items.why: Lets regulated teams use Excel with Databricks under their required compliance standards.
items.title: Databricks Add-in for Excel support for all compliance security profile standards

items.headline: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent supports nested supervisor agents
items.summary: Supervisor Agents can now be added as subagent tools, enabling nested multi-agent orchestration for coordinated workflows.
items.why: Lets teams build layered multi-agent systems that split complex tasks across specialist agents.
items.title: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent now supports nesting supervisor agents as subagent tools

items.headline: Bundle UI edits now update YAML automatically
items.summary: Changes made to jobs and pipeline settings in the UI now automatically update the bundle YAML file.
items.why: Keeps bundle configuration files in sync without manual YAML editing.
items.title: Edits to resources in the UI now automatically update YAML

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer updates bring visual prep to all tiers
items.summary: Lakeflow Designer is on by default for all tiers, adds intent-based operator search, configurable sample sizes, Git support and user-defined operators in Public Preview.
items.why: Lets teams build visual data pipelines with less setup and easier version control.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer updates

items.headline: Databricks Container Services for standard compute
items.summary: Standard compute on Databricks Runtime 18.3 or later can now use custom Docker images in shared environments.
items.why: Lets teams run custom containers on shared compute with their own dependencies.
items.title: Databricks Container Services for standard compute is now available (Beta)

items.headline: MLflow evaluation features now work with customer-managed keys
items.summary: Production monitoring, the Review App and evaluation datasets now work in workspaces using customer-managed keys.
items.why: Lets regulated teams run AI evaluation while keeping their own encryption keys.
items.title: Customer-managed keys now support MLflow managed evaluation features

items.headline: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash hosted on Model Serving
items.summary: Model Serving now offers Google Gemini 3.5 Flash as a Databricks-hosted model, accessible through Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Adds another hosted model option for building generative AI apps.
items.title: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Unified runs list for jobs and pipelines
items.summary: All job and pipeline runs now appear in one list, filterable by status, time, user, run ID and error codes.
items.why: Makes troubleshooting failed jobs and pipelines faster from a single view.
items.title: Unified runs list is generally available

items.headline: Databricks Runtime 18 brings table and write changes
items.summary: Runtime 18 changes table comments, by-name write casting and metric view window measure results when clusters restart.
items.why: Review these behaviour changes before restarting clusters, as they can alter existing pipelines.
items.title: Databricks Runtime 18: May 18, 2026

items.headline: Supervisor Agent adds vector search index support
items.summary: Supervisor Agent can now use vector search indexes as tools for its subagents in a multi-agent setup.
items.why: Lets coordinated agents retrieve from vector indexes directly, simplifying multi-agent retrieval workflows.
items.title: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent now supports vector search indexes as subagent tools

items.headline: Recover deleted Lakebase projects within 7 days
items.summary: Deleted Lakebase projects now stay in a soft-deleted state for seven days, so you can restore branches, databases, endpoints and settings.
items.why: Adds a safety net against accidental deletion of projects and their settings.
items.title: Recover a deleted Lakebase project within 7 days

items.headline: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent gains Unity Catalog table tools
items.summary: Supervisor Agent can now use Unity Catalog tables as tools for its subagents.
items.why: Lets agents query governed enterprise tables directly within multi-agent workflows.
items.title: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent now supports Unity Catalog tables as subagent tools

items.headline: Spark Declarative Pipelines sinks for external targets
items.summary: The Lakeflow sink API now lets pipelines write transformed data to external targets such as Kafka and Event Hubs.
items.why: Simplifies publishing pipeline output to Kafka, Event Hubs and Delta tables.
items.title: Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow sinks are now generally available

items.headline: Share Genie Code chat threads with colleagues
items.summary: Users can now share Genie Code chat threads with users, groups or service principals, giving recipients read-only access.
items.why: Lets teams review AI-assisted work without risking changes to the original.
items.title: Share Genie Code chat threads

items.headline: Run history for scheduled refreshes in Google Sheets
items.summary: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets now shows run history for scheduled refreshes, including run ID, start time and status.
items.why: Helps teams track whether scheduled Sheets data refreshes are succeeding.
items.title: View run history for scheduled refreshes in Google Sheets

items.headline: Databricks SQL alerts for monitoring data and KPIs
items.summary: SQL alerts now run scheduled queries, check conditions and notify recipients when thresholds are met.
items.why: Helps catch KPI drift, anomalies and data quality issues without manual checks.
items.title: Databricks SQL alerts are now generally available

items.headline: New audit events for Genie One chats
items.summary: Genie One adds nine chat audit events, covering MCP tool calls, feedback, cancellations and scheduled tasks, plus minor fixes.
items.why: Gives governance teams finer tracking of Genie One chat activity and scheduled tasks.
items.title: Genie One enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: New SQL alert task for Lakeflow Jobs
items.summary: Lakeflow Jobs' SQL alert task, previously in Beta, is now in Public Preview, returning results for downstream branching.
items.why: Lets workflows branch on alert results, automating responses to data quality or threshold issues.
items.title: SQL alert task in Lakeflow Jobs is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Genie Agent gains longer queries and reviews
items.summary: Genie Agent raises API instruction limits, adds an Answer now option in Agent mode, and lets users request reviews.
items.why: Teams can stop slow reasoning early and review agent answers more easily.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Spark Declarative Pipelines environment versions
items.summary: Pipelines can now pin their Python version and preinstalled libraries, independent of Databricks Runtime upgrades.
items.why: Keeps pipeline Python stable through runtime upgrades, reducing unplanned breakage.
items.title: Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow environment versions (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Code now authors dashboard visualisations
items.summary: Genie Code can now author all dashboard visualisation options, and line charts can display error bars as bands.
items.why: Faster dashboard building with AI, plus clearer line chart trend uncertainty.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Serverless 18.2 adds agg() alias for metric views
items.summary: Serverless release adds agg() as an alias for measure() in metric views, plus temporary table replace and GA replaceOn and replaceUsing options.
items.why: Existing measure() queries keep working; metric view users can adopt agg() safely.
items.title: Version 18.2

items.headline: New Lakebase instances scale to zero by default
items.summary: New Lakebase instances pause compute after 24 hours of inactivity by default; existing projects unaffected.
items.why: Lowers compute costs for idle projects without any action needed.
items.title: New Lakebase instances now scale to zero by default

items.headline: Lakebase Change Data Feed captures every table change
items.summary: Lakebase Postgres tables can now log every insert, update and delete as Unity Catalog Delta tables.
items.why: Feeds downstream pipelines, models and audit without running a separate CDC stack.
items.title: Lakebase Change Data Feed (CDF) is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Databricks Add-in for Excel now available for HIPAA workspaces
items.summary: The Databricks Add-in for Excel is now available to HIPAA-compliant workspaces in all supported regions.
items.why: Lets regulated healthcare teams work with Databricks data directly in Excel.
items.title: HIPAA support for the Databricks Add-in for Excel

items.headline: App telemetry for Databricks Apps
items.summary: Apps can now send traces, logs and metrics to Unity Catalog tables via OpenTelemetry.
items.why: Easier monitoring and debugging of apps, with telemetry stored alongside governed data.
items.title: App telemetry for Databricks Apps is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds HubSpot Marketing Hub ingestion
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect's managed HubSpot connector can now ingest Marketing Hub data into Databricks.
items.why: Lets teams load HubSpot marketing data into Databricks without building custom pipelines.
items.title: HubSpot connector (GA)

items.headline: Catalog commits enable multi-table transactions
items.summary: Catalog commits let Unity Catalog coordinate managed Delta tables across engines, enabling multi-statement, multi-table transactions.
items.why: Enables consistent multi-table writes and stronger governance across engines.
items.title: Catalog commits are now generally available

items.headline: Genie Agents can now export metric views
items.summary: Genie Agents can now export their context as metric views, plus new Beta monitoring and compliant iframe embedding.
items.why: Lets teams define business semantics centrally, so metrics stay consistent.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: Local metric views now autofill join conditions
items.summary: Local metric views now autopopulate join conditions when joining two or more tables, alongside dashboard draft and fix updates.
items.why: Speeds up building semantic models; also adds a reset draft API for dashboard authors.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Standalone pipelines now run on serverless general compute
items.summary: Standalone pipelines, including materialised views and streaming tables, can now be created from serverless notebooks, using SQL or Python.
items.why: Lets engineers build pipelines in notebooks on serverless compute, in SQL or Python.
items.title: Standalone pipelines on serverless general compute (Beta)

items.headline: Faster installs with %uv pip in serverless notebooks
items.summary: Serverless notebooks on environment version 5 or later now support %uv pip, a faster alternative to %pip.
items.why: Speeds up Python package installs, sharing the same environment as %pip.
items.title: Faster package installs with %uv pip in serverless notebooks

items.headline: Genie One gains custom instructions and new MCP connections
items.summary: Workspace admins can set instructions for all Genie One chats, connect Atlassian and Glean MCPs, and use externally hosted MCP servers with server-sent events.
items.why: Lets teams tailor Genie One chats and reach more external tools from chat.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Automatic identity management syncs users and groups
items.summary: Syncs users and groups from your identity provider, keeping group memberships current; Entra ID is in Public Preview.
items.why: Cuts manual user administration and keeps access aligned with your identity provider.
items.title: Automatic identity management

items.headline: Qwen3.5 122B A10B available in Model Serving
items.summary: Model Serving now offers Alibaba's Qwen3.5 122B A10B as a Databricks-hosted model, accessible via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives customers another hosted open model option for building AI applications.
items.title: Alibaba Cloud Qwen3.5 122B A10B now available as a Databricks-hosted model in Public Preview

items.headline: Databricks invests US$300 million in ANZ over three years
items.summary: Databricks will open an ANZ headquarters and grow Lakebase and Genie adoption, plus upskill 100,000 people.
items.why: Signals deeper local support and skills for ANZ customers adopting Lakebase and Genie.
items.title: Databricks to invest US$300 million in ANZ over the next three years

items.headline: Lakeflow Pipelines Editor adds agent-first pipeline development
items.summary: The editor lets teams create, update and debug production pipelines with Genie Code, alongside the pipeline graph and metrics.
items.why: Lets engineers build and fix production pipelines faster with an AI agent.
items.title: Lakeflow Pipelines Editor is now generally available

items.headline: Lakebase Provisioned upgrades to Autoscaling platform
items.summary: Databricks automatically upgrades all Lakebase Provisioned instances to Autoscaling from June 2026, adding scale-to-zero and branching.
items.why: Connection strings keep working, but Forward ETL and REST API preview features end.
items.title: Upcoming change: Upgrade to Lakebase Autoscaling

items.headline: Community connectors for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Open-source community connectors now extend Lakeflow Connect to sources without managed support.
items.why: Lets teams ingest from more sources without waiting for managed connectors.
items.title: Community connectors (Beta)

items.headline: Native data profiling for notebook results tables
items.summary: Notebook results tables now show profiling statistics for columns, also available in the new Databricks SQL editor.
items.why: Quickly spot column quality and distribution issues while exploring data in notebooks.
items.title: Native data profiling for notebook results tables

items.headline: agg function: shorter way to query metric view measures
items.summary: The agg function is now a synonym for measure, so you can write agg(measure_column) when querying metric view measures.
items.why: Shorter SQL syntax for querying metric view measures.
items.title: agg SQL function as a synonym for measure

items.headline: Genie One adds scheduled tasks for recurring prompts
items.summary: Users can now schedule recurring prompts in Genie One, such as weekly digests, with results emailed to them.
items.why: Automates recurring insight reports, saving time for business users without manual checks.
items.title: Genie One scheduled tasks (Public Preview)

items.headline: Genie Agent adds weekly digests and PDF uploads
items.summary: Genie Agent's Monitoring tab now shows a weekly digest, and users can upload PDF files for analysis.
items.why: Faster spotting of usage trends and lets teams analyse PDF content directly.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: MLflow trace storage moves to Unity Catalog tables
items.summary: Traces are now stored in Unity Catalog tables in OpenTelemetry format, governed by existing schema and table permissions.
items.why: Brings AI trace observability under existing Unity Catalog governance and SQL access.
items.title: MLflow trace storage in Unity Catalog is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent adds custom subagents
items.summary: Supervisor Agent can now use custom MCP servers and custom agents hosted on Databricks Apps as subagents.
items.why: Lets teams plug their own tools and agents into one coordinated multi-agent system.
items.title: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent now supports custom MCP servers and custom agents on Databricks Apps

items.headline: Disable tasks in Lakeflow Jobs without removing them
items.summary: Tasks in Lakeflow Jobs can now be disabled to skip at run time, keeping their configuration and run history.
items.why: Pause tasks without rebuilding them later; configuration and run history stay intact.
items.title: Disabling tasks in Lakeflow Jobs is now GA

items.headline: Dashboard publishing, ownership and parameter improvements
items.summary: Authors can publish dashboards with service principal credentials, transfer ownership to service principals, reference parameters in widget titles, and choose PDF pages.
items.why: Smoother automated dashboard sharing, plus several fixes to publishing and viewing reliability.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Chat in Genie One brings natural language data questions
items.summary: Chat in Genie One has moved from Beta to Public Preview, offering a unified full-screen interface for natural language data questions.
items.why: Gives business users a single place for plain-language questions over trusted data.
items.title: Chat in Genie One is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Attribute-based access control (ABAC) in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Governed tags now automatically apply row filters and column masks to matching tables, views and functions.
items.why: Breaking change: row filters now use the querying user's identity; check policies.
items.title: Attribute-based access control (ABAC) is now generally available

items.headline: Connect Databricks to on-premises resources via SSH tunnel
items.summary: Classic and serverless compute can now reach on-premises resources through an SSH reverse tunnel on AWS proxy VMs, with no inbound firewall opening.
items.why: Lets hybrid estates use Databricks without opening inbound firewall ports.
items.title: Connect Databricks to on-premises resources using an SSH reverse tunnel

items.headline: Zendesk Support connector arrives in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: The Zendesk Support connector in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available for ingesting support data.
items.why: Lets teams load Zendesk ticket data into Databricks without building custom pipelines.
items.title: Zendesk Support connector (GA)

items.headline: Cloud token access for open Delta Sharing
items.summary: Open Delta Sharing now supports directory-based access, letting recipients read directly from cloud storage with temporary credentials.
items.why: Recipients read shared tables directly from storage, bypassing pre-signed URLs, where supported.
items.title: Cloud token access for open Delta Sharing sharing (GA)

items.headline: New 5X-Large SQL warehouse size
items.summary: The 5X-Large size, with 512 workers, is now in Public Preview for serverless and pro SQL warehouses in all regions.
items.why: Lets the largest SQL workloads scale further on serverless and pro warehouses.
items.title: 5X-Large SQL warehouse size (Public Preview)

items.headline: Tag Unity Catalog functions for search and certification
items.summary: Functions can now be tagged in Unity Catalog using SET TAG and UNSET TAG, requiring Runtime 18.1 or above.
items.why: Makes functions easier to find, certify and deprecate across your estate.
items.title: Tag Unity Catalog functions

items.headline: Recently resolved incidents in Data Quality Monitoring
items.summary: Data Quality Monitoring dashboard now shows tables that recovered to healthy status, with resolution times.
items.why: Confirms known data quality problems have been fixed and spots self-healing issues.
items.title: Recently Resolved Incidents section in Data Quality Monitoring (Beta)

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds Confluence connector
items.summary: The Confluence connector in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available for ingesting data.
items.why: Lets teams ingest Confluence content into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Confluence connector (GA)

items.headline: Databricks Excel Add-in needs admin enablement
items.summary: Workspace admins must now enable the Excel Connector preview from the Previews page before anyone can use the add-in.
items.why: Users cannot use the Excel add-in until an admin enables it.
items.title: Databricks Excel Add-in requires workspace preview enablement

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.5 and Pro models hosted on Databricks
items.summary: GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro are now hosted models in Mosaic AI Model Serving, accessible pay-per-token via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Lets teams use OpenAI's newest models within Databricks, billed per token.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro now available as Databricks-hosted models

items.headline: Manage Supervisor Agent programmatically with Databricks SDK
items.summary: Supervisor Agent and its tools can now be created and managed using the Databricks SDK for Python.
items.why: Lets teams automate agent setup and management in code rather than manually.
items.title: Manage Supervisor Agent programmatically with the Databricks SDK (Beta)

items.headline: Workspace base environments for serverless notebooks
items.summary: Workspace admins can now create and manage pre-built, cached environments for serverless notebooks, rolling out to compliance profile workspaces from late May 2026.
items.why: Lets admins standardise serverless notebook environments across teams and workspaces.
items.title: Workspace base environments are now generally available

items.headline: Dashboards add table drill-through and metric view defaults
items.summary: Tables now support cross-filtering and drill-through, counters accept prefixes and suffixes, and adding tables creates local metric views by default.
items.why: Makes dashboards more interactive and nudges teams towards governed metric views.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie Code can now configure Genie Agents
items.summary: Genie Code can now update Genie Agent instructions, example questions and descriptions for you.
items.why: Speeds up setting up and maintaining Genie Agents without manual editing.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: Workspace object permissions will inherit from all account groups
items.summary: Workspace object permissions will be inherited from all account groups, activating orphaned grants that may give members unexpected access.
items.why: Could expose workspace objects to unexpected users; review permissions and run the orphaned grants notebook.
items.title: Workspace object permissions will soon be inherited from all account groups

items.headline: Lakeflow Designer adds visual drag-and-drop pipeline building
items.summary: Lakeflow Designer now lets users build data transformation workflows visually on a drag-and-drop canvas, using natural language.
items.why: Lets teams build pipelines without writing as much code.
items.title: Lakeflow Designer is now in Public Preview

items.headline: AI Runtime adds single H100 accelerator option
items.summary: AI Runtime now supports a single H100 GPU accelerator in Beta, documented under Hardware.
items.why: Adds a high-performance GPU choice for AI and machine learning workloads.
items.title: AI Runtime 1xH100 accelerator (Beta)

items.headline: Data Classification automatically tags sensitive Unity Catalog data
items.summary: Data Classification automatically finds and tags sensitive data in Unity Catalog using an agentic AI system.
items.why: Helps protect sensitive data and meet compliance obligations without manual tagging effort.
items.title: Databricks Data Classification is now GA

items.headline: Lakebase exports metrics and logs via OpenTelemetry
items.summary: Lakebase Postgres metrics and logs can now be exported to any OTLP-compatible observability backend, such as Datadog or Grafana Cloud.
items.why: Lets teams monitor Lakebase databases in their existing observability tools.
items.title: Lakebase OpenTelemetry export (Beta)

items.headline: Supervisor API for building agents
items.summary: Supervisor API lets teams build agents in one call, with Databricks handling tool selection, execution and response synthesis.
items.why: Simplifies agent creation, so teams can prototype agents without managing orchestration logic.
items.title: Supervisor API for building agents (Beta)

items.headline: Serverless compute 18.1 adds vector functions and schema evolution
items.summary: Serverless compute 18.1 adds Synapse DATETIMEOFFSET support, schema evolution in INSERT, vector SQL functions and Delta Sharing transactions.
items.why: Several incremental SQL and connectivity gains; none touch metric views or BI integrations directly.
items.title: Version 18.1

items.headline: Unity Catalog managed storage location can now be changed
items.summary: Customers can now change the default managed storage location for catalogs and schemas in Unity Catalog.
items.why: Lets teams control where new managed tables and volumes are stored.
items.title: Altering a catalog or schema's managed storage location is now GA

items.headline: Power BI connector no longer supports BI compatibility mode
items.summary: Microsoft removed the BI compatibility mode option from the Power BI Databricks connector, so existing reports using metric views stop working.
items.why: Reports on metric views in Power BI will break; plan a workaround now.
items.title: BI compatibility mode removed from Power BI connector

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.7, queryable via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives customers a strong reasoning and vision model without leaving Databricks.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: ai_parse_document extracts structure from unstructured documents
items.summary: The ai_parse_document function is now generally available, extracting structured content from PDFs, images, Word and PowerPoint files, up to 500 pages and 100 MB.
items.why: Turns messy documents into structured data for AI and analytics pipelines.
items.title: ai_parse_document is now generally available

items.headline: Databricks Connector for Google Sheets adds metric views
items.summary: Users can now import and query Unity Catalog data, including metric views, directly in Google Sheets.
items.why: Lets business users work with governed metric definitions in a familiar spreadsheet.
items.title: Databricks Connector for Google Sheets is now generally available

items.headline: Builder mode becomes default for metric views
items.summary: Builder mode, the UI-based transformation tool, is now the default for editing measures and dimensions in metric views.
items.why: Makes creating measures and dimensions in metric views simpler without writing code.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Compute logs can be delivered to Unity Catalog volumes
items.summary: Spark driver, worker and event logs from classic all-purpose and jobs compute can now be stored in Unity Catalog volumes.
items.why: Gives a recommended, governed location for debugging logs from classic compute.
items.title: Compute log delivery to volumes is now GA

items.headline: Customer-managed keys for model serving
items.summary: Customer-managed keys can now encrypt model serving container images and artifacts in the managed registry. Applies to endpoints created after 16 April 2026.
items.why: Meets encryption control requirements for regulated workloads serving models with your own keys.
items.title: Customer-managed keys now support model serving

items.headline: Genie Agent gains reasoning traces and message comments
items.summary: Genie reasoning traces and message comments are now available through the API, and Agent mode supports longer conversations.
items.why: Developers can build richer Genie integrations and track how answers are produced.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: AI Gateway adds governance for MCP servers
items.summary: AI Gateway can now enforce access control, monitor usage and audit activity across all MCP interactions in a workspace.
items.why: Gives central control over how AI agents access tools and data across the workspace.
items.title: AI Gateway now governs MCP servers (Beta)

items.headline: Query-based connectors for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now ingests from databases by querying sources directly with a cursor column, without CDC or gateways.
items.why: Simpler database ingestion across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and other sources, with no CDC setup.
items.title: Query-based connectors for Lakeflow Connect (Public Preview)

items.headline: Sample Data Explorer with Genie Code
items.summary: Sample Data Explorer with Genie Code lets users ask natural-language questions about Unity Catalog tables, returning SQL answers.
items.why: Lets teams query sample data in plain English without writing SQL first.
items.title: Sample Data Explorer is generally available

items.headline: Lakebase now supports customer-managed encryption keys
items.summary: Lakebase project data can now be encrypted with your own cloud KMS key.
items.why: Gives full control over encryption and helps meet regulatory compliance requirements.
items.title: Lakebase: Customer-managed keys

items.headline: Unity Catalog tables writable from external Delta clients
items.summary: External Delta clients such as Apache Spark can now create and write to Unity Catalog tables, with managed tables in Beta needing catalog-managed commits.
items.why: Lets engineers write to governed tables from Spark without leaving Unity Catalog governance.
items.title: Create and write to Unity Catalog tables from external Delta clients (Beta)

items.headline: Vector Search adds built-in retrieval quality evaluation
items.summary: Mosaic AI Vector Search can now measure and compare the relevance of different search strategies on your data.
items.why: Helps you choose the search strategy that returns the most relevant results.
items.title: Vector Search retrieval quality (Beta)

items.headline: SAP column governance tags sync into Unity Catalog
items.summary: Column-level personal data tags from SAP Business Data Cloud now sync into Unity Catalog for use in ABAC policies.
items.why: Lets you restrict access to sensitive SAP columns using attribute-based policies.
items.title: Column-level SAP governance tags sync into Unity Catalog

items.headline: Share foreign Iceberg tables with Delta Sharing
items.summary: Providers can now add foreign Iceberg tables, federated from external Iceberg catalogs, to Delta Sharing shares.
items.why: Recipients get read-only access to Iceberg data without copying it.
items.title: Share foreign Iceberg tables with Delta Sharing (Public Preview)

items.headline: Account-level Genie One adds Apps, Domains and Genie
items.summary: Account-level Genie One now includes Databricks Apps, Domains and Genie, and the workspace navigation gained Genie Code chat history.
items.why: Lets customers reach Apps, Domains and Genie through one account-level Genie One experience.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: Dashboards can now create local metric views
items.summary: A new dataset type lets authors build metric views in a dashboard with a low-code visual interface, without publishing to Unity Catalog first.
items.why: Lets teams define governed metrics inside the dashboard, reducing duplicated logic.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements

items.headline: Embed Genie Agents in external apps and websites
items.summary: Genie Agents can now be embedded as iframes in websites or apps, alongside thumbnails, conditional formatting and Agent mode defaults.
items.why: Lets teams put conversational data answers into their own products and sites.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: Unity Catalog pipeline deletion will retain tables by default
items.summary: Deleting a Unity Catalog pipeline will keep its tables, now inactive, rather than removing them. Setting cascade=true keeps the old behaviour.
items.why: Automated clean-up scripts may need updating to set cascade=true before the change lands.
items.title: Upcoming breaking change: default behavior when deleting a Unity Catalog pipeline

items.headline: ai_prep_search turns parsed documents into search-ready chunks
items.summary: New SQL function that converts ai_parse_document output into chunks optimised for vector search and RAG.
items.why: Simplifies preparing documents for vector search and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.
items.title: ai_prep_search (Beta)

items.headline: Scoped personal access tokens for specific API operations
items.summary: Personal access tokens can now be restricted to specific API operations, limiting them to only the permissions you choose.
items.why: Limits token permissions, reducing risk if a token is leaked or misused.
items.title: Scoped personal access tokens are now generally available

items.headline: Deploy Databricks apps directly from Git repositories
items.summary: Databricks apps can now deploy straight from Git repositories, with an option to enforce Git-only deployments across a workspace.
items.why: Brings version control to app deployments, keeping releases traceable to Git commits.
items.title: Git-backed app deployments are now generally available

items.headline: SAP semantic metadata syncs automatically into Unity Catalog
items.summary: Mounting an SAP Business Data Cloud share now syncs semantic metadata, including governance tags, into Unity Catalog automatically.
items.why: Lets teams use SAP governance tags in ABAC policies to control sensitive data access.
items.title: SAP semantic metadata syncs automatically into Unity Catalog

items.headline: Shared workspace skills for Genie Code agents
items.summary: Workspace admins can now create shared agent skills for Genie Code's Agent mode, available to everyone in the workspace.
items.why: Lets teams standardise reusable workflows like ML pipelines across the whole workspace.
items.title: Workspace skills for Genie Code are now available

items.headline: Genie Agents gain column display names and API access
items.summary: Space authors can set friendly column display names, shown in results and CSV downloads; the Genie Conversation API is now generally available.
items.why: Lets teams build Genie Agent into apps and automate questions programmatically.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: Governed tags for consistent metadata tagging
items.summary: Administrators can now define a controlled set of tags applied to Unity Catalog and workspace objects.
items.why: Enforces consistent tagging for access control, data classification and cost tracking.
items.title: Governed tags are generally available

items.headline: Account-level Genie One launches for multi-workspace views
items.summary: Genie One is now in Public Preview at account level, giving one place to view dashboards, apps and Genie across workspaces, with navigation between account and workspace views.
items.why: One view across all workspaces, simplifying oversight for leaders managing multiple teams.
items.title: Genie One enhancements

items.headline: AI/BI dashboard enhancements, including Genie Code faceted charts
items.summary: Dashboards gain vertical text alignment, ZIP and NUTS map boundaries, individual filter clearing, and Explain this change for more chart types.
items.why: Smoother dashboard authoring and viewing, plus Genie can now build faceted charts.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Customer-managed keys for Unity Catalog
items.summary: Customers can now use their own cloud KMS keys to encrypt Unity Catalog catalogs on default storage.
items.why: Gives tighter control over encryption keys for governed data.
items.title: Customer-managed keys for Unity Catalog are generally available

items.headline: Databricks joins STATION F to accelerate AI adoption
items.summary: Databricks partners with STATION F, the Paris founder campus, to promote Lakebase and Genie to startups.
items.why: Helps European startups adopt Lakebase and Genie for enterprise-ready AI.
items.title: Databricks joins STATION F to Accelerate AI Adoption for European Founders

items.headline: Legacy SQL editor retiring; new editor becomes default
items.summary: The new SQL editor becomes default in late May 2026, and the legacy editor is retired in late July 2026.
items.why: Plan now: workspace opt-out ends, so teams must move to the new editor.
items.title: New SQL editor default enablement and legacy SQL editor retirement

items.headline: Databricks commits $850M to UK data and AI growth
items.summary: Databricks is quadrupling its UK office footprint, doubling its team and scaling Lakebase and Genie adoption.
items.why: Signals more local support and talent for Lakebase and Genie customers.
items.title: Databricks Announces $850M UK Investment to Accelerate Enterprise Data + AI Adoption

items.headline: Agent Bricks becomes umbrella for all Databricks AI
items.summary: The Agent Bricks page now serves as the hub for all Databricks AI capabilities, beyond declarative agents.
items.why: One place to find and navigate Databricks AI capabilities.
items.title: Agent Bricks now covers all Databricks AI capabilities

items.headline: Classification and information extraction visual interfaces
items.summary: Visual interfaces now let users classify documents and extract structured data at scale.
items.why: Lets teams process document data without writing code, previewing results first.
items.title: Classification and Information Extraction are in Public Preview

items.headline: New v2 versions of ai_classify and ai_extract
items.summary: ai_classify and ai_extract gain v2 signatures with better quality, flexibility and document parsing composability.
items.why: Enables end-to-end document processing with better quality and performance for AI workflows.
items.title: ai_classify and ai_extract now support v2 signatures (Public Preview)

items.headline: Genie Agent can now be shared account-wide
items.summary: Genie Agents can be shared with all account users, and full-result downloads now follow workspace SQL download settings.
items.why: Makes sharing easier across the account and keeps download controls consistent.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements

items.headline: Dashboard enhancements, scheduling redesign and bug fixes
items.summary: Adds Genie Agent descriptions, pivot table advanced cells, parameters in custom calculations and a simpler scheduling UI; removes the legacy colour palette setting.
items.why: Makes dashboards easier to build, schedule and maintain, with several bug fixes.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Delta Lake type widening for column changes
items.summary: Delta Lake tables can now widen column types, such as INT to BIGINT, during ingestion without rewriting data files.
items.why: Lets teams evolve schemas without costly data file rewrites or ingestion rework.
items.title: Type widening is now generally available

items.headline: Auto Loader adds automatic type widening
items.summary: Auto Loader can now widen data types such as int to long automatically, without rewriting data.
items.why: Fewer pipeline failures when source file types change, with no manual intervention.
items.title: Auto Loader supports automatic type widening (Public Preview)

items.headline: Databricks enters security with Lakewatch, an agentic SIEM
items.summary: Databricks is entering security with Lakewatch, an agentic SIEM offering unified data, petabyte-scale threat detection and investigations.
items.why: Vendor claims up to 80% lower TCO for unified threat detection.
items.title: Databricks Enters Security Market with Launch of Lakewatch: New, Agentic SIEM

items.headline: Dynamic parameters in the new SQL editor
items.summary: The new SQL editor adds a Dynamic dropdown widget that fills its options from a saved query's results.
items.why: Keeps parameter dropdowns current as underlying data changes, reducing manual list upkeep.
items.title: Dynamic parameters in the new SQL editor

items.headline: Genie One chat can now search external sources
items.summary: Chat in Genie One can now search external sources like Google Drive and SharePoint, with individual user authentication, plus custom MCP servers.
items.why: Lets chat answers draw on company documents, using each user's own credentials.
items.title: Connect external data sources to chat in Genie One (Beta)

items.headline: Supervisor Agent supports long-running tasks
items.summary: Supervisor Agent can split complex tasks into multiple request and response cycles, avoiding timeouts.
items.why: Lets complex agent workflows finish without timing out.
items.title: Supervisor Agent supports long-running tasks

items.headline: AI Runtime brings GPU support to serverless compute
items.summary: AI Runtime adds GPU support to serverless compute for deep learning; single-node tasks are in Public Preview, while distributed multi-GPU training remains in Beta.
items.why: Lets teams train deep learning models on GPUs without managing infrastructure.
items.title: AI Runtime is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Inspect improves Genie answer accuracy automatically
items.summary: Inspect reviews Genie's generated SQL, checks parts of the query and improves it automatically.
items.why: Fewer wrong answers from Genie without extra manual checking by analysts.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: Real-time mode for Structured Streaming
items.summary: Real-time mode for Structured Streaming is now generally available on classic compute, with dedicated and standard access modes.
items.why: Enables low-latency streaming; requires Databricks Runtime 16.4 LTS or later.
items.title: Real-time mode in Structured Streaming is now generally available

items.headline: Alerts for anomaly detection in Data Quality Monitoring
items.summary: Users can now create and view anomaly detection alerts directly in the Data Quality Monitoring UI.
items.why: Catches unexpected data shifts early, without building custom alert logic.
items.title: Create alerts for anomaly detection in the Data Quality Monitoring UI (Beta)

items.headline: SQL alert task for jobs
items.summary: You can now add a SQL alert task to Databricks jobs to evaluate SQL alerts within workflows.
items.why: Automates condition checks and notifications inside data pipelines without extra tooling.
items.title: SQL alert task for jobs (Beta)

items.headline: Dashboard updates include Genie chart explanations
items.summary: Dashboards gain drill-through for pivot tables and Genie explanations for time series charts, alongside several bug fixes.
items.why: Lets users drill into pivot tables and ask Genie why charts changed.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes

items.headline: OpenSharing (formerly Delta Sharing) token URL changes
items.summary: Tokens created or rotated after the September 2026 transition use recipient-specific URLs; old URLs work until they expire.
items.why: Providers should move recipients to new URLs now; the old format will eventually be retired.
items.title: Changes to OpenSharing (formerly Delta Sharing) open recipient tokens

items.headline: Databricks usage dashboard for account admins
items.summary: Account admins can import pre-built, customisable dashboards to monitor usage at account and workspace levels.
items.why: Gives admins clearer visibility of usage across accounts and workspaces.
items.title: Databricks usage dashboard is now generally available

items.headline: Databricks Apps now supports uv for Python dependencies
items.summary: Databricks apps can now manage Python dependencies with uv, using pyproject.toml and uv.lock files.
items.why: Gives teams a faster, standard way to lock and manage app dependencies.
items.title: Databricks Apps supports uv for Python dependency management

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.4 mini and nano hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Databricks now hosts OpenAI GPT-5.4 mini and nano models, accessible via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives smaller, faster OpenAI options for agents and apps on Databricks.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.4 mini and GPT-5.4 nano now available as Databricks-hosted models

items.headline: Accenture and Databricks accelerate enterprise AI agent adoption
items.summary: Accenture and Databricks launch a new business group with more than 25,000 trained professionals to help clients deploy Lakebase, Genie and Agent Bricks.
items.why: Faster route to scaling agents and AI apps, with certified Databricks talent on hand.
items.title: Accenture and Databricks Accelerate Enterprise Adoption of AI Applications and Agents at Scale

items.headline: ai_parse_document layout and reading order improvements
items.summary: Improves bounding box and layout detection and fixes common reading order errors.
items.why: Cleaner parsed document structure means better data for downstream extraction and AI pipelines.
items.title: ai_parse_document quality improvements: layout and reading order

items.headline: Lakebase databases as Databricks Apps resources
items.summary: Users can now add Lakebase databases as resources for their Databricks apps.
items.why: Makes it simpler to connect app data to Lakebase.
items.title: Lakebase databases as Databricks Apps resources

items.headline: Chat in Genie One unifies talking to Genie
items.summary: Genie One offers a unified full-screen chat that routes questions to the best Genie Agent or answers directly.
items.why: One place to ask data questions, with Genie choosing the right agent.
items.title: Chat in Genie One (Beta)

items.headline: Health indicators for tables in Catalog Explorer
items.summary: Catalog Explorer now shows freshness and completeness health indicators for tables, based on anomaly detection.
items.why: Spot stale or incomplete tables quickly, without building your own monitoring.
items.title: Health indicators for tables in Catalog Explorer (Public Preview)

items.headline: New 5X-Large size for SQL warehouses
items.summary: The 5X-Large cluster size now works for serverless and pro SQL warehouses, in Beta, with admins controlling access via Previews.
items.why: Lets heavy SQL workloads scale further on serverless and pro warehouses.
items.title: 5X-Large SQL warehouse size (Beta)

items.headline: Lakebase adds OAuth roles, budget policies and Lakehouse sync
items.summary: Lakebase adds UI and API OAuth roles, budget policies and tags, plus Beta CDC replication into Unity Catalog Delta tables.
items.why: Lets teams replicate operational data into the lakehouse and track Lakebase costs.
items.title: Lakebase updates: OAuth role management, budget policies and tags, and Lakehouse sync

items.headline: AI/BI dashboards gain external embedding, mobile layouts and more
items.summary: Dashboards can now be embedded for external users without Databricks accounts, with new formatting, fonts and mobile layouts.
items.why: Lets you share AI/BI dashboards with external users without giving them accounts.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and improvements

items.headline: Genie One now spans all workspaces in an account
items.summary: Genie One gives a single entry point to dashboards, Genie Agents and Apps across every workspace in an account.
items.why: One place to find and search AI/BI dashboards and agents across workspaces.
items.title: Account-level Genie One (Beta)

items.headline: New Lakebase instances now default to autoscaling
items.summary: New Lakebase instances are created with autoscaling, scale-to-zero, branching and instant restore by default across UI, API, Terraform and SDKs.
items.why: Compute scales automatically and new databases get branching and fast restore.
items.title: New Lakebase instances include autoscaling by default

items.headline: Genie Agent space management APIs
items.summary: The APIs for creating, updating, getting, listing and trashing Genie Agent spaces are now GA, with fixes and context improvements.
items.why: Lets developers automate Genie Agent spaces with stable, supported APIs.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and improvements

items.headline: Databricks Runtime 18 brings metric view filter support
items.summary: Runtime 18 is released, with MEASURE aggregates now honouring FILTER clauses, plus faster spatial Boolean operations and Auto Loader file events by default.
items.why: Filtered metric view measures now return correct results instead of silently ignoring the filter.
items.title: Databricks Runtime 18: March 11, 2026

items.headline: Databricks SQL pipelines gain notifications and performance mode
items.summary: Materialized views and streaming tables in Databricks SQL can now send failure notifications and use serverless performance mode.
items.why: Faster failure alerts and more control over serverless performance for scheduled refreshes.
items.title: Databricks SQL pipelines support notifications and performance mode (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Code brings agentic engineering to data work
items.summary: Databricks introduces Genie Code, which builds autonomous production systems from data engineering, data science and analytics ideas.
items.why: Could shorten the path from data idea to production system.
items.title: Databricks Launches Genie Code: Bringing Agentic Engineering to Data Work

items.headline: Multi-table transactions for Delta Lake tables
items.summary: Group SQL statements across multiple tables into one atomic transaction using BEGIN ATOMIC syntax, with rollback on failure.
items.why: Keeps related multi-table changes consistent, so partial updates no longer corrupt data.
items.title: Multi-table transactions are now in Public Preview

items.headline: Query metric views in Power BI with compatibility mode
items.summary: Power BI users can query metric views using standard SQL aggregations by enabling a compatibility mode on connection, which automatically applies correct measure definitions.
items.why: Lets Power BI reports use governed metric definitions without rewriting queries.
items.title: BI compatibility mode for metric views in Power BI (Beta)

items.headline: Inbound Private Link for performance-intensive services
items.summary: Inbound Private Link is now in Public Preview for performance-intensive services like Zerobus Ingest and Lakebase Autoscaling.
items.why: Keeps traffic to high-throughput services on private networks, without public internet exposure.
items.title: Inbound Private Link for performance-intensive services (Public Preview)

items.headline: Workday HCM connector in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Databricks now offers a managed Lakeflow Connect connector to ingest Workday Human Capital Management data.
items.why: Lets teams bring HR workforce data into Databricks without building custom pipelines.
items.title: Workday HCM connector (Beta)

items.headline: Declarative feature engineering APIs for time-windowed features
items.summary: Lets teams define and compute time-windowed aggregation features in Unity Catalog, materialised to Delta or Lakebase.
items.why: Simplifies ML feature pipelines and serving, though only in two AWS regions for now.
items.title: Declarative Feature Engineering APIs (Beta)

items.headline: New app and table resources for Databricks Apps
items.summary: Databricks apps can now use other apps and Unity Catalog tables as resources, enabling app-to-app communication and governed table access.
items.why: Lets apps talk to each other and read governed tables securely.
items.title: New resources for Databricks Apps

items.headline: Endpoint telemetry for custom model serving
items.summary: Custom model serving endpoints can now persist logs, traces and metrics into Unity Catalog Delta tables via OpenTelemetry.
items.why: Enables root cause analysis and compliance retention using standard SQL queries.
items.title: Endpoint telemetry for custom model serving endpoints (Beta)

items.headline: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite now available on Databricks
items.summary: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite is now a Databricks-hosted model, accessible through Foundation Model APIs, vision queries and batch inference.
items.why: Adds another hosted option for pay-per-token, vision and batch AI workloads.
items.title: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Telemetry for Databricks Apps
items.summary: Apps can now send traces, logs and metrics to Unity Catalog tables via OpenTelemetry.
items.why: Gives visibility into app performance and usage, stored in governed Unity Catalog tables.
items.title: Databricks Apps telemetry (Beta)

items.headline: Unity Catalog metric views in Excel and Google Sheets
items.summary: You can now import Unity Catalog metric views as pivot tables using the Excel Add-in and Google Sheets connector.
items.why: Lets finance and analysts use governed metrics directly in spreadsheets.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and improvements

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.4 available via Databricks-hosted models
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts OpenAI GPT-5.4, accessible via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Lets teams use a frontier OpenAI model on pay-per-token pricing.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.4 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Lakebase supports compliance security profile workspaces
items.summary: Lakebase now works in workspaces with the compliance security profile for HIPAA, C5, TISAX, or no standard.
items.why: Lets regulated customers run Lakebase under HIPAA, C5 or TISAX requirements.
items.title: Lakebase is now generally available with compliance security profile

items.headline: Schedule data refreshes in Google Sheets
items.summary: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets can now refresh data automatically on an hourly, daily or weekly schedule.
items.why: Keeps Sheets-based reports current without manual exports or re-running queries.
items.title: Schedule data refreshes in Google Sheets (Public Preview)

items.headline: Connect Microsoft Excel to Databricks
items.summary: The Databricks Excel Add-in lets users import tables or metric views, run SQL and analyse data in Excel.
items.why: Lets analyst teams use governed metric views directly in spreadsheets.
items.title: Connect to Databricks from Microsoft Excel (Public Preview)

items.headline: Customer-managed keys for Unity Catalog
items.summary: Lets customers encrypt Unity Catalog data using their own keys.
items.why: Gives tighter control over encryption and key ownership for sensitive data.
items.title: Customer-managed keys for Unity Catalog (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakebase adds high availability with automatic failover
items.summary: Lakebase high availability pairs primary compute with one to three secondaries across zones, auto-promoting one if the primary fails.
items.why: Keeps applications running through zone failures without connection string changes.
items.title: Lakebase now includes high availability

items.headline: Notebook tagging for organising and certifying notebooks
items.summary: Notebooks can now be tagged for organisation, plus governed certification and deprecation tags showing trust or lifecycle status.
items.why: Makes notebooks easier to manage and shows which ones are trusted or retired.
items.title: Notebook tagging (Public Preview)

items.headline: Managed OAuth for external MCP servers
items.summary: Databricks now handles OAuth sign-in for select external MCP servers, so teams need no custom OAuth app.
items.why: Connects agents to Glean, GitHub, Google Drive and SharePoint without managing credentials.
items.title: Managed OAuth flows for external MCP servers

items.headline: Serverless 18.0 adds window functions to metric views
items.summary: Serverless compute release 18.0 adds SQL window functions to metric views, makes SQL scripting generally available, and more.
items.why: Enables running totals and rankings in metric views without workarounds.
items.title: Version 18.0

items.headline: Dashboards show metric view lineage and agentic Genie
items.summary: Dashboards now show Unity Catalog metric views in lineage, plus date format, refresh cancellation and a Genie agentic experience in Public Preview.
items.why: Shows metric view dependencies on dashboards and adds agentic Genie insights for faster analysis.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and improvements

items.headline: Unity Catalog adds column semantic metadata commands
items.summary: New SQL commands set, unset and display business metadata such as display names, formats and synonyms on Unity Catalog columns.
items.why: Lets teams give columns friendly names and synonyms for clearer analytics and BI.
items.title: Databricks Runtime 18: February 26, 2026

items.headline: Genie Agents gain metric view names and Context tab
items.summary: Genie Agents now show metric view display names, auto-create joins from keys, add a Context tab, and run agent queries in parallel.
items.why: Consumers see context and common questions; metric views read more clearly in answers.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and improvements

items.headline: Enable HITRUST compliance controls in Databricks
items.summary: You can now enable HITRUST compliance controls to help manage risk and demonstrate security and privacy compliance.
items.why: Helps regulated customers show security and privacy compliance against HITRUST standards.
items.title: HITRUST compliance controls (Public Preview)

items.headline: Python unit testing in the workspace
items.summary: Databricks workspace now includes built-in tools to discover, run and debug pytest-based Python unit tests.
items.why: Lets teams test and debug Python code directly in the workspace, without external tooling.
items.title: Python unit testing in the workspace

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.3 Codex hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts OpenAI GPT-5.3 Codex, a code-focused model, billed pay-per-token.
items.why: Adds a strong coding model for refactoring and software engineering tasks without managing infrastructure.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.3 Codex now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: ADBC driver becomes default for new Power BI connections
items.summary: New Power BI connections in Desktop and Service now use the ADBC driver by default; existing connections stay on ODBC unless changed manually.
items.why: Changes the default for new reports; existing ones need manual switching to ADBC.
items.title: ADBC driver is now the default driver for new Power BI connections

items.headline: JAR tasks run on serverless compute
items.summary: Jobs can now run JAR tasks on serverless compute, in Public Preview.
items.why: Lets JVM workloads run without managing clusters, reducing operational overhead.
items.title: JAR tasks on serverless compute is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Dashboard visualisation and interaction enhancements
items.summary: Dashboards gain pivot hierarchies, stacked bar min/max and total labels, axis sorting, faceted charts and content search.
items.why: Makes dashboards easier to explore and analyse, with better charts and search.
items.title: Dashboard visualization and interaction enhancements

items.headline: Gemini 3.1 Pro as a Databricks-hosted model
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving adds Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro as a Databricks-hosted model, usable for pay-per-token and batch workloads.
items.why: Gives teams Google's reasoning and vision model without leaving Databricks.
items.title: Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Scoped personal access tokens limit API permissions
items.summary: Personal access tokens can now be restricted to specific API scopes, limiting each token to chosen operations.
items.why: Reduces risk by ensuring tokens can only perform the operations they need.
items.title: Scoped personal access tokens (Beta)

items.headline: Discover page and domains in Unity Catalog
items.summary: Adds a central Discover page to search, browse and preview governed data, plus business-aligned domains and curation.
items.why: Helps teams find, trust and steward governed data assets faster across the business.
items.title: Discover page and domains (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Research Agent renamed Agent mode, with faster responses
items.summary: Research Agent is now called Agent mode, and it gives more concise, faster answers to what-type questions.
items.why: Quicker, more concise answers to what-type questions from Genie Agent mode.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) Agent mode rename and improvements

items.headline: Claude Sonnet 4.6 now hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6, accessible via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams a frontier model without managing infrastructure, billed per token.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, accessible via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Offers another embedding option for search and retrieval, billed per token.
items.title: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B now available in Public Preview as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Dashboard enhancements: pivot tables, table styling and wider grid
items.summary: Dashboards gain pivot table cross filtering, table aggregations, 12-column layouts, multi-select all values and more improvements.
items.why: Makes dashboards more flexible and easier to build for analysts.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and improvements

items.headline: Genie Agents gain Inspect accuracy and new visuals
items.summary: Genie adds heatmap and sankey charts, plus Inspect in Beta to improve SQL accuracy.
items.why: Inspect reviews generated SQL, improving answer accuracy without extra effort.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and improvements

items.headline: File events on by default for new external locations
items.summary: New external locations now enable file events by default, letting storage jobs and ingestion pipelines detect file changes more efficiently.
items.why: Makes ingestion pipelines more efficient, with a permissions check on creation.
items.title: File events enabled by default on new external locations

items.headline: AI Gateway governance expands to coding agents
items.summary: Enhanced AI Gateway adds a richer UI, better observability and wider API coverage for governing LLM endpoints and coding agents.
items.why: Gives central control over AI model and coding agent usage, aiding compliance and visibility.
items.title: AI Gateway (Beta)

items.headline: HubSpot connector in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now ingests HubSpot Marketing Hub data into Databricks.
items.why: Lets teams pull HubSpot marketing data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: HubSpot connector (Beta)

items.headline: SQL scripting arrives in Databricks SQL 2025.40
items.summary: SQL scripting is now GA, adding conditionals, loops, local variables and exception handling, with parameter markers expanded too.
