items.why: Lets teams write procedural logic in SQL without leaving the warehouse.
items.title: Databricks SQL version 2025.40 is now available in Preview

items.headline: Supervisor Agent orchestrates multiple AI agents for complex tasks
items.summary: Supervisor Agent is now available to build multi-agent systems coordinating agents and tools, in select US regions.
items.why: Simplifies coordinating several AI agents on complex business tasks.
items.title: Supervisor Agent is now Generally Available

items.headline: Databricks grows 65% and backs Lakebase and Genie
items.summary: Databricks reports over 65% year-on-year growth, a $5.4 billion revenue run-rate, and over $7 billion of announced investment.
items.why: Signals strong platform momentum and sustained investment in Lakebase and Genie.
items.title: Databricks Grows >65% YoY, Surpasses $5.4 Billion Revenue Run-Rate, Doubles Down on Lakebase and Genie

items.headline: Query tags for SQL warehouses
items.summary: Custom key-value tags can now label SQL warehouse workloads, helping attribute costs and find slow queries.
items.why: Lets teams attribute warehouse costs to business context and spot long-running queries.
items.title: Query tags for SQL warehouses (Public Preview)

items.headline: Deploy Databricks apps from Git repositories
items.summary: Databricks apps can now deploy straight from Git repositories, from any branch, tag or commit, without uploading files.
items.why: Lets teams deploy apps from version control without manual file uploads.
items.title: Deploy Databricks apps from Git repositories (Beta)

items.headline: Lakeflow pipelines get row filters, masks and tags
items.summary: Lakeflow pipeline datasets can now have row filters, column masks, tags and comments applied via ALTER or the UI.
items.why: Enforces access controls and labelling inside pipelines rather than as a manual afterthought.
items.title: Applying filters, masks, tags, and comments to pipeline-created datasets is now GA

items.headline: Dashboard enhancements including Assistant and Genie
items.summary: Dashboards gain parameterised tasks, workspace themes, tag search, and an Assistant for authoring in Beta.
items.why: Lets authors build dashboards from prompts; Genie questions now default on for viewers.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and new capabilities

items.headline: Claude Opus 4.6 now hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 as a Databricks-hosted model, accessible via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Lets teams use a top reasoning and vision model on pay-per-token pricing.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Genie Agent gains tag search and paginated columns
items.summary: Genie Agents now support tag search, paginated column lists in the Configure tab, and embedded compute credentials for all users.
items.why: Makes it easier to find spaces by tag and navigate wide tables.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) improvements

items.headline: Google Ads connector for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now offers a managed connector to ingest Google Ads data into Databricks.
items.why: Simplifies loading advertising data for marketing analytics without custom pipelines.
items.title: Google Ads connector (Beta)

items.headline: Default SQL warehouse settings for workspaces
items.summary: Admins can set a workspace default SQL warehouse, which users can override with their own default.
items.why: Users spend less time choosing warehouses across editor, dashboards and Genie.
items.title: Default SQL warehouse settings (General Availability)

items.headline: Databricks Assistant connects to MCP servers
items.summary: Databricks Assistant in Agent mode can now use external MCP servers added to your workspace.
items.why: Lets the Assistant reach external tools and data sources under existing permissions.
items.title: Connect Databricks Assistant to MCP servers

items.headline: Pivot tables from Databricks tables in Google Sheets
items.summary: Users can now select Databricks tables in Catalog Explorer and import them into Google Sheets as pivot tables using the Databricks Connector.
items.why: Lets analysts build pivot analysis on governed data without leaving Google Sheets.
items.title: Select tables and create pivot tables in Google Sheets

items.headline: Data Quality Monitoring adds anomaly detection
items.summary: Schema-level anomaly detection learns from historical patterns to flag data quality issues, with monitored table health consolidated in one system table and UI.
items.why: Catches data quality problems early, without hand-writing rules for every table.
items.title: Data Quality Monitoring Anomaly Detection public preview

items.headline: Tag Databricks apps to organise them
items.summary: Databricks apps can now be tagged to organise and categorise them, though tag-based search is not supported yet.
items.why: Makes app estates easier to organise, though search by tag is unavailable.
items.title: Tag Databricks Apps (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakeflow jobs system tables for account-wide job insight
items.summary: Four Lakeflow jobs system tables have moved to GA, giving account-wide insight into jobs and job runs.
items.why: Lets teams monitor all jobs and runs from one supported, production-ready source.
items.title: Lakeflow jobs system tables are now generally available (GA)

items.headline: Trigger on update refreshes pipelines when sources change
items.summary: Pipelines can now refresh automatically when a source table changes, set through SQL schedules.
items.why: Removes manual or timed refreshes, keeping pipelines current with upstream data.
items.title: Trigger on update for pipelines (GA)

items.headline: Serverless workspaces pre-configured with compute and storage
items.summary: Serverless workspaces come pre-configured with serverless compute and default storage as a fully managed SaaS experience.
items.why: Lets teams start on fully managed, enterprise-ready infrastructure without manual compute or storage setup.
items.title: Serverless workspaces are now generally available

items.headline: Dashboard visualisation and data improvements
items.summary: Dashboards gain full-width pivot tables, image cells, tooltip fields on combo charts, and larger pivot downloads, plus several fixes.
items.why: Makes pivot reporting more readable and easier to share with stakeholders.
items.title: Dashboard visualization and data improvements

items.headline: GPT-5.2 Codex hosted on Databricks Model Serving
items.summary: Databricks now hosts OpenAI's GPT-5.2 Codex, a code-focused model, billed pay-per-token via Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams a specialist model for code generation, refactoring and debugging on pay-per-token pricing.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.2 Codex now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Genie Agent adds full result downloads and clearer errors
items.summary: A new API endpoint downloads result sets up to about 1 GB, with clearer errors and catalog permission warnings.
items.why: Lets teams export full results and see permission issues upfront.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) API and user experience improvements

items.headline: Compute sizing for Databricks Apps
items.summary: Databricks Apps now offers Medium and Large compute sizes, letting teams match resources to workload needs.
items.why: Right-sizing app compute helps control costs and performance for different workloads.
items.title: Compute sizing for Databricks Apps is now generally available

items.headline: Managed MCP servers connect AI agents to Databricks
items.summary: Managed MCP servers let AI agents securely connect to Databricks resources and external APIs.
items.why: Simplifies secure agent access to Databricks data and external services.
items.title: Managed MCP servers is now Public Preview

items.headline: Store and query MLflow traces in Unity Catalog
items.summary: MLflow traces can now be stored in Unity Catalog Delta tables using OpenTelemetry format and queried with SQL.
items.why: Gives long-term trace retention, SQL analysis and Unity Catalog access control for GenAI applications.
items.title: Store and query MLflow traces in Unity Catalog (Beta)

items.headline: Databricks achieves ISMAP certification in Japan
items.summary: Databricks has gained Japan's ISMAP cloud security certification, the government's official framework for assessing cloud services.
items.why: Eases public sector adoption in Japan by confirming Databricks meets national security standards.
items.title: Databricks Achieves ISMAP Certification in Japan, Unlocking Secure Data Innovation for the Public Sector

items.headline: Lakebase Postgres adds autoscaling, branching and backups
items.summary: Lakebase, Databricks' Postgres database, now includes autoscaling, scale-to-zero, instant branching, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, and expanded regions.
items.why: Gives production-ready transactional Postgres for apps and AI agents alongside the lakehouse.
items.title: Lakebase is now generally available

items.headline: Front-end PrivateLink for performance-intensive services
items.summary: AWS front-end PrivateLink now gives private connectivity to Zerobus Ingest and Lakebase Autoscaling.
items.why: Lets AWS customers keep high-throughput services off the public internet.
items.title: Front-end PrivateLink for performance-intensive services (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Agents now appear in Unity Catalog lineage
items.summary: Genie Agents, formerly Genie Spaces, now appear in Unity Catalog lineage, and entity matching gains bulk actions.
items.why: Easier tracing of Genie data sources and faster bulk management of entity matches.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) lineage and entity matching improvements

items.headline: Dashboard subscriptions, custom calculations and visualisation improvements
items.summary: Dashboard authors can now subscribe account-level users to scheduled updates, with new calculation references, stacked bar totals and tooltip and error fixes.
items.why: Lets teams share dashboards on schedule with more users, plus clearer charts.
items.title: Dashboard subscriptions, custom calculations, and visualization improvements

items.headline: Genie One search and discovery improvements
items.summary: Genie One adds app status filtering, dashboard widget title search, boosted certified content ranking, and recents on the For you page.
items.why: Makes finding trusted dashboards, apps and favourites quicker in Genie One.
items.title: Genie One search and discovery improvements

items.headline: Genie One gives business users a simpler entry point
items.summary: Genie One offers business users a simplified interface to dashboards, natural language questions and custom Databricks Apps without technical knowledge.
items.why: Lets non-technical staff self-serve data, dashboards and apps without needing compute or query skills.
items.title: Genie One is generally available

items.headline: Custom base environments for serverless jobs
items.summary: Serverless jobs now support custom YAML base environments for Python, wheel and notebook tasks.
items.why: Lets teams standardise dependencies across serverless job types.
items.title: You can now use custom base environments for Python, Python Wheels, and notebook tasks in serverless jobs

items.headline: Level of detail expressions for custom calculations
items.summary: Dashboard custom calculations can now control aggregation granularity, using fixed or coarser level of detail expressions.
items.why: Enables percent-of-total and cohort metrics without changing chart groupings.
items.title: Level of detail expressions for custom calculations

items.headline: Genie Agent adds sample data and Research Agent starters
items.summary: Genie Agent adds a sample data tab, API text answer summaries, Research Agent starter questions in Beta, and space manager feedback tools.
items.why: Helps users trust answers and lets space managers debug feedback more easily.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) sample data, Research Agent, and space manager improvements

items.headline: Genie One adds favourites and certified content filtering
items.summary: Users can star assets in Genie One and filter content by favourite or certified status.
items.why: Makes it faster to find trusted, certified content in Genie One.
items.title: Genie One favorite and filtering improvements

items.headline: Genie Agent and Databricks Assistant arrive on AWS GovCloud
items.summary: Genie Agent and Databricks Assistant are now available on Databricks on AWS GovCloud for US government and regulated workloads.
items.why: Lets US government teams use AI-assisted analytics and agents in a compliant environment.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) and Databricks Assistant on Databricks on AWS GovCloud GA

items.headline: Knowledge Assistant chatbot answers document questions
items.summary: Knowledge Assistant lets you build a chatbot that answers document questions with citations, now generally available in select US regions.
items.why: Gives teams cited, high-quality answers from documents, without custom chatbot development.
items.title: Knowledge Assistant is now generally available

items.headline: Row filtering for Lakeflow Connect ingestion connectors
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect managed connectors can now ingest only rows matching SQL-style conditions, for Google Analytics, Salesforce and ServiceNow.
items.why: Cuts load times and duplicate data by ingesting only needed records.
items.title: Row filtering for managed ingestion connectors (Beta)

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.1 Codex Max and Codex Mini hosted models
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving adds two OpenAI code-focused models, available pay-per-token through Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams specialised code generation and refactoring models without leaving Databricks.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.1 Codex Max and Codex Mini now available as Databricks-hosted models

items.headline: Dashboard pivot tables, filters and Excel export improvements
items.summary: Dashboards gain pivoted Excel downloads, total rows for pivot tables, resizable widgets, multi-select paste and timezone fixes.
items.why: Excel exports now match the pivot layout you see on screen.
items.title: Dashboard pivot tables, filters, and data export improvements

items.headline: Genie Agent adds PDF export, citations and accuracy gains
items.summary: Research Agent reports now export as PDFs in Beta, Genie cites its SQL examples, and currency formatting and question handling are refined.
items.why: Faster, more traceable answers and shareable reports for stakeholders who need evidence.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) PDF export, citations, and accuracy improvements

items.headline: Toyota adopts Databricks for unified data and AI platform
items.summary: Toyota is adopting the Databricks Data + AI Platform, called vista, to democratise data and deliver AI-ready data across applications.
items.why: Shows large-scale enterprise adoption of Databricks for unified data and AI.
items.title: Toyota Adopts Databricks to Power its Unified Data and AI Platform, “vista”

items.headline: Create skills for Databricks Assistant
items.summary: Users can now create skills that extend Databricks Assistant's Agent mode with domain-specific capabilities, loaded automatically when relevant.
items.why: Lets teams tailor the assistant to specialised tasks using the open Agent Skills standard.
items.title: Create skills for Databricks Assistant

items.headline: Email notifications for expiring personal access tokens
items.summary: Databricks now emails users automatically before their personal access tokens expire.
items.why: Helps avoid broken integrations and reduces risk from forgotten long-lived credentials.
items.title: Automatic email notifications for expiring personal access tokens (GA)

items.headline: Default Consumer access for new workspace users
items.summary: Admins can set new users to get Consumer access by default via group cloning, without the standard workspace interface.
items.why: Streamlines onboarding of business users at scale while keeping existing users' access unchanged.
items.title: Change default workspace access to Consumer access (Public Preview)

items.headline: Databricks Assistant Agent mode rolls out to most customers
items.summary: Agent mode now runs multi-step tasks from one prompt, enabled by default for most customers; admins can disable it.
items.why: Automates retrieving data, writing and running code, and fixing errors, with admin control.
items.title: Databricks Assistant Agent mode is now in Public Preview

items.headline: Single-use refresh tokens for OAuth applications
items.summary: Customers can now require OAuth refresh tokens to be single-use, rotating after each use.
items.why: Strengthens protection for user-to-machine authentication flows by rotating tokens after each use.
items.title: Single-use refresh tokens for OAuth applications

items.headline: Claude Haiku 4.5 hosted model on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Claude Haiku 4.5, accessible pay-per-token through Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Gives teams a fast Anthropic model without managing hosting, billed per token.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: New accounts lose legacy features, Unity Catalog only
items.summary: Accounts created after 18 December 2025 lose DBFS root, Hive Metastore and no-isolation shared compute, using Unity Catalog only.
items.why: Ensures new accounts start with Unity Catalog governance and enterprise-grade security.
items.title: New Databricks accounts will not have access to legacy features

items.headline: Lakebase adds a Metrics dashboard for health monitoring
items.summary: Lakebase App now has a Metrics dashboard showing CPU, RAM, connections, storage, cache and replication graphs, filterable by branch, compute and time range.
items.why: Lets teams spot database performance and health issues without leaving Lakebase.
items.title: Lakebase metrics dashboard

items.headline: Ingest Meta Ads data into Databricks
items.summary: Databricks can now ingest data from Meta Ads through Lakeflow Connect, with setup instructions in the documentation.
items.why: Lets teams bring Meta advertising data into their lakehouse alongside other sources.
items.title: Meta Ads connector (Beta)

items.headline: ai_parse_document quality improvements for tables and layout
items.summary: ai_parse_document adds strikethrough support and better parsing of short, narrow tables and dense layouts.
items.why: Cleaner extraction from scanned forms, tax documents and tables, reducing manual correction.
items.title: ai_parse_document quality improvements: strikethrough, tables, and layout

items.headline: Notebooks now show latest scheduled job results
items.summary: Notebooks and notebook dashboards can now display the latest scheduled run and update the notebook with its results.
items.why: Lets teams check scheduled notebook outputs quickly without opening job runs.
items.title: View latest scheduled notebook job results

items.headline: Dashboard filter, chart and agent widget improvements
items.summary: Dashboards gain boolean alias formatting, relative date ranges, sortable filter options, custom chart labels, and several bug fixes.
items.why: Makes filters and charts more flexible, and fixes several dashboard display issues.
items.title: Dashboard enhancements and fixes

items.headline: Genie gets better number formatting and entity matching
items.summary: Genie now formats numeric columns better, fixes file uploads for CAN MANAGE users, and scans far more rows for matching.
items.why: Clearer numbers and better value matching improve answers to everyday questions.
items.title: Genie enhancements and fixes

items.headline: MySQL connector now in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now offers a fully managed MySQL connector for incremental ingestion from MySQL databases, including cloud-hosted variants.
items.why: Lets teams pull MySQL data into Databricks incrementally without building custom pipelines.
items.title: MySQL connector in Lakeflow Connect (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakebase SQL editor gains read-write connections
items.summary: Lakebase users can now connect directly from the SQL editor with full read-write access.
items.why: Lets teams query and change Lakebase data without leaving the workspace.
items.title: Connect to Lakebase from the SQL editor with read-write access

items.headline: Flexible node types fall back when instances unavailable
items.summary: Compute can fall back to compatible alternative instance types when the specified type is unavailable.
items.why: Fewer failed compute launches caused by instance capacity shortages.
items.title: Flexible node types are now generally available

items.headline: Context-based ingress control lets admins set trusted access rules
items.summary: Account admins can now set allow and deny rules combining caller identity, request type, network source and reachable resources.
items.why: Ensures only trusted identity, request and network combinations reach workspaces, consistently across workspaces.
items.title: Context based ingress control is now in Public Preview

items.headline: New resource types for Databricks Apps
items.summary: Databricks Apps can now use MLflow experiments, vector search indexes, UDFs and Unity Catalog connections as resources.
items.why: Lets app builders connect apps directly to governed data, models and functions.
items.title: New resource types for Databricks Apps

items.headline: Gemini 3 Flash model hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Google's Gemini 3 Flash is now served as a Databricks-hosted model for multimodal tasks.
items.why: Offers speed and scale for video analysis, data extraction and visual Q&A.
items.title: Gemini 3 Flash now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Lakebase adds access control lists for project permissions
items.summary: Lakebase now supports access control lists, letting admins grant CAN CREATE or CAN MANAGE on projects.
items.why: Gives tighter control over who can create and manage Lakebase project resources.
items.title: Lakebase ACL support

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds PostgreSQL ingestion connector
items.summary: Databricks' fully managed PostgreSQL connector for Lakeflow Connect enables incremental ingestion from PostgreSQL databases across major clouds and on-premises.
items.why: Simplifies loading operational PostgreSQL data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: PostgreSQL connector in Lakeflow Connect (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakeflow Connect adds managed Confluence ingestion
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect can now ingest Confluence spaces, pages, attachments, blogposts, labels and classification levels.
items.why: Brings wiki content into Databricks without building custom pipelines.
items.title: Confluence connector (Beta)

items.headline: Databricks grows 55% and raises over $4 billion
items.summary: Databricks passed a $4.8 billion revenue run-rate and is raising over $4 billion at a $134 billion valuation.
items.why: Signals investment momentum in Agent Bricks, Lakebase and Databricks Apps.
items.title: Databricks Grows >55% YoY, Surpasses $4.8B Revenue Run-Rate, and is Raising >$4B Series L at $134B Valuation

items.headline: Delta Sharing to external Iceberg clients
items.summary: Delta Sharing now lets external Iceberg clients such as Snowflake, Trino, Flink and Spark query shared tables with zero-copy access.
items.why: Lets teams share Delta data with Iceberg tools without copying it.
items.title: Delta Sharing to external Iceberg clients is in Public Preview

items.headline: Lakebase gets autoscaling, branching and scale-to-zero
items.summary: The new Lakebase version adds autoscaling compute, scale-to-zero, database branching, instant restore and a project-based interface on AWS. Usage is free for a limited time.
items.why: Lets teams trial a modern Postgres service free before billing starts January 2026.
items.title: Lakebase now in Public Preview

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.2 hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Databricks now hosts OpenAI's GPT-5.2, accessible through Foundation Model APIs with pay-per-token pricing.
items.why: Gives access to a frontier model without provisioning, billed per token.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.2 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Dashboard subscriptions to Microsoft Teams channels
items.summary: AI/BI dashboards can now send scheduled snapshots to Microsoft Teams channels, including PNG images, links and PDFs.
items.why: Keeps stakeholders updated inside Teams without opening Databricks.
items.title: Dashboard visualization enhancements and fixes

items.headline: Genie Research Agent gets single reasoning agent
items.summary: Genie Research Agent (Beta) now uses one reasoning agent for hypotheses and SQL, plus minor monitoring and API fixes.
items.why: Research Agent should follow instructions better, with more concise reports and lower latency.
items.title: Genie enhancements and fixes

items.headline: Admin settings to disable legacy features
items.summary: Account and workspace admins can turn off DBFS, Hive Metastore and no-isolation shared compute to speed Unity Catalog migration.
items.why: Blocks legacy access paths, helping lock in Unity Catalog governance during migration.
items.title: Disable legacy features settings are now GA

items.headline: Auto Loader discovers files efficiently using file events
items.summary: Auto Loader file events combine notification speed with the simplicity of directory listing for file discovery.
items.why: Recommended approach for Auto Loader with Unity Catalog, offering faster file discovery with simpler setup.
items.title: Discover files in Auto Loader efficiently using file events

items.headline: Fully managed Microsoft Dynamics 365 connector in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect can ingest data from Dynamics 365 apps such as Sales, Customer Service and Finance & Operations.
items.why: Lets teams bring Dynamics customer and finance data into Databricks without custom pipelines.
items.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 connector (Public Preview)

items.headline: Customisable SharePoint connector for Delta tables
items.summary: Introduces a customisable SharePoint connector that ingests structured, semi-structured and unstructured files into Delta tables, with control over schema inference and parsing.
items.why: Gives finer control over file ingestion from SharePoint into Delta tables.
items.title: Customizable SharePoint connector (Beta)

items.headline: NetSuite connector for ingesting data
items.summary: Databricks now lets you ingest NetSuite data via the API, CLI or notebooks.
items.why: Simplifies loading NetSuite ERP data into Databricks for analytics teams.
items.title: NetSuite connector (Public Preview)

items.headline: ForEachBatch for Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Pipelines can now process streams as Python micro-batches, writing to arbitrary data sinks via a ForEachBatch sink.
items.why: Lets pipelines write streaming data to any sink, not just supported formats.
items.title: ForEachBatch for Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow is available (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakeflow system tables gain new job monitoring columns
items.summary: New columns give richer job, task and pipeline monitoring and troubleshooting data in Lakeflow system tables.
items.why: Helps teams track job reliability, runtimes and failures with more detail.
items.title: New columns in Lakeflow system tables (Public Preview)

items.headline: Reranker for Vector Search improves retrieval quality
items.summary: The Vector Search reranker is now generally available, helping reorder retrieved results by relevance.
items.why: Better retrieval quality for AI and search apps built on Vector Search.
items.title: Vector Search reranker is now generally available

items.headline: Delta Sharing tokens now expire within one year
items.summary: New open sharing tokens last at most one year; existing long-lived tokens expire on 25 February 2027.
items.why: Long-lived tokens will break integrations, so review and renew them before February 2027.
items.title: New token expiration policy for open Delta Sharing

items.headline: Genie Research Agent and answer improvements
items.summary: Genie asks clearer clarifying questions, tidies Research Agent, adds benchmark explanations, and improves answer readability.
items.why: Fewer misread answers and easier review of agent reasoning and benchmark errors.
items.title: Genie Research Agent, benchmark, and answer improvements

items.headline: Dashboards gain per-series labels and download fixes
items.summary: Dashboards can now label individual series, and downloads again offer CSV, TSV and Excel formats.
items.why: Lets you label key series without cluttering every line, and restores export formats.
items.title: Dashboard visualization enhancements and fixes

items.headline: Built-in support for reading Excel files
items.summary: Databricks can now read Excel files directly into Spark DataFrames without external libraries.
items.why: Lets teams query Excel spreadsheets without extra libraries or manual conversion.
items.title: Built-in Excel file format support (Beta)

items.headline: Genie Agent limits and Research Agent improvements
items.summary: Genie Agent now allows 200 SQL snippets and JOIN relationships, Research Agent shows starter questions, and benchmarks are auto-suggested.
items.why: Higher limits and suggested benchmarks make building and testing agents easier.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) limits and Research Agent improvements

items.headline: Faster pivot tables in Databricks dashboards
items.summary: Pivot table headers now render significantly faster, with less scroll lag in dashboards.
items.why: Smoother scrolling for large pivot tables in dashboards you share with stakeholders.
items.title: Dashboard visualization enhancements

items.headline: Stream progress metrics for Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Querying the event log for stream progress metrics in Spark Declarative Pipelines is now generally available.
items.why: Lets teams check streaming pipeline progress straight from the event log.
items.title: Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow stream progress metrics are generally available

items.headline: Claude Opus 4.5 hosted model on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.5, usable via pay-per-token Foundation Model APIs, reasoning, vision and batch workloads.
items.why: Gives customers access to a frontier model for reasoning, vision and batch.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.5 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Real-time collaboration in notebooks, files and SQL editor
items.summary: Multiple users can now edit the same notebook cell at once and see each other's changes.
items.why: Speeds up teamwork on notebooks and SQL without swapping files or screen-sharing.
items.title: Real-time collaboration in notebook cells, files, and SQL editor

items.headline: Automate classic workspace creation with AWS IAM temporary delegation
items.summary: Classic workspaces can now be created automatically, with Databricks given temporary access to provision AWS resources.
items.why: Speeds up setup and replaces the AWS Quickstart template.
items.title: Automate classic workspace creation with AWS IAM temporary delegation

items.headline: Run Git CLI commands in Git folders
items.summary: Users can now run standard Git commands directly from the web terminal in Git folders.
items.why: Lets developers use familiar Git workflows without leaving Databricks.
items.title: Use Git CLI commands in Git folders (Beta)

items.headline: Genie APIs and Research Agent for deeper insights
items.summary: Genie Create and Update APIs enter Beta, the Get API returns serialised agent definitions, and Research Agent adds multi-step reasoning for complex business questions.
items.why: Enables programmatic Genie management and deeper analysis of complex business questions.
items.title: Genie APIs and Research Agent in Beta

items.headline: Dashboard counters gain sparklines and multi-filter application
items.summary: Counters can now show sparklines over time, and dashboards can apply several filters at once alongside instant application.
items.why: Makes trend tracking quicker and filtering more flexible for dashboard viewers.
items.title: Dashboard visualization improvements and bug fixes

items.headline: Email alerts before personal access tokens expire
items.summary: Workspace users now receive automatic email notifications about seven days before their personal access tokens expire.
items.why: Reduces unexpected access failures and helps users rotate credentials before they lapse.
items.title: Automatic email notifications for expiring personal access tokens (Public Preview)

items.headline: Configure compute size for Databricks Apps
items.summary: Apps can now be given a chosen compute size, controlling CPU, memory and cost.
items.why: Lets teams match app resources to workload needs and manage running costs.
items.title: Configure compute size for Databricks Apps (Public Preview)

items.headline: Google Gemini 3 Pro now hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Google Gemini 3 Pro, usable via Foundation Model APIs for reasoning, vision and batch.
items.why: Gives customers another frontier model for reasoning, vision and batch AI workloads.
items.title: Google Gemini 3 Pro Preview now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: ABAC-secured assets shared using Delta Sharing
items.summary: ABAC policies can now be applied to tables and schemas shared through Delta Sharing, in preview.
items.why: Lets you share governed data externally while keeping attribute-based access controls intact.
items.title: ABAC-secured assets shared using Delta Sharing is in Public Preview

items.headline: Jobs can now trigger on source view updates
items.summary: Table update triggers for jobs now accept views as sources, when the view references supported table types.
items.why: Saves manual job runs by reacting to changes in views you already use.
items.title: Jobs can now be triggered on source view update

items.headline: Connect Genie Agents to Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.summary: Genie Agents can now be added as tools in Microsoft Copilot Studio agents, enabled via the Managed MCP Servers preview.
items.why: Lets Microsoft agents query governed Databricks data through Genie.
items.title: Connect Genie Agents to Microsoft Copilot Studio (Public Preview)

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5.1 hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts OpenAI GPT-5.1, usable via pay-per-token endpoints, reasoning, vision and batch AI Functions.
items.why: Lets teams query OpenAI's latest model directly from Databricks workloads and batch jobs.
items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.1 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Less downtime during managed database connector full refresh
items.summary: Full refreshes for managed database connectors such as SQL Server now delay table updates until the snapshot completes, keeping existing data available.
items.why: Fewer timeouts and less downtime when re-syncing database tables from SQL Server.
items.title: Improved full refresh flow for managed database connectors

items.headline: Databricks SQL alerts get a new editing experience
items.summary: The new version of Databricks SQL alerts adds a redesigned editing experience.
items.why: Makes data alerts easier for analysts to set up and manage.
items.title: Databricks SQL alerts are now in Public Preview

items.headline: Governed JDBC connections to external databases via Unity Catalog
items.summary: Unity Catalog now offers JDBC connections to external databases, usable from Spark and the Remote Query SQL API.
items.why: Reuse one governed connection across serverless and standard compute; credentials stay hidden from users.
items.title: JDBC Unity Catalog connection in Beta

items.headline: SFTP connector in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now ingests files from SFTP servers using Auto Loader, in Public Preview.
items.why: Lets teams pull files from SFTP servers without custom ingestion code.
items.title: SFTP connector (Public Preview)

items.headline: Dashboards gain better search and Genie embedding
items.summary: Dashboard search now covers names, widgets, descriptions and queries, and embedded dashboards can show the Ask Genie button.
items.why: Makes dashboards easier to find and lets embedded viewers ask Genie questions.
items.title: Dashboard search and embedding enhancements

items.headline: Convert foreign tables to Unity Catalog tables
items.summary: You can now convert Hive Metastore and AWS Glue foreign tables to Unity Catalog managed or external tables, keeping history and configuration.
items.why: Moves legacy metastore tables into Unity Catalog governance without losing history or settings.
items.title: Convert foreign tables to Unity Catalog managed or external tables (Public Preview)

items.headline: Dashboard filters and metric view metadata support
items.summary: AI/BI dashboards now read metric view formatting and display names, and per-widget filters support date and number ranges.
items.why: Keeps metric view definitions consistent across dashboards and simplifies filtering.
items.title: Dashboard filter and counter enhancements

items.headline: Genie gains better charts and empty-result explanations
items.summary: Genie now explains empty query results, builds higher-quality auto-generated charts and formats dates better.
items.why: Clearer answers and charts for business users asking questions in Genie.
items.title: Genie visualization and query result improvements

items.headline: Workspace tab lists MCP servers
items.summary: A new MCP Servers tab in the workspace shows managed and external servers, plus a curated Marketplace list to install.
items.why: Makes it easier to find, manage and install MCP servers for agents.
items.title: New MCP server tab

items.headline: SAP BDC connector adds cross-cloud data sharing
items.summary: Customers can now share data between different cloud environments using the SAP Business Data Cloud Connector for Databricks.
items.why: Simplifies SAP data access for Databricks users across different cloud platforms.
items.title: SAP BDC connector for Databricks supports cross-cloud sharing

items.headline: Databricks Marketplace now lists MCP servers
items.summary: Providers can now list MCP servers in Databricks Marketplace, and users can install them to connect AI agents to external tools and data.
items.why: Gives agents easier access to external data sources and SaaS tools through Marketplace.
items.title: List MCP servers in Databricks Marketplace (Public Preview)

items.headline: Qwen3-Next Instruct gains function calling and structured output
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now supports function calling and structured output with Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3-Next 80B model.
items.why: Lets teams build agents and apps that call tools with reliable JSON output.
items.title: Function calling and structured output now available using the Alibaba Cloud Qwen3-Next Instruct model (Beta)

items.headline: Attribute-based access control (ABAC) expands to account level
items.summary: ABAC now applies policies account-wide across all attached workspaces, with automatic column mask type casting.
items.why: Lets governed tags control access consistently across every workspace on the metastore.
items.title: Attribute-based access control (ABAC) now in Public Preview

items.headline: Audit logs now record request-for-access events
items.summary: Actions on access request destinations, currently in Public Preview, are now recorded in audit logs.
items.why: Gives governance teams a clear trail of access request activity for compliance.
items.title: Audit logs for request-for-access events are now emitted

items.headline: JAR tasks now supported on serverless compute
items.summary: Jobs can now run JAR tasks on serverless compute.
items.why: Lets teams run existing JAR workloads on serverless, simplifying infrastructure management.
items.title: JAR tasks are now supported on serverless compute

items.headline: Disable DBFS root and mounts in workspaces
items.summary: Workspace admins can now disable access to the DBFS root and mounts in existing workspaces.
items.why: Restricts legacy DBFS storage access, reducing risk and pushing teams towards Unity Catalog.
items.title: Disable DBFS root and mounts workspace setting is GA

items.headline: Salesforce connector adds history tracking
items.summary: Salesforce managed connectors in Lakeflow Connect can now keep history of changes using SCD type 2.
items.why: Keeps a full audit trail of Salesforce changes instead of overwriting outdated records.
items.title: Salesforce ingestion connector supports history tracking (SCD type 2)

items.headline: Skip individual notebook cells with %skip
items.summary: Notebook users can now skip individual cells when running multiple cells, using the %skip magic command.
items.why: Saves time by leaving out cells you don't need during notebook runs.
items.title: Skip cells when running notebooks

items.headline: Notebook debugger now supports multi-file debugging
items.summary: The Python notebook debugger can now set breakpoints and step into functions across multiple workspace files.
items.why: Makes debugging code spanning several workspace files much easier.
items.title: Improved notebook debugger experience

items.headline: Databricks SQL 2025.35 adds metric view metadata
items.summary: Preview release adds metric view semantic metadata to DESCRIBE output, plus new SQL functions, spatial ring functions and recursive CTE support.
items.why: Shows semantic metadata for metric views in DESCRIBE, aiding discovery and BI tool use.
items.title: Databricks SQL version 2025.35 is now available in Preview

items.headline: Lakebase new version launches on AWS with autoscaling
items.summary: A new Lakebase version is available on AWS with autoscaling, scale-to-zero, database branching, instant restore and project-based organisation, separate from the Public Preview.
items.why: Brings autoscaling, branching and instant restore to Postgres workloads on Databricks.
items.title: Lakebase (Beta) now available

items.headline: Dashboard visualisation, pivot table and authoring improvements
items.summary: Dashboards add Slack channel subscriptions, export datasets to materialised views, and new pivot table and legend options.
items.why: Easier sharing, faster dashboards and cleaner pivot tables for everyday reporting.
items.title: Dashboard visualization, pivot table, and authoring improvements

items.headline: Genie explains its SQL logic in plain language
items.summary: Genie now explains its SQL logic in plain language, and table previews show schema, owner and last updated time.
items.why: Helps non-technical users trust answers and find the right data source faster.
items.title: Genie thinking steps and benchmark error resolution

items.headline: Supervisor Agent adds Unity Catalog functions and MCP servers
items.summary: Supervisor Agent can now delegate tasks to Unity Catalog functions and external MCP servers as tools.
items.why: Lets multi-agent systems use governed catalog functions and external tools.
items.title: Supervisor Agent now supports Unity Catalog functions and external MCP servers

items.headline: New compute policy form lets admins use dropdowns
items.summary: Admins can configure compute policies using dropdown menus instead of learning policy syntax.
items.why: Lets admins write policies without learning policy syntax, saving time.
items.title: New compute policy form is now generally available

items.headline: OpenAI GPT-5 models arrive in Mosaic AI Model Serving
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5, GPT-5 mini and GPT-5 nano models can now be used in Mosaic AI Model Serving.
items.why: Gives teams production-ready access to newer OpenAI models within Databricks.
items.title: OpenAI GPT 5 models are now generally available in Mosaic AI Model Serving

items.headline: ai_parse_document now reads coloured text and handwriting
items.summary: The ai_parse_document function now recognises coloured text and documents mixing handwritten and digital text more accurately.
items.why: Improves extraction accuracy for scanned forms and mixed-format documents.
items.title: ai_parse_document quality improvements: colored text and handwriting

items.headline: Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash now on pay-per-token endpoints
items.summary: Model Serving adds Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash via Foundation Model APIs pay-per-token, with function calling and structured output.
items.why: Gives teams another frontier model option, with tool calling and structured outputs for batch work.
items.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash models now supported on pay-per-token endpoints

items.headline: Parse documents with the ai_parse_document function
items.summary: The ai_parse_document function extracts content from documents directly in SQL and is now in Public Preview.
items.why: Lets teams pull text from documents into SQL pipelines without separate tooling.
items.title: ai_parse_document (Public Preview)

items.headline: Genie benchmarks scale to 500 with selective runs
items.summary: Genie Agents now support up to 500 benchmarks, selective benchmark runs, and Unity Catalog SQL functions as answers.
items.why: Lets teams test Genie more thoroughly before relying on its answers.
items.title: Genie benchmark scaling and SQL function support

items.headline: Zerobus Ingest connector arrives in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: Lakeflow Connect now offers Zerobus Ingest, a gRPC API for record-by-record writes directly into Delta tables.
items.why: Offers a direct route for streaming individual records into Delta tables.
items.title: Zerobus Ingest connector in Lakeflow Connect (Public Preview)

items.headline: Dashboard publishing and field management improvements
items.summary: Dashboards gain a waterfall chart, over 170 custom calculation functions, drag-to-reorder fields, and Notify viewers off by default.
items.why: Adds richer chart types and calculations, and fewer accidental viewer notifications when publishing.
items.title: Dashboard publishing, scheduling, and field management improvements

items.headline: Qwen3-Next Instruct hosted on Mosaic AI Model Serving
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Alibaba's Qwen3-Next 80B A3B Instruct model in two regions, pay-per-token.
items.why: Gives access to another open model via pay-per-token, but limited to two regions.
items.title: Alibaba Cloud Qwen3-Next Instruct now available in Beta

items.headline: Compatibility Mode lets external engines read Unity Catalog tables
items.summary: Generates read-only, automatically synced copies of Unity Catalog tables and views for external Delta and Iceberg clients like Athena, Snowflake and Fabric.
items.why: Lets customers share lakehouse data with other engines without losing performance.
items.title: Compatibility Mode (Public Preview)

items.headline: Zstd becomes default compression for new managed tables
items.summary: New managed tables in Runtime 16.0 and above default to Zstd instead of Snappy; existing tables keep their codec.
items.why: Better compression can cut storage costs for new tables without any action.
items.title: Zstd is now the default compression for new managed tables

items.headline: Unified runs list for jobs and pipelines
items.summary: Monitor job and pipeline runs together in one unified list, now in Public Preview.
items.why: Tracks jobs and pipelines in one place, simplifying operational monitoring.
items.title: Unified runs list (Public Preview)

items.headline: Databricks SQL alerts open in multi-tab editor
items.summary: Creating or editing alerts now uses a new multi-tab editor for a unified workflow.
items.why: Gives a single, consistent workflow for building and changing SQL alerts.
items.title: New alert editing experience

items.headline: Databricks Connector for Google Sheets adds saved queries
items.summary: Users can now save queries inside a Google Sheet, making data refresh, query reuse and editing easier.
items.why: Simplifies refreshing and reusing Databricks data in spreadsheets for business users.
items.title: Databricks Connector for Google Sheets offers additional features (Public Preview)

items.headline: Edit and deploy Declarative Automation Bundles in workspace
items.summary: Teams can now edit, commit, test and deploy bundle updates together through the workspace UI.
items.why: Makes shared deployment work easier for teams without leaving the workspace.
items.title: Declarative Automation Bundles in the workspace is GA

items.headline: Genie gains API previews and clearer benchmark explanations
items.summary: Genie adds SQL measures to knowledge stores, auto-summarises query results, explains incorrect benchmarks, and moves several API endpoints to Public Preview.
items.why: Helps tune Genie answers and simplifies building on its API.
items.title: Genie API updates, benchmark explanations, and JOIN improvements

items.headline: Tag dashboards and Genie Agents for organisation
items.summary: Dashboards and Genie Agents can now carry tags for organisation and automation, such as via the API.
items.why: Helps teams organise workspaces and automate dashboard workflows through the API.
items.title: Dashboard and Genie Agents tagging (Public Preview)

items.headline: Jobs can now run when source tables update
items.summary: Databricks Jobs can now be triggered automatically when a source table is updated.
items.why: Enables event-driven pipelines without polling or manual scheduling, reducing latency and wasted compute.
items.title: Jobs can now be triggered on source table update

items.headline: Dashboard pivot tables, gridlines and drill-through improvements
items.summary: Dashboards gain text functions in pivot tables, gridline toggles, drill-through without target filters, and dashboard tags in preview.
items.why: Makes dashboard formatting, filtering and organisation easier, with tags enabling automation.
items.title: Dashboard pivot tables, gridlines, and drill-through enhancements

items.headline: Backfill older data with Databricks Jobs runs
items.summary: Jobs can now trigger runs that backfill older data or repair failed processing.
items.why: Speeds up loading historical data and fixing failed pipeline runs.
items.title: Create backfill job runs

items.headline: Multimodal support for Mosaic AI Model Serving
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now accepts multimodal inputs for hosted foundation models, covering real-time and batch inference.
items.why: Lets teams build vision-based apps on Databricks-hosted models, for both live and batch use.
items.title: Multimodal support is now available

items.headline: Mosaic AI Model Serving autoscaling ignores brief traffic surges
items.summary: Model Serving autoscaling now ignores very brief traffic spikes and responds only to sustained load increases, cutting costs.
items.why: Lower serving costs without affecting performance or reliability for bursty workloads.
items.title: Improved autoscaling behavior for Mosaic AI Model Serving

items.headline: SQL MCP server lets AI agents query Unity Catalog
items.summary: Databricks now offers a managed SQL MCP server letting AI agents run SQL queries on Unity Catalog tables via SQL warehouses.
items.why: Lets agents query Unity Catalog data through a managed, standard interface.
items.title: SQL MCP server now available (Beta)

items.headline: Context-based ingress control for trusted workspace access
items.summary: Account admins can now set allow and deny rules combining caller identity, request type, and network source.
items.why: Lets one policy enforce consistent access rules across all your workspaces.
items.title: Context based ingress control (Beta)

items.headline: AI/BI dashboards gain table, chart and calculation improvements
items.summary: Dashboards now offer adjustable line thickness, copyable table links, better pivot headers, and DISTINCT, FILTER and extra predicates in custom calculations.
items.why: Makes dashboards easier to tune, share and calculate without complex CASE statements.
items.title: AI/BI dashboard table and text widget improvements

items.headline: Genie adds easier benchmark creation and faster answers
items.summary: Space editors can save chat answers and generate SQL as benchmarks, and Genie's simplified reasoning slightly lowers latency.
items.why: Makes Genie more accurate to set up and slightly faster to respond.
items.title: Genie knowledge store enhancements and benchmark improvements

items.headline: Data Science Agent can now use Anthropic models
items.summary: The Databricks Assistant's Data Science Agent can now use Anthropic models served on Databricks, when partner-powered AI features are enabled.
items.why: Gives data science users a choice of Anthropic models, hosted within Databricks' security perimeter.
items.title: The Data Science Agent can now also use models served through Anthropic on Databricks

items.headline: Mosaic AI Model Serving adds OpenAI GPT-5 models
items.summary: GPT-5, GPT-5 mini and GPT-5 nano are now in Public Preview, by request through account teams, for batch and real-time inference.
items.why: Lets teams use the latest OpenAI models for batch AI Functions.
items.title: Mosaic AI Model Serving now supports OpenAI GPT 5 models (preview)

items.headline: Certification status system tag for certified or deprecated assets
items.summary: Assets across catalogs, tables, dashboards and Genie Agents can now be marked as certified or deprecated.
items.why: Builds trust in analytics and AI workloads and helps users find reliable data.
items.title: Certification status system tag is in Public Preview

items.headline: Delta Sharing recipients apply row filters and column masks
items.summary: Recipients can now apply their own row filters and column masks to shared tables, though providers still cannot share secured tables.
items.why: Lets recipients enforce their own access controls on shared data.
items.title: Delta Sharing recipients can apply row filters and column masks (GA)

items.headline: Partition metadata logging for Unity Catalog external tables
items.summary: Partition metadata logging is now available as a partition discovery strategy for external tables registered in Unity Catalog.
items.why: Gives a partition discovery option for external tables governed in Unity Catalog.
items.title: Partition metadata is generally available

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5 hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Mosaic AI Model Serving now hosts Claude Sonnet 4.5, accessible pay-per-token through Foundation Model APIs.
items.why: Lets teams use Anthropic's model without separate vendor contracts or infrastructure.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5 now available as a Databricks-hosted model

items.headline: Prompt caching for Claude models
items.summary: Databricks-hosted Claude models now support prompt caching via cache_control, covering thinking messages, images and tool definitions.
items.why: Caching repeated content can cut latency and token costs for Claude-based applications.
items.title: Prompt caching is now supported for Claude models

items.headline: Notebook improvements for navigation, diagnostics and sessions
items.summary: Notebooks gain a cell status minimap, Assistant help with environment errors, automatic serverless session restoration and larger IPYNB support.
items.why: Faster navigation, quicker fixes and fewer lost sessions on serverless notebooks.
items.title: Notebook improvements

items.headline: Claude Sonnet 4 now supports batch inference in US
items.summary: Claude Sonnet 4 can now run batch inference via ai_query in US regions.
items.why: Lets teams run large unstructured-data jobs with a leading model at scale.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4 is available for batch inference in US regions

items.headline: AI/BI dashboards add metric view field browsing and copy-paste
items.summary: Authors can now preview fields and measures from metric views in the Add data dialog, and copy widgets and pages between dashboards.
items.why: Lets analysts see metric view definitions before building dashboards, speeding up semantic-layer dashboard work.
items.title: AI/BI dashboard enhancements and global filters improvements

items.headline: Genie Agent adds metric views and thinking steps
items.summary: Genie spaces now accept metric views alongside tables, and each response shows its interpreted prompt, tables and SQL.
items.why: Analyse metric views with tables in one place and audit how Genie answers.
items.title: Genie Agent (formerly Genie Space) enhancements and thinking trace features

items.headline: Semantic metadata now supported in metric views
items.summary: Metric views can now hold semantic metadata that helps Genie Agents and AI/BI dashboards interpret data.
items.why: Gives AI tools clearer business context, so answers from your data are more accurate.
items.title: Semantic metadata support for metric views

items.headline: Convert external tables to Unity Catalog managed tables
items.summary: The ALTER TABLE SET MANAGED command now converts Unity Catalog external tables into managed tables.
items.why: Unlocks managed table governance, reliability and performance features for existing tables.
items.title: Convert to Unity Catalog managed table from external table

items.headline: Pipeline update timeline table now available
items.summary: Adds a system table giving full historical tracking of pipeline updates, triggers, results and compute usage.
items.why: Helps teams audit pipeline run history and compute usage for cost and reliability.
items.title: Pipeline update timeline table is now available (Public Preview)

items.headline: Data intelligence for cybersecurity from Databricks
items.summary: Databricks unveils a unified platform for AI agent systems to respond faster to AI-driven threats.
items.why: Helps security teams respond more accurately and in real time to AI-driven threats.
items.title: Databricks Announces Data Intelligence for Cybersecurity

items.headline: Lakeflow Pipelines Editor shows pipelines as files
items.summary: Pipelines are now edited as files in one place, with Python and SQL as the default format.
items.why: New pipelines default to Python and SQL files, so check existing workflows.
items.title: Lakeflow Pipelines Editor is now in public preview

items.headline: Claude Opus 4.1 hosted on Databricks
items.summary: Databricks now hosts Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.1, accessible via Foundation Model APIs on pay-per-token pricing.
items.why: Lets teams use Claude Opus 4.1 without provisioning their own model endpoints.
items.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.1 now available as a Databricks-hosted foundation model

items.headline: Databricks SQL 2025.30 adds temporary metric views
items.summary: Databricks SQL 2025.30 is in Preview, adding temporary metric views visible only to their session, plus more.
items.why: Lets analysts create short-lived semantic layer definitions without cluttering shared catalogues.
items.title: Databricks SQL version 2025.30 is now available in Preview

items.headline: Genie benchmarks now run in the background
items.summary: Genie benchmarks now run in the background, appear in the toolbar, and prompt reruns after instruction changes.
items.why: Makes benchmarking Genie spaces easier, so accuracy checks happen more often.
items.title: Genie benchmarks and JOIN relationship enhancements

items.headline: Databricks and OpenAI partner on Agent Bricks
items.summary: Databricks and OpenAI announce a $100 million partnership bringing OpenAI models natively to Databricks, including Agent Bricks.
items.why: Gives 20,000+ customers native access to OpenAI models within their data platform.
items.title: Databricks and OpenAI Launch Groundbreaking Partnership to Bring Frontier Intelligence to Enterprises with Databricks Agent Bricks

items.headline: Migrate Spark Declarative Pipelines to default publishing mode
items.summary: Pipelines can now move from legacy single-catalog publishing to the default mode supporting multiple catalogs and schemas.
items.why: Lets teams publish pipeline outputs across several catalogs and schemas, with earlier migration issues fixed.
items.title: Migrate Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow pipelines from legacy publishing mode is generally available

items.headline: Mosaic AI Agent Framework adds Lakebase authentication passthrough
items.summary: Agents built with Mosaic AI Agent Framework can now pass authentication automatically to Lakebase resources.
items.why: Simplifies secure agent access to Lakebase, reducing manual credential management.
items.title: Mosaic AI Agent Framework supports automatic authentication passthrough for Lakebase resources

items.headline: LSEG and Databricks partner on AI-ready financial data
items.summary: LSEG's financial data becomes available natively within Databricks, for building governed AI agents with Agent Bricks.
items.why: Lets financial teams build governed AI agents on premium market data without leaving Databricks.
items.title: LSEG and Databricks Partner to Bring AI-Ready Financial Data Natively to Databricks for Analytics, AI Apps and Agents

items.headline: Catalog Explorer can now generate SQL from questions
items.summary: Catalog Explorer's Assistant turns natural language questions about sample data into SQL, which you can validate and run.
items.why: Lets people query tables without writing SQL, using existing metadata context.
items.title: Explore table data using an LLM (Public Preview)

items.headline: AI/BI dashboards get Genie credential and publishing updates
items.summary: Dashboards published with embedded credentials run Genie queries under the publisher's credentials; the publish dialog is simplified and the Genie toggle moved to settings.
items.why: Clarifies whose data permissions Genie uses, and simplifies publishing dialog.
items.title: AI/BI dashboard Genie integration and publish dialog improvements

items.headline: Genie SQL gets better models, autocomplete and new APIs
items.summary: Genie's SQL author uses upgraded LLMs, adds SQL autocomplete, and gains feedback and follow-up question APIs.
items.why: Improves Genie accuracy and lets teams build feedback and follow-up features.
items.title: Genie SQL improvements, API enhancements, and bug fixes

items.headline: Genie One simplifies data access for business users
items.summary: A simplified interface for business users that lets them ask natural-language questions, view dashboards and use custom apps.
items.why: Lets non-technical staff use data and AI without notebooks, queries or compute knowledge.
items.title: Genie One Public Preview

items.headline: Auto Loader discovers files faster using file events
items.summary: The cloudFiles.useManagedFileEvents option is now ungated in Public Preview, letting Auto Loader discover files more efficiently.
items.why: Faster file discovery for ingestion pipelines without needing enrollment.
items.title: Discover files in Auto Loader efficiently using file events without enrollment (Public Preview)

items.headline: Delta Sharing now supports Lakehouse Federation tables
items.summary: You can now share foreign schemas and tables created with query federation via Databricks-to-Databricks and open sharing.
items.why: Lets teams share federated external data without copying it into their lakehouse.
items.title: Delta Sharing on Lakehouse Federation is in Beta

items.headline: Mount Delta Sharing shares to existing shared catalogs
items.summary: Recipients can now mount shares from providers into an existing shared catalog, instead of creating a new catalog per share.
items.why: Fewer catalogs to manage when receiving multiple shares from providers.
items.title: Mount Delta shares to an existing shared catalog

items.headline: Dashboard text widget gets better editor and performance fixes
items.summary: The AI/BI dashboard text widget gets a richer editor for formatting, links and images, plus fixes for slow page loads.
items.why: Easier formatting and fewer slowdowns make dashboards quicker to build and use.
items.title: AI/BI dashboard text widget and performance improvements

items.headline: Genie gains file uploads and chart fixes
items.summary: Genie now lets admins enable file uploads, plus fixes for charts, percentages, and cloning, and raises entity matching to 120 columns.
items.why: Better charts and percentage answers, plus more columns for entity matching.
items.title: Genie chart fixes and feature enhancements

items.headline: SAP Business Data Cloud connector for Databricks
items.summary: Databricks now offers secure, zero-copy data sharing with SAP Business Data Cloud, in both directions.
items.why: Lets customers analyse SAP data alongside Databricks without copying it.
items.title: The SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Connector for Databricks is generally available

items.headline: Stream progress metrics for Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Pipelines can now query the event log for metrics on stream progress.
items.why: Helps teams monitor streaming pipeline health and spot slowdowns more easily.
items.title: Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow now supports stream progress metrics in Public Preview

items.headline: Python custom data sources in Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Pipelines can now use Python custom data sources and sinks in their definitions.
items.why: Lets teams connect pipelines to bespoke sources and sinks using Python.
items.title: Python custom data sources can be used with Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow

items.headline: Google Analytics Raw Data connector for Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: The Google Analytics Raw Data connector in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available for ingestion.
items.why: Gives teams production-ready ingestion of Google Analytics 4 data into Databricks.
items.title: Google Analytics Raw Data connector GA

items.headline: Databricks Apps adds Genie Space resource support
items.summary: Databricks Apps can now include a Genie Space as a resource, enabling natural language querying over curated datasets.
items.why: Lets teams build apps with conversational access to governed, curated data.
items.title: Databricks Apps support for Genie resources

items.headline: Databricks passes $4 billion revenue run-rate
items.summary: Databricks reports a $4 billion revenue run-rate, including over $1 billion from AI, and is closing a $1 billion Series K.
items.why: Signals strong AI demand and a major valuation for the data platform.
items.title: Databricks Surpasses $4B Revenue Run-Rate, Exceeding $1B AI Revenue Run-Rate

items.headline: Databricks Online Feature Stores for low-latency features
items.summary: Low-latency feature serving built on Lakebase, kept consistent with offline feature tables and integrated with Unity Catalog, MLflow and Model Serving.
items.why: Lets production models and agents access fresh features securely at high speed.
items.title: Databricks Online Feature Stores (Public Preview)

items.headline: Databricks connector arrives in Microsoft Power Platform
items.summary: Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio can now connect directly to Databricks data.
items.why: Lets teams build apps, flows and agents on Databricks data without custom integration.
items.title: Databricks connector in Microsoft Power Platform is in Public Preview

items.headline: MLflow metadata in system tables
items.summary: MLflow tracking metadata can now be queried from system tables across the whole workspace, in one central place.
items.why: Lets teams analyse experiment data with dashboards, alerts and SQL alongside other data.
items.title: MLflow metadata is now available in system tables (Public Preview)

items.headline: Serverless GPU compute adds H100 accelerators
items.summary: On-demand H100 accelerators are now available for single-node serverless GPU workflows and jobs.
items.why: Lets teams run demanding AI workloads without managing GPU infrastructure.
items.title: Serverless GPU compute now supports H100 accelerators (Beta)

items.headline: Genie gains conversation APIs and better prompt matching
items.summary: Adds endpoints to list, delete and manage Genie conversations, and makes prompt matching generally available.
items.why: Lets developers manage Genie conversations programmatically and improves how prompts map to data values.
items.title: New Genie API endpoints and improved benchmarks

items.headline: AI/BI dashboards gain active filter bar
items.summary: Dashboards now show active filters in a bar, support minimum and maximum on dates, and label histogram bins with start and end.
items.why: Makes dashboard filters clearer and date analysis easier for stakeholders.
items.title: AI/BI dashboard active filter bar and visualization improvements

items.headline: Databricks Assistant Agent mode and Data Science Agent
items.summary: Agent mode lets the Assistant run multi-step workflows from one prompt, including a Data Science Agent that builds notebooks.
items.why: Automates end-to-end analysis, forecasting and machine learning work, saving data science time.
items.title: Databricks Assistant Agent mode: Data Science Agent is in Beta

items.headline: AI agents gain on-behalf-of-user authorisation
items.summary: Agents deployed to Model Serving endpoints can now act as the Databricks user running the query, for tighter access control.
items.why: Lets agents reach sensitive data under each user's own permissions.
items.title: AI agents: Authorize on-behalf-of-user Public Preview

items.headline: Delta Sharing extends to default storage tables
items.summary: Providers can now share default-storage tables with any recipient, open or Databricks, even on classic compute; partitioned tables excluded.
items.why: Broadens sharing options without moving data, though partitioned tables remain excluded.
items.title: Tables backed by default storage can be Delta shared to any recipient (Beta)

items.headline: SQL Server connector adds SCD type 2 history tracking
items.summary: The Lakeflow Connect SQL Server connector can now keep a history of source data changes, instead of overwriting them.
items.why: Lets you track how source records change over time for analysis.
items.title: SQL Server connector supports SCD type 2

items.headline: Dashboards now embeddable for external users
items.summary: Embedding dashboards for external users enters Public Preview, alongside more custom calculation functions and a 200-calculation limit.
items.why: Lets you share interactive dashboards with customers outside your organisation.
items.title: Dashboard external embedding Public Preview and new custom calculations functions

items.headline: Connect Databricks to external MCP servers
items.summary: Users can now connect Databricks to external MCP servers so agents can use tools outside Databricks.
items.why: Lets agents reach tools beyond Databricks, widening what they can do.
items.title: External MCP servers are in Beta

items.headline: Default SQL warehouse setting for workspaces and users
items.summary: Admins can set a workspace default warehouse, which users can override or replace with their own default.
items.why: Saves time selecting compute across SQL editor, dashboards and Genie.
items.title: Default warehouse setting is now available in Beta

items.headline: Admins can manage serverless base environments
items.summary: Workspace admins can now create, manage and set a default base environment for serverless notebooks.
items.why: Gives consistent, cached starting environments for every serverless notebook user in the workspace.
items.title: Admins can now manage a workspace's serverless base environments (Public Preview)

items.headline: Lakebase synced tables now support Iceberg and foreign tables
items.summary: Synced tables in Snapshot mode can now be created from Iceberg and foreign tables.
items.why: Brings lakehouse Iceberg and foreign data into Lakebase for serving applications.
items.title: Lakebase synced tables supports syncing Apache Iceberg and foreign tables in Snapshot mode

items.headline: Governed tags for consistent tagging across data assets
items.summary: Admins can now define allowed tag keys and values, and control who assigns them to catalogs, schemas and tables.
items.why: Standardises metadata for classification, cost tracking and access control across teams.
items.title: Governed tags are Public Preview

items.headline: OAuth token federation for securely accessing Databricks APIs
items.summary: Users can now access Databricks APIs with tokens from their identity provider, configured via UI, CLI or REST API.
items.why: Lets enterprises use existing identity provider logins for secure API access.
items.title: OAuth token federation is now GA

items.headline: INSERT REPLACE commands now available in Runtime 17.2
items.summary: INSERT REPLACE USING and INSERT REPLACE ON are now generally available in Databricks Runtime 17.2.
items.why: Simplifies selective data replacement with standard SQL, without separate delete and insert steps.
items.title: New INSERT REPLACE commands (GA)

items.headline: Microsoft SQL Server ingestion connector launches in Lakeflow Connect
items.summary: The Microsoft SQL Server ingestion connector in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available for all customers.
items.why: Lets teams ingest SQL Server data into Databricks with production-ready support.
items.title: Microsoft SQL Server connector GA

items.headline: Automatic liquid clustering for Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Pipelines can now use CLUSTER BY AUTO, so Databricks picks clustering keys to optimise query performance automatically.
items.why: Less manual tuning of table layouts for faster pipeline query performance.
items.title: Automatic liquid clustering is now available for Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow

items.headline: Budget policy support for Lakebase instances and synced tables
items.summary: Lakebase instances and synced tables can be tagged with budget policies, plus custom tags for cost attribution.
items.why: Lets data leaders attribute Lakebase compute spend to teams, projects or cost centres.
items.title: Budget policy support for Lakebase database instances and synced tables (Public Preview)

items.headline: Notebook autocomplete now handles structs, maps and arrays
items.summary: SQL notebook cells now suggest fields for structs, maps and arrays, and CTE columns from SELECT *.
items.why: Faster SQL writing with fewer schema lookups for nested data.
items.title: Enhanced autocomplete for complex data types in notebooks

items.headline: Databricks Assistant now works on compute pages
items.summary: Users can now chat with Databricks Assistant on some compute pages to create compute resources, pools and policies, and ask questions about them.
items.why: Speeds up setting up compute and checking Unity Catalog status and policies.
items.title: Databricks Assistant integrated with compute

items.headline: Deploy Lakebase databases with Declarative Automation Bundles
items.summary: Bundles can now define Lakebase catalogs, instances and synced tables, deploying full database environments in one command.
items.why: Lets teams deploy and version Lakebase environments alongside code, without manual setup.
items.title: Declarative Automation Bundles support for Lakebase database resources

items.headline: Genie validates SQL join relationships and fixes space cloning
items.summary: Genie now flags errors in SQL join statements authors write, and cloned spaces now copy their tables correctly.
items.why: Fewer broken join relationships in Genie spaces, and cloned spaces work as expected.
items.title: Genie SQL validation and space management

items.headline: Databricks signs term sheet for Series K funding
items.summary: Databricks signed a term sheet for a Series K round valuing the company above $100 billion, closing soon.
items.why: Signals strong investor confidence and financial momentum in the data and AI platform.
items.title: Databricks is raising a Series K Investment at >$100 billion valuation

items.headline: Set the run-as user for Spark Declarative Pipelines
items.summary: Pipelines can now run as a chosen identity, including a service principal, and change the owner of published tables.
items.why: Service principals are safer and more reliable than user accounts for automated pipelines.
items.title: Set the run-as user for Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow

items.headline: Reranker arrives in Mosaic AI Vector Search
items.summary: Mosaic AI Vector Search now offers reranking to improve retrieval quality, currently in preview.
items.why: Better retrieval quality for RAG and agent applications built on vector search.
items.title: Mosaic AI Vector Search reranker Public Preview

items.headline: Databricks Assistant runs on Databricks-hosted models
items.summary: Databricks Assistant can now run fully on models hosted within Databricks, on all clouds, at no extra cost.
items.why: Assistant features run on Databricks infrastructure with no added cost.
items.title: Databricks-hosted models for Assistant are now GA

items.headline: Databricks SQL 2025.25 adds recursive CTEs and spatial types
items.summary: Preview release adds generally available recursive CTEs, schema and catalog default collation, and over 80 spatial SQL functions.
items.why: Simplifies hierarchical queries and geospatial analysis without external tools.
items.title: Databricks SQL version 2025.25 is now available in Preview

items.headline: New Databricks SQL editor with real-time collaboration
items.summary: The new SQL editor adds multiple statement results, inline execution history, real-time collaboration and enhanced Databricks Assistant integration.
items.why: Speeds up query writing and lets teams co-author SQL in one place.
items.title: New SQL editor is generally available

items.headline: Funnel charts and table fixes in AI/BI dashboards
items.summary: AI/BI dashboards now support funnel charts, plus table indicators, column width retention and field ordering fixes.
items.why: Adds a new chart type for conversion analysis and smooths table editing.
items.title: Dashboard table visualization and chart improvements

items.headline: Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow bundle template
items.summary: Users can create an ETL pipeline inside a bundle in the workspace using a new project template.
items.why: Speeds up building and deploying ETL pipelines with bundles in the workspace.
items.title: Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow template in bundles in the workspace (Public Preview)

items.headline: Genie gets safer file uploads and simpler setup
items.summary: File uploads in Genie are now private to their uploader, and the catalog and schema are set automatically.
items.why: Keeps uploaded files private to their owners and reduces setup effort.
